articleTitle: Image Steganography based on improved LSB algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of copyright protection of electronic resources, this paper establishes a model based on the optimized LSB algorithm to implicitly write the target information into the image. The model first encodes the text and optimizes the LSB algorithm with a random search algorithm, so as to obtain picture after embedding the information. The output image is measured in terms of SSIM(StructureSimilarity Index Measure), MSE(Mean Square Error), PSNR(Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio), and compared with the original unimproved LSB algorithm, which shows that the optimized LSB algorithm has improved compared with the original one.

articleTitle: Plug-and-Work edge collaborator design for customised manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to improve the flexibility and adaptability of the customized production line and meet the user’s demand for customized products, this paper proposes a devise scheme and achievement programme of the plug and work edge collaborator for customized manufacturing. Firstly, the requirements of the collaborator are analyzed and the design framework is proposed. Then, the information model construction methods of different granularity devices from three perspectives of structure, function and behavior are introduced in detail, and the modeling is realized by AutomationML data format. Then collaborator hardware is selected and model conversion code, protocol mapping and logic mapping code, and service discovery and registration code are written to have the ability of model self-awareness, automatic configuration and automatic code generation. Finally, the plug and work functional are verified on a simulation platform. On the basis of the device information model, the plug-in edge collaborator designed in this paper can automatically perceive the surrounding environment of the manufacturing site and realize the plug-in and production without intervention.

articleTitle: Multi-UAV Urban Delivery Research Based on Range Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) range is a key factor in the success of last-mile delivery, and this paper proposes a path-planning-based task assignment strategy. Multi-task solving faces the problem of high computational volume and high solving difficulty. To minimize the quantity of path planning and enhance algorithmic efficiency, the uniform distribution K-means (UD-Kmeans) algorithm is initially employed to decompose tasks into multiple task groups. This decomposes the task into multiple task groups, reducing the coupling of the system and the complexity of task solving. Next, the Bidirectional Adaptive Potential Field -Rapidly-exploring Random Tree star (Bi-APF-RRT*) algorithm is utilized within the task group to obtain the distance matrix. Following this, the Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) algorithm is used to assign tasks with the objective of minimizing the total UAV range, combined with the distance matrix. Simulation experiments show that the MCTS algorithm combined with path planning (PP-MCTS) can efficiently and reasonably allocate multi-tasks, proving the effectiveness of this allocation strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Electricity Load Forecasting Based on the GWO-LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the process of construction and operation of the power grid, power load forecasting is a very important part, according to the forecast results, can be better grid scheduling and security monitoring and other important work, so it is very necessary to do the forecast as much as possible to improve the prediction accuracy, according to the selection of the data in the temperature, humidity, date type and load data analysis, the use of optimization of the hyperparameters of the LSTM neural network through the grey wolf optimization algorithm , and finally the use of the optimized model for prediction.

articleTitle: Electric Tower Extraction in Overhead Line Based on Multi-Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Lidar has been applied widely in intelligent applications of overhead line inspection. However, automatic extraction of electric towers from overhead lines remains a tricky problem considering both the accuracy and the efficiency. To address this, we propose a method for extracting electric tower point clouds based on the fusion of images and point clouds. The mature 2D object detection technique is introduced to conveniently locate the tower in an image, and then the tower point cloud can be extracted by the proposed spatiotemporal alignment of point clouds and images, through a coarse tower extraction and fine extraction. Experiments show that the extracted electric tower point clouds are complete and accurate, and the extraction speed is superior to traditional methods.

articleTitle: A micro-quadrotor UAV wind-resistant control method based on LADRC
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of micro-quadrotor UAVs, which are small in size, light in mass, and susceptible to wind, this paper designs a Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (LADRC) controller to achieve wind-resistant control of micro-quadrotor UAVs, simulates and analyzes the attitude control of micro-quadrotor UAVs, and compares it with the classical PID control method. The simulation results show that, under a certain amount of wind perturbation, the LADRC controller is able to estimate and compensate for the total disturbances of the strong wind conditions very well, and the response speed and stability of the LADRC controller are better than those of the classical PID controller.

articleTitle: In-situ Measurement of Crystal Length and Width Based on Binocular Vision with Oriented Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: For real-time monitoring of the growth quality of crystals during a crystallization process, this paper proposes an in-situ measurement method of crystal length and width based on the oriented object detection by a binocular vision system. The oriented object detection is used to divide the overlapped crystals into individual crystals for measurement, respectively, so as to improve the measurement accuracy on crystal size distribution (CSD). By establishing an imaging model of the binocular telecentric cameras, the coordinates of four key contour points representing the crystal length and width in three-dimensional (3D) space are precisely calculated, such that the length and width of each crystal could be reconstructed for measurement, avoiding the projection error from two-dimensional (2D) plane measurement. Experimental verification on measuring the cooling crystallization process of -form L-glutamic acid (LGA) is shown to demonstrate the effectiveness and advantage of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Multi-UAV Based on Improved Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper explores the application of reinforcement learning in multiple unmanned aerial vehicle (multi-UAV) path planning. The traditional proximal policy optimization (PPO) algorithm faces issues with low efficiency and unstable performance. We introduce a refined version of PPO called RB-PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization with Replay Buffer). The RB-PPO uses off-policy data stored in a replay buffer to enhance the sample efficiency of PPO. Furthermore, it incorporates rollback operations into the objective function to constrain the difference between new and old policies, making policy updates more stable. The RB-PPO combines the stability advantage of on-policy algorithms with the efficient sampling of off-policy algorithms. The experiment results indicate that the RB-PPO achieves quicker convergence and better training rewards compared to the PPO.

articleTitle: Maneuvering Target Tracking Algorithm Across Detection Blind Spots
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In pursuit of tracking multiple maneuvering targets efficiently, radar systems must ensure consistent tracking. Ground-based radar systems encounter challenges, particularly when maneuvering multi-targets exhibit radial velocities below the minimum detectable threshold, leading to their ingress into detection blind spots. Such occurrences result in data loss, significantly impeding subsequent command decisions. To address this issue, we propose a maneuvering multi-target tracking algorithm, which is called cross-detection blind spots maneuvering target tracking algorithm. This algorithm integrates the interacting multiple model-unscented Kalman filter (IMM-UKF) algorithm into the global nearest neighbor tracking framework, which can complete the tracking maneuvering multi-targets across blind spots. Simulation results demonstrate that the algorithm has higher accuracy and efficiency than the traditional methods in maneuvering multi-target tracking.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Remote Monitoring Robot System for Solitary Elderly Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Addressing the limitations of existing solitary elderly monitoring systems, this paper employs embedded technology, mobile communication technology, and artificial intelligence image processing technology to develop a remote monitoring robot system for the children or guardians of solitary elderly individuals. This robot system aims to overcome the shortcomings of traditional fixed camera monitoring systems, achieving more flexible and efficient remote monitoring of the elderly with a cheaper solution. The hardware part of the robot system uses the CH32V307VCT6 microcontroller as the processor, combined with the HC-SR04 sensor for obstacle avoidance detection, utilizes an LED pillbox to remind the elderly to take their medication, employs a K210 camera module to monitor falling behavior, and achieves wireless communication through the esp8266 module. The hardware programming uses MRS IDE, the server side adopts Bafa Cloud and MQTT transmission protocol, and the mobile app is created through WeChat Developer Tools. At the same time, a vision algorithm based on deep learning is used to determine whether the elderly person has fallen. Test results prove that this intelligent monitoring system for the elderly, based on embedded technology, performs well in terms of real-time performance, accuracy, and stability.

articleTitle: Multi-level Fusion in a Hybrid Architecture for 3D Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, multi-level feature fusion is applied in a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture. In more detail, level-by-level fusions of multiple levels of Transformer output with various scales of CNN encoder feature maps are used in the decoder. The Transformer will be used to capture long-distance dependencies, while the CNN will be fully utilized for local feature extraction. It is also possible to combine features of various sizes to create discriminative features, which aids the decoder step in producing finer segmentation results. The method MFTr proposed in this paper has been validated with the BraTS2020 dataset for brain tumor segmentation task. The experimental results show the superior performance of MFTr in segmenting 3D medical images.

articleTitle: Research on License Plate Recognition Method Based on LPRNet and Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low recognition efficiency, weak generalization ability, and low recognition accuracy of existing license plate recognition technology, an end-to-end license plate detection and recognition model was proposed for license plate detection and recognition in a high- precision complex environment. First of all, the license plate location model uses YOLOv8, in which the Biformer attention mechanism is introduced to enhance the attention of small targets in the license plate, and the traditional convolution is replaced by the deep separated convolution (DSC), which reduces the number of parameters and improves the calculation speed, thus producing a more lightweight model. The license plate recognition network uses LPRNet, which is a lightweight network proposed specifically for license plate recognition. Its model size is only about 1.5M. Finally, this paper presents a large number of experimental results on the Chinese city license plate dataset (CCPD2019) and the selfie dataset. The results show that the mAP50 of the license plate location model based on the improved YOLOv8 proposed in this paper is 0.994, and the MAP50:95 is 0.922. In addition, the mAP value of the LPRNet license plate recognition model also reached 0.896. The overall recognition accuracy of the model is 98.05%, which is obviously better than the traditional license plate recognition technology. It performs well in complex environments, maintaining high accuracy while remaining lightweight, and is easy to deploy on embedded edge devices.

articleTitle: Random Fourier Features Kernel Recursive Generalized Loss for Online Time Series Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the highlight of the dynamic characteristics of complex systems, the online prediction method of time series has become a key means to master the dynamic changes of complex systems. In this paper, we propose a novel kernel adaptive algorithm, called kernel recursive generalized loss (KRGL) algorithm, which is derived from generalized loss (GL) function in the kernel space in the form of online recursion. Different from the traditional fixed loss function, GL function is a synthesis of various loss functions, which can adaptively learn weights according to errors and effectively weaken outliers or non-Gaussian noise. It has high superiority in real-time tracking of the dynamic changes of the complex systems. At the same time, considering the infinite expansion of the kernel matrix, the sparse method is used in the general form of GL function, and random Fourier features kernel recursive generalized loss (RFF-KRGL) algorithm is proposed. By using the finite-dimensional inner product to approximate the kernel function, the weight network structure is fixed and the computational complexity is significantly reduced. Finally, simulations are performed on a benchmark dataset and a real-world dataset to verily the robustness of the proposed KRGL and RFF-KRGL in the online prediction of nonlinear, non-Gaussian and non-stationary time series.

articleTitle: BAGAN: Semantic Segmentation of Oil Spills in Optical Remote Sensing Images Based on Bottleneck Attention Module and Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the serious threat that marine oil spills pose to the ecological environment, satellite remote sensing technology for monitoring these spills is especially important. Optical satellite remote sensing, with its benefits of high spatial and temporal resolution, high spectral resolution, and autonomous operation, can effectively track and monitor marine oil spill incidents. However, the acquisition of optical satellite data is highly susceptible to climate conditions, making it difficult to obtain sufficient data for efficient information extraction. Therefore, this article proposes a bottleneck attention generative adversarial network (BAGAN) that can accurately extract oil spill areas from visible remote sensing data. The addition of data preprocessing and bottleneck attention module (BAM) in the model has improved the accuracy of oil spill segmentation. Through the optical remote sensing data of GF-1 satellite in the Bohai Bay from 2022 to 2023, the average accuracy reached 89.11%, verifying that this model is superior to other models in semantic segmentation.

articleTitle: Outlier Detection of Cement Rotary Kiln Parameters Based on CNN-LSTM-Attention Model Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The working conditions of clinker calcination process in cement rotary kiln are complex and changeable, and the change of various parameters is an important factor affecting the quality of cement. Aiming at the problem of abnormal detection of parameter data in the production process of cement rotary kiln, this paper proposes an abnormal value detection method based on CNN-LSTM-Attention model prediction. Three parameters of kiln main current, kiln head pressure and kiln head temperature related to common abnormal working conditions are selected and introduced. Firstly, the CNN-LSTM-Attention model is trained using normal historical data to learn the time series characteristics of the data. Then, the trained model is used to predict the test set part, and the abnormal data points are identified by comparing the difference between the predicted value and the actual value of the test set part. The experimental results show that this method can effectively detect the abnormality of various parameters of cement rotary kiln, and provides a more effective means for fault diagnosis and prevention in the production process. This method has good practicability and reliability, and has certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Probabilistic Boolean Networks under State-Flipped Control
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the synchronization problem of probabilistic boolean networks (PBNs) under state-flipped control. First, by flipping some of the nodes, the entire state space is transferred to a synchronous state set. Some verification conditions for the synchronization of PBNs are proposed. Second, a Q-Learning (QL) algorithm for synchronizing PBNs in finite flip control is given, and the minimum flip set is obtained. Finally, numerical simulations are performed to verify the feasibility of the conclusions.

articleTitle: Design of a Subway Train Fault Detection System based on Yolov7 and EfficientNet Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Due to the current issues of dim lighting, fatigue, and high false detection rates in manual visual inspection of subway trains, a train bottom fault detection system has been designed to address these issues. The robot can automatically operate under the train, capture images of target inspection points through the robot vision system, locate bolts using an improved Yolov7 algorithm, and then use the EfficientNet+B3 model to identify bolt faults. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the designed method for locating bolts is 0.9942 , and the accuracy of identifying bolt faults is 0.979, demonstrating excellent fault recognition performance.

articleTitle: Bionic Flapping-wing micro air vehicle design and PD flight control
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: As a new type of flying vehicle that imitates biological flight, the wing-fluttering vehicle has many advantages and development prospects that traditional flying vehicles do not have. In the current research, most of the vertical flight prototypes use the crank and double rocker mechanism, using two pairs of flexible wings to flap to produce the effect of moment cancellation to stabilize the vertical flight, this paper proposes a motor-driven biomimetic vertical flight wing fluttering micro-vehicle, the use of a double rudder steering control structure design, to achieve a good control effect on the pitch angle, roll angle. In this paper, a three-dimensional model of its transmission mechanism, steering structure, and overall assembly of the prototype is established, and it is assembled by physical processing. The PD control algorithm is adopted for the steering control mechanism of the vehicle, and the flight experiment is conducted on the actual constructed vehicle. The results of the flight experiments are briefly analyzed, and the study shows that the use of PD control is more effective for the miniature flapping wing vehicle designed in this paper.

articleTitle: Data-driven control for multi-rate sampling singularly perturbed systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the stabilization problem of singularly perturbed hybrid systems with multi-rate sampling. Firstly, we established a hybrid model of singularly perturbed system by designing a multi-rate sampling controller. Secondly, sufficient conditions for global exponential stability of the considered systems are provided using the Lyapunov method. Thirdly, the bounds on the maximum allowable sampling intervals are estimated, and the influence of singular perturbation parameters on the sampling intervals and sampling rates is analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the simulation of DC motor model.

articleTitle: Dynamic Image-Based Formation Control of Omnidirectional Mobile Robots via SMC
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a vision-based formation control strategy for monocular cameras fixed on omnidirectional mobile robots (OMRs) and design a prescribed performance sliding mode control (SMC) law. We explore the visual kinematics of feature points relative to the camera frame and present the dynamics of OMRs. By crafting performance envelope and conducting error transformations, the field of view constraint can be ensured. Additionally, we use Lyapunov tools to demonstrate the global stability of the proposed control algorithm and validate its effectiveness and performance through numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Enhanced CCA-based Fault Detection with Deep Neural Networks in High-Speed Train Traction Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative fault detection method for nonlinear systems by combining deep neural networks (DNNs) with canonical correlation analysis (CCA). Unlike traditional linear CCA-based fault detection methods, this approach initially uses DNNs to extract advanced and complex feature extractions from raw data, followed by using these features as inputs for CCA. By computing the correlation coefficients and continually adjusting the parameters of the DNN, the maximum correlation in the data, resulting in the optimal residuals to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of fault detection. Addressing the issue that the assumption of independence among features after DNN feature extraction may no longer hold, a kernel density estimation method is utilized to determine the threshold. Finally, the proposed fault detection method is applied to the simulation of a high-speed train traction system, verifying the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Lithium-ion batteries state of charge estimation using PSO-BP neural network improved UKF algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To tackle the issue of inaccurate state of charge (SOC) estimation in lithium-ion batteries when employing the unscented Kalman filter (UKF) in real-world applications, a refined approach utilizing the PSO-BP neural network is introduced to enhance the performance of UKF for SOC estimation. Firstly, the Thevenin model is identified using particle swarm optimization (PSO). Secondly, the PSO-BP is trained by using the characteristic parameters related to the estimation error of UKF. Finally, the UKF SOC estimate error was corrected using the trained PSO-BP. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm significantly enhances SOC estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-Based Adaptive Tracking Control for the Conversion Mode of Tilt-Rotor Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy-based adaptive tracking control scheme is proposed for the conversion mode of tilt-rotor aircraft subject to system uncertainties. In order to characterize the dynamics of the conversion process, a switched nonlinear model with respect to the inclination angle is established. To this end, an fuzzy control scheme is designed to enable the state of the closed-loop system to track the desired trajectory. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control method is illustrated by a simulation.

articleTitle: Real-Time Multi-View Human Pose Estimation System
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We present a highly synchronized multi-view hardware acquisition system that simultaneously enables real-time multi-person pose estimation. We design a hardware synchronizer to achieve multi camera synchronous shooting, with a synchronization latency rate of only 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−8</sup> seconds. Based on this, we construct a multi-view hardware synchronous acquisition system. This system can be flexibly deployed in various environments to capture moving targets, such as bodies, clothing, hands, etc. Leveraging the distributed computing capabilities of the system, we further develop a multi-view multi-person pose estimation algorithm framework that fulfills real-time requirements and achieves an average frame rate of 40FPS in experimental settings while demonstrating robustness against human motion and occlusion.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Coordination of Multiple Euler-Lagrange Systems over Directed Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the distributed optimal coordination (DOC) problem of multiple Euler-Lagrange (EL) systems over weighted-unbalanced directed networks. By introducing a balanced compensation variable associated with the out-degree information, a nonlinear DOC controller coupling with a DOC estimator are established to estimate optimal solution of DOC problem while coordinating the states of all agents to reach consensus. Additionally, a Lyapunov stability analysis framework is formulated to analyze the convergence of the proposed DOC algorithm. Finally, a numerical simulation is illustrated to validate the effectiveness of proposed theoretical results.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing Based on CBAM-ICNN
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Rolling bearing is one of the key components of mechanical equipment, and it is of great practical significance to ensure its normal operation. Note that the bearing fault diagnosis method based on convolutional neural network cannot adaptively extract key features. A fault diagnosis method is proposed based on short-time fourier transform and convolutional neural network with convolutional block attention module (STFT-CBAM-ICNN) in this paper. Firstly, the one-dimensional vibration signals are transformed into two-dimensional time-frequency images by using short-time fourier transform. Secondly, for the purpose of increasing the network’s attention to important features and improve the ability of feature extraction, the CBAM attention mechanism is embedded into an improved convolutional neural network. In addition, the transformed image data is fed into the CBAM-ICNN module for feature extraction and fault classification. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed STFT-CBAM-ICNN model in the fault diagnosis of rolling bearing is verified by several sets of comparative experiments.

articleTitle: A Target-scoring Technique with Anti-shake based on Object Detection and Feature Matching
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Training for law enforcement personnel in chestring target shooting is of significant importance, and the completion of such training relies heavily on an accurate and fast target-scoring system. The target-scoring techniques based on digital image processing is low-cost and accurate, and has been improved recently with the development of deep learning. However, the accuracy and robustness cannot be ensured if the target paper shakes or the training environment is complex. To solve these issues, in this paper, we propose an automatic target-scoring method based on feature matching networks and bullet hole recognition models. A feature matching network is first utilized for image registration to reduce the deviations caused by target paper vibrations. Subsequently, a recognition model is employed to detect bullet holes in each frame of the video stream. Finally, a binary tree is established based on the position information of the bullet holes to arrange the sequence of shots and calculate scores, achieving live ammunition target-scoring. Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, which outperforms existing methods in terms of accuracy, speed, and robustness in target-scoring. This provides insights for further improvements in the target-scoring systems for law enforcement.

articleTitle: Research on High-Gloss Surface Detection Method Based on Projection grating Phase and LCD Screen Phase Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Due to the problem of overexposure that existing in traditional phase measurement profilometry method during the reconstruction of high reflective objects, this paper proposes an absolute phase acquisition method based on phase measurement profilometry and LCD screen phase compensation. This method, first, structured light is projected onto high reflective object using a projector and LCD screen, second, the absolute phase information projected by projector and LCD is obtained. After that, the absolute phase information of overexposure area is obtained by the algorithm that proposed in this paper. Finally, the object under measurement is reconstructed using the stereo vision algorithms. The experiment shows that this method is capable of recovering phase information for highly exposed areas, overcoming the problem of outliers and discrete point clouds. It measures 99.99% of the valid point cloud, that shows this method is effective.

articleTitle: A global-local path planning for mobile robot with real-time unknown obstacle avoidance
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: During the execution of given tasks, mobile robot is required to respond to both known and unknown obstacles in real time, but avoiding the unknown obstacles in the cluttered surroundings is difficult. This paper aims to deal with the collision avoidance problem for the mobile robot through real-time path planning via a best-position-based dynamic window approach (BP-DWA). Firstly, the traditional A* algorithm is promoted by removing the redundant path points. Then, the promoted A* algorithm is incorporated into the DWA to prevent the robot from getting trapped into local optima, while avoiding the unknown obstacles. Subsequently, a BP-DWA is developed, which provides the next best position for the mobile robot instead of the next best velocity. This improvement helps to reduce the mobile robot’s computing burden and enhance the velocity stability. Simulation comparisons between the BP-DWA and the existing dynamic window-based approaches demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Fuzzy sliding mode active disturbance rejection attitude control for quadcopters based on new hyperbolic reaching law
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the issue of wind speed and airflow disturbances in different directions and intensities that quadcopter may encounter during flightˈan advanced fuzzy sliding mode active disturbance rejection control system utilizing the hyperbolic convergence law is designed. Firstly, a dynamic mathematical model is established for a four-rotor wing, considering air drag interference, based on kinematic and dynamic analyses. Secondly, a novel hyperbolic sliding mode reaching law is introduced to enhance the anti-interference ability of fuzzy sliding mode active disturbance rejection controller. Finally, a comprehensive stability analysis is conducted to validate the efficacy of the proposed control law. Simulation results demonstrate that the controller exhibits robust interference rejection capabilities, rapid response times, and effectively regulates the flight attitude of the quadrotor.

articleTitle: Online Reinforcement Learning Control of Nonlinear Vehicle Platoons with Unknown Disturbances and Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In our paper, an innovative framework for online reinforcement learning in a discrete-time setting has been introduced to address the complex issue of tracking within a third-order nonlinear discrete-time vehicle platoon. The Actor and Critic neural networks are concurrently refined in an online manner to formulate the most effective control strategy that remains within defined limits. The proposed method is suitable for nonlinear discrete-time tracking systems with unknown disturbances and control constraints, it does not require complete dynamic information. The results of the simulation confirm the scheme’s efficacy.

articleTitle: Application of the DIMSST in Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing under Variable Speed Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Rolling bearings are indispensable parts of high-end mechanical equipment. To ensure safe production, it is essential to promptly detect and diagnose issues in high-end equipment, particularly when it comes to critical component diagnosis. However, there are a lot of uncertainties in the operation of the machine, such as variable speed and noise interference, which pose a challenge to the fault diagnosis of rolling bearings. A new post-processing method for time-frequency analysis, DIMSST, is introduced in this paper. Based on preserving the high time-frequency aggregation of IMSST, the idea of average threshold denoising is introduced, which makes DIMSST obtain the high energy concentration time-frequency representation and enhance the anti-noise performance. Finally, the proposed method successfully diagnosed the rolling bearing with outer ring fault and inner ring fault, and verified the potential of its application in engineering.

articleTitle: Bi-layer Optimization of integrated wind-PV-hydrogen systems considering the whole life cycle
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of coordinated optimal configuration and scheduling of individual devices in a coupled wind-PV-hydrogen power generation system, A Bilayer optimisation model is proposed. The upper model is a planning model that targets full life cycle economic indicators. The lower layer is a dispatch model that targets brother you power purchases, energy and hydrogen abandonment. By iterating, Determine the optimal capacity and optimal output of the equipment. Secondly, the particle swarm algorithm is used to solve the upper optimal configuration model and the lower optimal scheduling model is solved using the Yalmip toolbox Cplex commercial solver for the MATLAB platform. Finally, the validity of the configuration results is verified through a park as an arithmetic example, which provides theoretical support for the economic operation of wind-hydrogen coupled power generation system.

articleTitle: Neural Network Training Method Based on Dynamic Segmentation of the Training Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We propose a neural network training method based on the dynamic partition of the training data set . The main idea is to perform multiple iterative training on the neural network model. Each iteration of training splits the training data set, and allows the neural network model to train independently on several sub datasets obtained by the segmentation. According to the error performance on the entire training data set of the neural network model trained on the sub-dataset , the optimal neural network model with the smallest error is selected as the initial network for the next iteration training. Experiments show that this training method based on dynamic segmentation of the training data set has two advantages compared with the traditional training method. One is to improve the training efficiency, because the sub-datasets obtained by each segmentation are independent of each other. Data set segmentation can be used for parallel training to accelerate training. The other is that this progressive training model of training data sets from small to large, from less to more, conforms to the changing law of human understanding of things, and makes the model have better training accuracy and generalization ability.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis for Multiplicative False Data Injection Attack Detection Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: False data injection attacks are one of the critical threats to modern power systems. Most of the existing false data injection attack detection is studied for additive false data injection attacks, while there are few studies on multiplicative false data injection attacks. In this paper, we propose a consistency test for a multiplicative false data injection attack, assuming that such attack can bypass the power system’s Chi-square detection. First, we derive the failure range of Chi-square detection against the multiplicative false data injection attack within a system model. Second, we use the estimates of the Kalman filter and a weighted least square estimator to perform consistency tests for detecting presence of the multiplicative false data injection attack. Consistency tests are conducted within the failure range of chi-square detection and the detection range of consistency tests is also studied. Finally, we verify the effectiveness of the consistency test within the failure range of chi-square detection by the simulation results of voltage magnitude and voltage phase angle.

articleTitle: Spatial Knowledge Transfer for Few-Shot Hyperspectral Image Classification Based on Residual Vision Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Deep learning has significantly advanced the hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by leveraging extensive training data and model parameters. However, challenges persist due to limited and low-quality labeled samples from ground surveys, hampering performance. Additionally, training models with numerous parameters demands substantial computational resources. To overcome these challenges, we propose a spatial knowledge transfer method for few-shot HSI classification using a lightweight model. Our approach utilizes spatial prior knowledge from RGB images through transfer learning. We pretrain the spatial feature extraction network on mini-ImageNet datasets and fine-tune it on practical HSIs, resulting in significant improvements in classification accuracy and the model convergence speed. Moreover, we introduce an innovative network architecture that combines residual networks and Vision Transformers, effectively capturing both local features and long-range dependencies within patches to extract global-local spatial information. Complementing spatial features, we employ a spectral feature extraction network based on one-dimensional convolutions, chosen for its effectiveness in capturing spectral characteristics. The extracted spatial and spectral features are seamlessly integrated using a fusion block based on fully connected networks. Experimental results on two publicly benchmarked HSI datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our method over existing few-shot and supervised learning approaches.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Modelling of Aeroengine systems Based on Variational Bayes and Adaptive Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper mainly develops a data-driven modeling approach for aeroengine systems. To describe how the system behaves dynamically, a state variable model is constructed, and it is further transformed such that the unknown parameters are treated as hidden states. As a result, the model parameters with their uncertainties, and the noise statistics can be jointly estimated by integrating an adaptive Kalman filter into the variational Bayesian (VB) framework. The efficacy of the proposed data-driven model is verified through comparison study with the component-level JT9D aeroengine model provided by NASA.

articleTitle: Immersive Virtual Simulation System for Principles of Communications Based on Unity 3D
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Utilizing virtual reality technology for 3D modeling of experimental equipment, this study achieved digital simulation of the signal transmission process and developed a multi-user collaborative, immersive virtual simulation system for communication principles using the Unity 3D rendering engine. This system allows multiple students enter the same virtual space simultaneously via the network to collaboratively manipulate 3D virtual instruments and complete communication experiments such as modulation and demodulation of AM signal. The underlying information exchange architecture employs the MySQL database to store user data, uses C# for networking servers, and establishes a data exchange protocol with Socket, creating a decoupled foundation network that allows real-time data reading and exchange from multiple clients to meet the requirements of online collaboration. This approach addresses the issues of insufficient space and equipment resources in conventional laboratories, alongside overcoming the limitations on students' practice time and space, and streamlines the evaluation process in experimental education.

articleTitle: Design of an Air Circulation Control System Based on Adaptive Temperature Regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A new type of air circulation control system to serve as an improvement for temperature instability and insufficient adjustment and other technology defect is reported. The adaptive temperature regulation function of the system is realized through the design of water constant temperature device, multi-channel exhaust channel, exhaust auxiliary device, and special control methods on the basis of traditional technology. This paper introduced the system structure, component function, working mode, control method and control flow in detail. The two working modes of external circulation and internal circulation are analyzed and illustrated with examples. This system, which has the value of being popularized and used, is easy to implement and install with reliable effect.

articleTitle: ADRC-based Load Frequency Control of Multi-Source Interconnected Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper studies the load frequency control (LFC) problem of multi-region systems with renewable energy. Renewable energy access reduces the stability of the multi-area power system and accelerates the rate of change of system frequency deviations. Using modern control theory, we use a third-order active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) method to solve this problem. A third-order ADRC is designed to realize the stable control of load frequency. The dynamic characteristics and control requirements of single-region and multi-region power systems are analyzed by building their models. The proposed method is verified to be effective.

articleTitle: A Self-Optimizing Deep Belief Network with Adaptive-Active Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Deep belief network (DBN) is an effective deep learning model, which has been widely used to analyze big-data characteristics, extract features and approximate nonlinear systems. However, due to the deep structure and numerous parameters, DBN suffers from the disadvantage of time-consuming training process generally. To address this problem and improve the training efficiency without reducing accuracy, this paper proposes a self-optimizing deep belief network with adaptive-active learning (SODBN-AAL). In the proposed SODBN-AAL, an adaptive learning algorithm of hyper-parameters is designed to ensure a good accuracy. On this basis, an active learning algorithm is developed based on event-triggered strategy to improve the training efficiency by extracting effective data and skipping invalid data. As a self-optimizing model, SODBN-AAL combines the advantages of both adaptive hyper-parameters and the event-triggered active learning. Two simulation experiments on the benchmark problem and water quality prediction are conducted to show the advantages of SODBN-AAL. The results show that, compared with the basic DBN model, SODBN-AAL averagely improves the learning accuracy by 77.13% and learning efficiency by 84.83%.

articleTitle: Robust Visual-Inertial-Wheel SLAM for Ground Robots in Complicated Scenes
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) in real-world scenes faces several challenges, including highly dynamic people and vehicles which make the static assumption of traditional SLAM no longer valid, and some indoor dim scenes which cause the loss of visual features. This paper presents a robust visual-inertial-wheel SLAM algorithm for ground robots that can handle these challenges in complicated environments. The proposed algorithm introduces a lightweight object detection network as the front-end to remove dynamic features in real time, and develops a novel filter-based approach to enhance feature tracking. The back-end of the proposed algorithm is modeled as an optimization-based bundle adjustment problem which includes constraints from IMU, wheel, visual and ground measurement. The proposed method is extensively evaluated on OpenLORIS dataset that includes real-world complicated scenes to validate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Flight Control for Small Fixed-Wing UAV Rolling Takeoff in Presence of Strong Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A novel rolling takeoff scheme for small fixed- wing unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) based on fuzzy control is presented in this paper. According to the analysis of the disturbance and control ability of UAV, the disturbance torque in rolling channel which caused by the propeller is larger than the control ability of aileron during the initial takeoff phase. To overcome the conflict between the disturbance and the control ability, the disturbance torque is treated as a part of control input to control the UAV make a quasi-barrel-roll in initial phase. With the increasing of velocity and control ability of UAV, the disturbance torque is compensated by the control torque such that the roll angle can be stabilized quickly. Based on aforementioned control strategy, the fuzzy control method is adopted to design the flight control scheme, and the frequency response of the proposed control scheme is presented. Numerical simulation results are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed flight control scheme.

articleTitle: A Residual Attention Network with Spectral and Spatial Selective Kernel for Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, convolutional neural networks have been widely used in hyperspectral image (HSI) classification, with spectral-spatial dual-branch network models being particularly popular. However, these networks typically use convolutional kernels with fixed-size receptive fields. This approach is unable to adaptively capture multiscale detailed features, affecting the classification results. To alleviate this issue, this paper proposes a spectral selective kernel (SK) block and a spatial SK block that can adaptively extract multi-scale features on the spectral and spatial dimensions respectively. Following this, we design a residual attention network with spectral and spatial selective kernel (SKRN), which has two branches for spectral and spatial processing respectively. On each branch, we initially use a SK block and a res2 block to simultaneously conduct branch feature extraction. After applying residual summation, we then reconstruct the feature map through global context (GC) attention. Notably, different from the traditional residual block, the res2 block also has the capability of extracting multi-scale features. Hence, this dual multi-scale feature extraction method using both SK block and res2 block makes the local detail feature extraction of the image more perfect. A series of experiments on Indian Pines (IP) and University of Pavia (UP) datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms other related algorithms, and that the combination of modules in our model achieves the best effects.

articleTitle: Prescribed Time Quantized Control for Nonlinear Systems via Sliding Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This brief presents a prescribed time quantized sliding mode control (SMC) scheme for nonlinear systems using time-varying functions. In order to reduce the communication burden, a uniform quantization strategy is considered. Two distinct time-varying functions are integrated into the design of the sliding variable and quantized SMC law, respectively, ensuring that the settling time of both the system state and the sliding variable can be prescribed and is independent of the initial conditions. Unlike existing prescribed-time SMC, the proposed method is characterized by prescribed-time ultimate boundedness with a tunable bound, even with states being quantized. Numerical simulations are conducted to highlight the main features of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Rate bumpless transfer control for a class of switched descriptor systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This brief studies stability and the rate bumpless transfer (BT) performance for switched descriptor systems (S-DSs) under a dynamics decomposition form at same time. At the switching moments, the rate of state will bump and this unexpected large bump may break the system. In order to restrain the amplitude of the rate bump, we give a definition of rate BT performance for SDSs. In addition, a sufficient condition is proposed for SDSs while ensuring the rate BT performance and stability according to the multiple Lyapunov functions theory. Furthermore, we jointly design the rate BT controller and the state-dependent switching signal. In this end, we give a numerical example to substantiate the superiority and eptitude of the put forward scheme.

articleTitle: Application of MindSpore-based waste classification detection technique
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper combines deep learning technology and, based on the MindSpore framework, designs and implements an efficient algorithm for waste classification. The paper begins by introducing the background of waste classification and its importance in environmental protection and resource recycling. At the same time, MindSpore offers convenience for the construction, training, and efficient deployment of algorithms and models. To meet the demands of waste classification tasks, the paper builds a specialized waste classification dataset and selects a series of mainstream image classification algorithms. During the model training process, data augmentation techniques such as random cropping, rotation, and horizontal flipping are introduced to enhance the model's recognition capability for various waste images. In terms of algorithm optimization, the paper selects appropriate loss functions and optimizers. The SE attention module is introduced with the aim of improving the model's ability to capture and learn key features in waste images, thereby increasing the classification accuracy. Through ablation studies and comparative experiments, the effectiveness of the SE module is validated, and the impact of different algorithms and optimizers on model performance is analyzed. The experimental results provide strong support and validation for the proposed waste classification algorithm.

articleTitle: EWCM-MPC: An Adaptive Multimode Process Control Based on Continual Learning and Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Due to changes in production conditions and strategies, industrial processes have various operation modes. However, the model based on a single operation mode cannot adapt to multimode process, leading to a degradation in the performance of model predictive control (MPC). Furthermore, most multimode process MPC require establishing a separate predictive model for each operation mode, causing the effectiveness of MPC to highly depend on the switching strategy. To address these issues, this paper proposes a continual learning-based MPC method for multimode process. First, an autoencoder and a predictor are investigated as the deep learning networks, and the continual learning strategy based on Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is used to update model among various processes, thereby a single predictive model that can automatically represent multimode process is established. Then, the single predictive model is integrated with the MPC framework, and precise control of the multimode process is achieved by solving optimization problem. Finally, numerical simulation experiments are designed to demonstrate that the proposed method achieves minimal overshoot and high accuracy in controlling multimode process.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Distributed Power Sources on Distribution Network Voltage Stability Based on Newton Raphson Method
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The connection of a high percentage of distributed PV to the distribution grid may lead to increased voltage fluctuations and instability at various nodes in the grid. The stochastic and intermittent power generation characteristics of the PV system may lead to power fluctuations in the grid, which in turn may affect the voltage level at each node. Especially during the peak hours of PV power generation, the voltage may increase, leading to unstable power system operation and even affecting the normal operation of user equipment. Therefore, it must be analyzed in order to better facilitate human life. Traditional power flow calculation methods, such as Gaussian Seidel method, tend to have difficult convergence features for sick condition systems. Therefore, it is not suitable for large-scale use. In this paper, based on Newton Raphson's method, we write a program to calculate the tidal current through Matlab, simulate the model of distributed power supply access to the distribution network and carry out the tidal current calculation, and finally analyze the steady state impact of distributed power supply access to the distribution network. The simulation results show that in the case of a large number of distributed photovoltaic connections, the Newton-Raphson method is used to calculate the power flow, which is fast and accurate. In practice, it can well avoid the phenomenon that the fault occurs and cannot be dealt with in time, and provides more accurate data for the relay protection system. In addition, it also provides a reliable reference for the access location of distributed photovoltaics, and can quickly obtain the degree to which the voltage of each location is affected by distributed photovoltaics after different locations are connected to distributed photovoltaics.

articleTitle: Cow Detection Model Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for livestock products in the market, the number of cow raised is also on the rise. However, currently, manual management and quantity statistics of cow are difficult and inefficient. In recent years, deep learning technology has been widely applied in the field of object detection. This paper proposes an improved YOLOv5 model by introducing a Bi-Level Routing Attention mechanism to address the problem of detecting a large number of cow in a circle, with significant differences in target location distance and occlusion. This model adds a dual Bi-Level Routing Attention (BRA) to the Neck layer of YOLOv5 to improve its feature processing and enhance the detection performance of the model. This article verifies the detection results through a self-built cow detection dataset. The results showed that the improved YOLOv5 model achieved Mean Average Precision (mAP) of 94.2% in individual cow detection tasks, which was 2.1% higher than the unimproved YOLOv5 model. This model provides a new approach for detecting cow in pens, laying the foundation for subsequent tracking and counting of cow.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of A Hardware-in-the-loop Simulation Virtual Environment for Multi-aircraft Tracking and Shooting Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In view of the simulation verification requirements of the control system of multi-aircraft tracking and shooting, in the hard-in-the-loop simulation test of the aircraft control system, the original image measurement device and target simulator have high cost and complex debugging degree in the target recognition process, so a physical equivalent device of image measurement based on the relative position of the head and body is designed and realized, solved the test preparation, long cycle, high test cost. The image measurement physical equivalent device based on the relative position of the head and body is referred to as the image measurement physical equivalent device. In addition, in order to meet the requirement that a sub-stage tracking test should be run at the same time with the full aircraft simulation test, a multi-core and multi-threaded parallel real-time simulation platform for multiple flight bodies is used for the first time in the test. The tests show that the closed-circuit guidance simulation test technology of the physical equivalent of the image measurement device approximates the actual application environment, improves the authenticity and reliability of the test, and reduces the test cost.

articleTitle: Geometric constraint-based image segmentation algorithm for concave point detection in complex backgrounds
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In workpiece assembly scenarios, there is a common phenomenon of sticking between workpieces, which seriously interferes with the subsequent counting and sorting of objects. Therefore, effective segmentation of these sticking workpieces is particularly critical. To address the difficult problem of segmenting highly attached objects in complex backgrounds, a concave point segmentation algorithm based on geometric constraints has been proposed. The method first utilizes angular thresholding to detect concave points in preprocessed images. Then, pseudo-concave points generated by uneven illumination are eliminated based on the number of concave points and their connected contours within a fixed range centered on the concave points. Subsequently, the distance between the concave point and the angular bisector where the remaining concave points are located is utilized to achieve the matching of concave pairs, and the straight line segmentation is performed accordingly. The results show that compared with the traditional watershed algorithm and morphology algorithm, the proposed algorithm has a significant segmentation effect in the case of uniform illumination, with an accuracy of 96.8%. At the same time, the proposed algorithm also presents a certain segmentation effect in the case of insufficient light and has a certain degree of anti-interference. This study provides a novel and efficient solution to the problem of image segmentation in complex backgrounds.

articleTitle: Encoding-Based Fusion Estimation for Multi-Sensor Systems: Applications to Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the robust set-membership fusion estimation problem for multi-sensor systems under the influence of uncertain parameters and unknown-but-bounded noises. The sensor nodes and the remote fusion estimator are connected through bandwidth-constrained communication networks. To address this challenge, a dynamic encoding-based data compression mechanism is introduced, enabling the data to be efficiently encoded using a reduced number of bits. By thoroughly analyzing the impact of uncertain parameters, unknown-but-bounded noises, and data distortions on estimation performance, sufficient conditions are derived to ensure that the estimation error remains within the bounded ellipsoidal set. Moreover, the weight parameters are calculated by solving constrained optimization problems. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed estimation algorithm is verified through a maneuvering target tracking scenario.

articleTitle: Distributed Recursive Filtering with Bit Rate Constraints and Cross-Correlated Noises over Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the distributed filtering issue for a type of discrete-time systems with cross-correlated measurement noises under constrained bit rate. The system under consideration is subject to cross-correlated measurement noises, that is, for different sensor nodes, the measurement noises are a-step cross-correlated. For digital communication, the binary encoding scheme is employed to encode the signals into binary bit strings, in which the random bit errors induced by the channel noise may occur during the propagation of the binary bit string via the memoryless binary symmetric channel. To characterize the occurrence of the bit errors, a set of Bernoulli distributed random variables is adopted. Furthermore, to better reflect the practice, the time delays in the coding-decoding process is incorporated in the filter design. Considering the impacts of the cross-correlated noises, constrained bit rates and bit errors, an upper bound of the filtering error covariance matrix is obtained and the filter parameters are acquired by minimizing the upper bound. Finally, a simulation example is conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Nonlinear predictive control based on echo state network and whale optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In response to the challenge of difficulty in modeling and low prediction accuracy for complex nonlinear processes, this paper proposes a nonlinear predictive control method that combines Echo State Networks and Whale Optimization Algorithm. Firstly, an optimized Echo State Network is utilized to construct a predictive model, capturing the nonlinear dynamic characteristics of the system. Subsequently, this predictive model is integrated with model predictive control to achieve predictive control of the system. During the control process, the Whale Optimization Algorithm is employed to solve the objective function in the rolling optimization loop, facilitating optimization adjustments to the control parameters. Finally, the proposed controller is applied to simulate and validate its effectiveness in a continuous stirred-tank reactor process. Simulation results demonstrate the efficacy of this approach.

articleTitle: A Fixed-time Disturbance Estimator of Aerial Transportation Systems With Unmodeled Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a fixed-time disturbance estimator for aerial transportation systems, to deal with uncertainties such as unmodeled dynamics and unknown disturbances. The observer is designed based on the original nonlinear dynamics of the aerial transportation system without linearization. A lumped disturbance term is introduced, which can be compensated by applying the proposed observer. The estimation error system is fixed-time stable, and the boundary of the convergence time is also given. The stability is proven rigorously and the effectiveness of the observer is verified through numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Road Grade Determination Based on Improved NARX Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved method considering the significant impact of road unevenness on vehicle performance and safety, as well as the problems of model complexity and insufficient generalization ability of existing road unevenness identification algorithms. First, simulated white noise is used to generate road irregularity data, combined with an improved NARX (Nonlinear autoregressive with external input) neural network and dropout technology to reduce model complexity and improve generalization capabilities. NARX neural networks excel in processing time series data, while dropout technology prevents overfitting by randomly discarding neurons, thereby enhancing the model's generalization ability. Following simulation verification, this method demonstrates higher accuracy and improved generalization in identifying newly generated road unevenness data, thereby enhancing the model's adaptability across diverse road conditions. Lastly, the road roughness estimation results were utilized to determine the road grade, validating the reliability and effectiveness of this method in practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Bipartite Consensus for a Class of Second-order Nonlinear Multi-agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of second-order bipartite consensus in nonlinear multi-agent systems concerning leader-following. A novel definition of the Lipschitz condition is proposed to solve the nonlinear term in the leader following the bipartite consensus problem. In addition, a procedure for adaptive output feedback control is proposed, which can continuously adjust the output of the controller to achieve stability. By utilizing the linear matrix inequality technique, a sufficient condition is proposed to ensure that the considered nonlinear multi-agent systems implement leader-following bipartite consensus. Finally, the validity and feasibility of the theoretical result are demonstrated through numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Study on Unsymmetrical Control of a Vehicle Mounted Robotic Arm System with both Output Constraints and Interference Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article is mainly talking about how to construct an unsymmetrical control strategy to achieve the control goals of vibration attenuation of mechanical arm and position tracking of angle and vehicle for a vehicle mounted robotic arm system with both time-varying output constraints and interference uncertainty. Such a vehicle mounted robotic arm system is mathematically expressed as three governing equations involving integral-partial differential equations and four boundary conditions involving partial differential equations. To take considerations of the impacts of time-varying output constraints on vehicle mounted robotic arm system and ensure that the constraints conditions are satisfied, a class of Lyapunov functions of logarithmic barrier type and an efficient unsymmetrical boundary control strategy consisting of three control actuators which are located in different locations are put forword. At last, the conclusion that above mentioned unsymmetrical boundary control strategy is working and instrumental for vibration attenuation and position tracking can be drawn by both Lyapunov’s theory and simulation results.

articleTitle: Soft Variable Structure Control for Constrained Discrete-time Singular Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper aims to address the chattering problem of sliding mode variable structure control strategy for discrete-time singular systems, and explores soft variable structure control strategy under complete controllability. First, the strategy of soft variable structure control and the design method of dynamic soft variable structure controller are introduced. Then, the controller design problem is transformed into constructing a suitable selection function via Lyapunov method, and a new selection function is proposed for the designed controller. The optimized selection strategy function makes the system stable and satisfies the control input constraints. Finally, the algorithm of undetermined parameters in the proposed controller is given, which has certain guiding significance for practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on IoT Device Access Technology based on the Power IoT Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Power Internet of Things (IoT) is a new type of information transmission technology that uses data acquisition, analysis, and calculation of various parameters in the power system to establish an intelligent network for monitoring and controlling the operation status of the power system, helping to achieve automation, digitization, and visualization in the power system. With the development of power monitoring business, the IoT platform has connected to an increasing amount of devices, which has brought challenges to the platform’s device access and management capabilities. Firstly, various types of devices often involve various professional lines such as infrastructure, production technology, and digital in power companies, and some device management functions and business applications have overlapping phenomena. Secondly, device from different manufacturers are heterogeneous, resulting in a considerable degree of access difficulties. In response to the above problems, this article designs a device access management process and technical process for power IoT, explains the role of the IoT platform in power device flow, clarifies the entire process of IoT device installation and commissioning; proposes a unified platform access standard for different types of device by constructing an device access technical system. According to the technical scheme in this article, China Southern Power Grid has built the power dedicated IoT platform access system with a capacity of tens millions devices, achieving a total of 430,000 device accesses, supporting the whole domain IoT collaborative system of "cloud pipe edge terminal".

articleTitle: Fixed-time Backstepping Control of QUAV Based on Prescribed Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article proposes a fixed-time control method with prescribed performance constraints for a quadcopter unmanned aerial vehicle (QUAV) with unknown disturbances. Firstly, the fixed-time extended state observer (ESO) is designed to estimate unknown disturbances. Secondly, the new barrier Lyapunov function (BLF) is proposed, which can handle constrained and unconstrained, symmetric and asymmetric situations. Thirdly, the tracking error is proved to converge to the origin within fixed-time by Lyapunov function. Ultimately, the effectiveness of algorithm is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Cascaded PID-based Control for Unicycle Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper studies the tracking control problem of a unicycle robot. To enhance the stability of the unicycle robot, the front-back symmetric tilting dual momentum wheels are introduced, and the cascade PID-based controller is proposed. The experimental results show that the control method is effective in solving the tracking control problem of unicycle robot, which can ensure stabilization in all directions.

articleTitle: Bipartite Time-Varying Output Formation Control of Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper studies the bipartite time-varying output formation (BTVOF) control problem for heterogeneous discrete-time linear multi-agent systems (MASs). A distributed estimator is developed to estimate the state of each agent using measurement values. Subsequently, the distributed formation controller is presented based on the distributed estimator and the reference generator. Meanwhile, based on Lyapunov stability theory, the sufficient solvability condition is derived to ensure the achievement of the desired formation control. Finally, we conduct a numerical simulation involving six quadrotors to empirically validate the efficacy of the proposed BTVOF control protocol.

articleTitle: Distributed Safe Coverage Control of Multi-agent Systems with Energy Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this article, we propose a continuous monitoring method to enhance disaster warning capabilities and address the persistent coverage problem in multi-agent systems. To enable the agent to continuously perform tasks, we transform the optimization objective function under energy constraints into constraints on control inputs. Additionally, the energy of the agent is constrained through the control barrier function (CBF), and a corresponding control framework is designed to achieve persistent task execution. We apply the proposed method to landslide early warning and validate its effectiveness and superiority in persistent coverage through numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A lightweight fire detection method based on improved Swin-Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of today's society, various disasters occur frequently, among which fire causes the most serious losses, threatening human life and property safety. Traditional fire detection methods have a high false alarm rate and low reliability. In order to reduce the influence of complex environment on fire detection results and improve the accuracy of identification, this paper proposes a fire detection method based on the improved Swin Transformer. In this method, Swin Transformer is used as the basic network, and a lightweight module of CA (Coordinate Attention) attention mechanism is introduced into the backbone network, which reduces the amount of computation and improves the feature extraction ability of the model. The traditional loss function is changed to the EIOU (Efficient-IoU) loss function, which deepens the representation ability between cross-modal feature information. In order to verify the effectiveness of the improved method, it was compared with Vision Transformer and Swin Transformer. Experimental results show that the improved method has the advantages of high detection accuracy, fast detection speed and low false alarm rate.

articleTitle: Imitation Learning of Robotic Arm with Hierarchical Training Based on Human Videos
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Human videos encapsulate a diverse spectrum of operational behaviors, serving as invaluable pedagogical resources for imitation learning. In this paper, we introduce an algorithmic framework aimed at emulating expert operational skills gleaned from human videos. The proposed algorithm computes the positional movements of individual steps within a robotic arm by quantifying the disparities between successive frames of the videos, which enables the emulation of skills exhibited in the demonstrations. In detail, we begin by utilizing image translation to seamlessly transition human demonstrations into the realm of the robotic arm, mitigating morphological differences across the multi-joint mechanical structure. Subsequently, we incorporate a keypoint detection network to extract structured information from the transformed images, generating a latent representation that encapsulates motion details for the learning process of the policy network.
