Experimental results affirm the efficacy of our approach in replicating operational skills.

articleTitle: Root cause diagnosis of industrial processes based on the KICA-RBC-ECCM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Root cause diagnosis aims to find the propagation path of the fault in time when system failure occurs, which is of key significance in the fault diagnosis of modern industrial systems. For industrial systems, the traditional root cause diagnosis methods have the problems of low efficiency and low accuracy. To solve these problems, an algorithm based on Kernel Independent Component Analysis, Reconstruction Based Contribution and Extended Convergent Cross Mapping (KICA-RBC-ECCM) is proposed in this work. First, the KICA algorithm is used for fault detection to get the transition process data. Second, the RBC algorithm is used to extract variables that contribute greatly to the fault. Third, the ECCM algorithm is used to find the causal relationship among variables to construct the fault propagation path diagram. Finaly, in order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, it is tested by the nuclear power plant secondary circuit simulation platform. The results show that compared with the ECCM algorithm, the KICA-RBC-ECCM algorithm performs better in terms of efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Study on Predicting the Degradation Performance of Non-stationary SOFC Systems Based on Time Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Considering the inherent temporal nature of SOFC system performance degradation and the existing research gap concerning the prediction of non-stationary systems, this study employs Time Convolution Networks (TCNs) to predict the behavior of non-stationary SOFC systems. Specifically, the focus is placed on predicting the degraded performance characterized by voltage drop. The findings demonstrate that TCNs offer superior performance in predicting the degradation of SOFC systems across various operating conditions.

articleTitle: Embedding Complete Binary Trees CBTn into Augmented Cubes AQn
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: As an important network structure, the complete binary tree has been investigated for parallel and distributed computing as well as being embed into other interconnection architectures for its nice properties. The n-dimensional augmented cube AQ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> is an important variant of the hypercube Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>. It has many attractive features superior to those of the hypercube. In this paper, we prove that the complete binary tree CBT<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> with 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup> vertices can be embedded into AQ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> with dilation 1 and congestion 1.

articleTitle: Clustering based distributed multi-robot task allocation algorithm in large-scale systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a consistency bundle algorithm based on clustering grouping for large-scale task allocation problems. Large scale task allocation problems often result in incomplete network coverage, exponential increase in communication frequency, and communication obstruction. Therefore, this article first uses clustering algorithms to group robots based on the number of tasks, transforming large-scale problems into small-scale problems; Secondly, use the consistency bundle algorithm to solve the task allocation problem for each group separately; Finally, the algorithm was used for simulation experiments on large-scale task allocation problems, and the results showed that the proposed algorithm can solve the problem while effectively reducing the number of communications.

articleTitle: Improved RUL prediction method of wind turbine gearbox bearings under strong noises
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: As essential components within the wind turbine gearbox, bearings are critical, and forecasting their Remaining Useful Life (RUL) is paramount. To enhance the integration of current inputs with historical data in Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) models, the Mogrifier Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) approach has been devised. It interacts with inputs and recurrent data in a predetermined fashion, marking its initial application in wind turbine gearbox bearing RUL prediction. Furthermore, the Relative Standard Deviation of Envelope Spectrum (RSDES), a reliable health indicator (HI) under high noise conditions, is introduced for precise evaluation of the gearbox bearing health. Consequently, a novel RUL prediction technique is introduced. Initially, RSDES from vibration data serves as HIs. Subsequently, utilizing these HIs, the Mogrifier LSTM predicts future HIs, and the bearing’s RUL is determined once the predicted HI surpasses the failure threshold. Empirical outcomes underscore the proposed method’s superiority over existing techniques in bearing RUL prediction.

articleTitle: Exponential stabilization of switched positive systems with time-varying delays and actuator saturation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this article, the problem of exponential stabilization (ES) for positive switched linear systems (PSLS) with time-varying delays (TVD) and actuator saturation is studied. Within the framework of the multiple co-positive Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (MCLKF) method, a time-dependent switching law is devised, grounded on the principle of dwell time switching, and a sufficient condition for the ES of the PSLS is presented, it should be pointed out that this result is applicable to case where the subsystems are unstable. Finally, the stabilization scheme is extended to PSLS with actuator saturation by using the convex hull technique. An numerical example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness and viability of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Research on Heavy Truck Load Estimation Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: For the estimation of heavy truck load, this article will conduct research as a regression scenario. Firstly, it is found that the correlation between engine data and load can be enhanced by filtering, and the filtering principle is that the correlation sum of feature data is the largest. Secondly, the tree-based GBDT (Gradient Boosting Decision Tree) algorithm is selected to study the impact of data processing methods and parameter optimization on the estimation accuracy. It is found that the mean error decreases from 3.21 tons to 1.11 tons under the optimal filtering constant, and from 1.11 tons to 0.0069 tons after hyper-parameters optimization. LDA (Linear Discriminant Analysis) feature conversion method is the best; Finally, based on LDA feature transformation, the applicability of BP neural network algorithm and SVM (Support Vector Machine) algorithm to load estimation is studied and compared. It is found that the average error of BP (Back Propagation) neural network is 0.76 tons, the memory occupation is the smallest, the error distribution is the most discrete. The load estimation has almost no time series attribute. The mean error of SVM algorithm is 0.85 tons, the memory occupation is medium, and the error distribution is between GBDT and BP. SVM model is suitable for ECU terminal integration. GBDT model is suitable for cloud integration.

articleTitle: ADLG: An Adaptive Deep Leakage from Gradients in Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Federated learning has garnered increasing attention due to its privacy-preserving capabilities. However, the unique framework of federated learning results in gradients being transmitted between clients and server, leading to extensive research on attacks that reconstruct private data from gradients information. Nevertheless, existing gradients-based attack methods often need higher accuracy and iteration speed in recovering repeated labels and reconstructing original images. We propose a novel adaptive estimation method to address this issue and accelerate gradient leakage attacks. This algorithm dynamically adjusts parameter estimations of influence quantities based on the number of repeated labels. Compared to existing methods, our algorithm enhances estimation accuracy when encountering excessively repeated labels in a single batch, thereby improving the convergence speed of attacks. Finally, we demonstrate the superiority of our algorithm in terms of convergence speed and accuracy over existing methods through practical federated learning tasks.

articleTitle: An Identity Authentication Method Based on Inertial Sensors and Pressure Insoles
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the era of digitization and intelligence, accurate identity authentication technology plays a crucial role across various domains. It garners extensive attention from academia and industry alike. This paper uses inertial sensors and pressure insoles to collect gait data for identity authentication based on gait analysis. To enhance the precision of identity authentication, a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) and a feature fusion module are proposed. The lightweight CNN, characterized by fewer parameters, is suitable for deployment on resource-constrained mobile devices. Meanwhile, the feature fusion module leverages attention mechanisms to highlight important gait feature channels and spatial characteristics. Empirical results demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Aperiodically Intermittent Control for Prescribed-Time Synchronization of Stochastic Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper tackles the challenge of achieving prescribed-time synchronization (PTS) for stochastic complex networks (SCNs) under the framework of aperiodically intermittent control (AIC). The adoption of a time-varying function ensures all states of the SCNs reach synchronization at the preset time. Compared with the PTS under the framework of deterministic systems, the introduction of stochastic disturbances has more practical significance. Introducing an auxiliary function makes the Lyapunov method mentioned in this paper valid under the AIC framework. Moreover, the AIC proposed in this paper relies on the average control rate instead of the infimum control rate, leading to less conservative results. At last, the viability of the theoretical results is confirmed by a simulation of a strongly connected digraph.

articleTitle: An Event-Triggered Deep Belief Network for Forecasting Coastal Water-Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Forecasting coastal water-quality is an indispensable step to prevent the marine pollution. In this article, we design an event-triggered deep belief network (ET-DBN) to forecast coastal water-quality. In theory, the main contribution is ET-DBN model, which is trained by the event-triggered algorithm with a selective parameter update mechanism. In practice, the main contribution is that ET-DBN model can accurately approximate the non-stationary characteristics of coastal water-quality via the event-triggered strategy on the spatio-temporal data. Finally, the experimental results show that the designed ET-DBN can adapt to the non-stationarity characteristics of coastal water-quality and achieve the accurate forecasting performance.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Charging Technology of Mobile Robots for Warehouse Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of autonomous charging for mobile robots in a warehousing environment. We propose an improved Dynamic Window Approach (DWA)-based path planning algorithm and integrate infrared positioning technology to achieve automatic alignment with charging stations. By optimizing the DWA algorithm, the robot can efficiently and safely plan charging paths in complex environments. The improved algorithm shows advancements in real-time performance, adaptability, and multi-objective optimization compared to traditional DWA algorithms. We then use infrared positioning technology combined with a PID algorithm for precise alignment between the robot and the charging station. Simulation and practical tests demonstrate that the proposed method effectively resolves path planning and automatic alignment issues in the autonomous charging process for mobile robots.

articleTitle: AKA-MobileNet: A Cloud-Noise-Robust lightweight Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of thin cloud interference of remote sensing images under hardware-constrained environments, this paper presents a new cloud-noise-robust lightweight convolution neural network model, AKA-MobileNet, based on MobileNetV3-small. The paper firstly proposes a new extract feature module. The new extract feature unit can notably improve the robustness of lightweight convolution neural network under thin cloud environment. The idea of AKConv (convolutional kernel with arbitrary sampled shapes and arbitrary number of parameters) enlightens us to construct a new unit named AKANet (The multi-scale feature composed of features extracted by AKConv). Then MobileNetV3-small is introduced as a background model to solve the problem of RS (remote sensing) to be obstructed by thin cloud. It makes our method to obtain higher efficiency compared other method. Finally, the model's efficiency and accuracy were evaluated using the RSSCN-cloud datasets. The experimental results demonstrate the cloud-noise-robust performance of our model in the thin cloud environment. Under thin cloud environment, the proposed AKC-MobileNet model surpasses classic model like AlexNet, VGG16, ResNet50, MobileNet series, ShuffleNet-v1 and Efficientnet-b3 in terms of runtime computational complexity, network’s parameters, and classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Sliding Mode Control for Unmanned Surface Vehicles with Input Saturation and Dead Zones
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive fuzzy sliding mode control (SMC) method is proposed for unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). The proposed controller can deal with the input constraints of USVs, including saturation and dead zones. All input constraints can be estimated using the fuzzy update mechanism. Specifically, an SMC strategy is designed to compensate for the inaccuracies in fuzzy approximation. The stability analysis is conducted to confirm that the tracking errors can converge within a confined range in a finite time. Simulation results are presented to validate the efficacy of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Distributed Event-Triggered Control for Single-Bus DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we have considered a DC microgrid with a sparse digital communication network, then by proposing a distributed event-triggered control strategy to realize voltage regulation and proportional current sharing in a DC microgrid. According to the designed control strategy, each distributed generator sends interaction information to its neighboring generators only when the triggering condition is satisfied. The regulation of voltage and proportional sharing of current can be achieved with the designed control strategy, which is analyzed via the Lyapunov stability method. The proposed control strategy is validated by a DC microgrid in the simulation.

articleTitle: Adaptive finite-time tracking control of quadrotor UAV subject to input saturation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a finite-time trajectory tracking control scheme is established for the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) under the co-existence of modeling uncertainty, external disturbance and input constraint. Firstly, a deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) based auxiliary part is established estimate and compensate the model uncertainty and external disturbance. Then, design the sliding surface with tracking error for the backstepping control procedure and use Lyapunov stability theory to solve the optimal control law. Besides, the control law has a hyperbolic tangent function form which can helps to handle the input constraint problem. Finally, validate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme through simulations.

articleTitle: Design of A Smart Safety Helmet Incorporating Observation, Communication and Localization Functions
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Currently, vessels traversing China’s inland waterways and open seas face obstacles due to restricted visibility resulting from foggy conditions and diminished sight during nighttime hours. Consequently, this study presents the design of an intelligent safety helmet equipped with observation, communication and localization functions. The system integrates microlight night vision devices with augmented reality technology to achieve high-definition visual imaging. Additionally, to enhance visual imaging quality in low visibility environments such as foggy, rainy, and snowy conditions, the system utilizes a convolutional neural network for image enhancement. The aforementioned aspects are able to augment seafarer’s observational acumen in foggy and nocturnal environments, consequently refining the efficacy of vessel ingress and egress at ports while concurrently bolstering navigational safety. The positioning and communication module is designed to meet the crew’s requirements for precise positioning and real-time communication. The overall system design incorporates lightweight, waterproof and dustproof materials, making it suitable for marine environments, offering high portability and user-friendliness, thus effectively ensuring the safety and operational efficiency of the crew.

articleTitle: Spatial domain identification based on variational autoencoder and single sample network
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Due to its ability to reveal tissue heterogeneity, spatial analytic transcriptomic data has been used to decipher the spatial domain of complex diseases for precise treatment. At present, the problems of high dimensional, sparse and noisy data in the application process are awaiting to be solved. However, it has not fully leveraged the intercellular molecular interactions, which affect the accuracy of spatial domain identification. In order to solve this problem, the stMVC model is improved by integrating the single sample network method and variational autoencoder, and the spatial domain(SDI-VASSN) is extracted from the transcriptome data of multimodal spatial decomposition. Specifically, the model uses multimodal data of the human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex obtained through 10X Genomics Visium technology. Firstly, from the samples, we used cell specific molecular interaction network (CSN) to calculate the gene interaction network of each cell and extract key genes; Then we encode key genes by one-hot coding; Finally, we use variational autoencoder (VAE) instead of autoencoder (AE) to maximize the probability of the input data to learn the probability distribution of the data, thus input the resulting data into the stMVC model for identifying the spatial domain.

articleTitle: Asynchronous memory sampled-data control of Markovian jump time-delay systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article is devoted to the asynchronous memory sampled-data control problem for Markovian jump time-delay systems. Since the plant mode is often unavailable in practice, the asynchronous phenomenon between system plant and sampled-data controller is taken into account and characterized by the hidden Markov model. Via employing a stochastic Lyapunov functional together with a looped functional, the sufficient criterion is obtained to guarantee that the underlying system is stochastically stable with asynchronous controller. Accordingly, a novel theorem is developed for the asynchronous memory sampled-data controller design of the Markovian jump system with time delay. Finally, some numerical simulations are provided to demonstrate the validity and advantages of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Dual Projection Synchronization of Hyperchaotic Complex Systems with Complex Variables
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Hyperchaotic complex systems are a type of dynamic system with complex variables. Compared with real-valued systems, the number of variables can be doubled, and they have the advantages of being more complex, higher-dimensional and more controllable. For such hyper-chaotic complex systems, a dual projective synchronization (DPS) scheme based on heterogeneous hyper-chaotic complex systems is proposed. First, a group of heterogeneous hyper-chaotic complex systems are selected, the real and imaginary parts of the state variables are separated, an equivalent system is obtained and analyzed by a mathematical model, and then the state variables are linearly coupled and used as a driving system; Then, combined with the idea of dual synchronization, a corresponding set of systems is selected, and its state variables are also linearly coupled as a response system. Lyapunov stability theory was used to design a DPS control scheme for heterogeneous hyperchaotic complex systems, and its rationality was proved mathematically. Finally, through numerical simulation, the efficiency and feasibility of the dual projection synchronization scheme were verified. It can provide new ideas and methods for the development of the field of chaos synchronization, and promote the application of chaotic systems in information transmission, encrypted communication and other fields.

articleTitle: Collision-Aware Navigation for Flapping-Wing Aerial Robots in Dense Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Executing flight missions in complex and unknown environments poses a significant challenge for visually limited Flapping Wing Micro Air Vehicles (FWMAVs). The difficulties are primarily manifested in two ways: Firstly, the dynamic constraints of the FWMAV impose curvature constraints on its flight trajectory. Secondly, perceiving obstacles and achieving obstacle avoidance under visually limited conditions is highly challenging. In this study, we initially introduce an enhanced version of the Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) algorithm. This refined approach to path planning significantly mitigates the jitter experienced during the trajectory tracking of FWMAVs. Subsequently, we present a novel re-planning strategy, which empowers the aircraft to autonomously navigate through complex and unknown environments, relying exclusively on touch sensors affixed to its wings, which has been verified through simulation. This strategy offers a viable alternative approach in scenarios where visual perception capabilities are constrained or limited.

articleTitle: A Branch and Bound Algorithm for Minimizing Total Tardiness of a Two-Stage Assembly Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Existing algorithms for the two-stage assembly scheduling problem (TASP) ignores the setup time and depends on four or more fine-tuned parameters. This work focuses on TASPs with separated setup time. There are multiple and one machine at stages one and two, respectively. A branch and bound algorithm which contains only one parameter is proposed to minimize the total tardiness of all jobs. In order to guide the search of the branch and bound algorithm, lower and upper bounds and dominance rules are proposed. Experimental results show that the proposed branch and bound algorithm outperforms the state-of-the-art method.

articleTitle: Quantized control for networked interval type-2 fuzzy semi-Markov jump systems with unreliable links
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This work is concerned with the observer-based quantized control for networked discrete interval type-2 fuzzy (IT2F) semi-Markov jump systems with unreliable links. In unreliable links, both packet loss and signal quantization are considered. Unlike traditional Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy model, nonlinear plant with parameter uncertainty is represented by IT2F model. Due to the difficulty of measuring actual system state, the observer-based measurement is adopted to estimate the system state. Based on the fuzzy model, the semi-Markov kernel (SMK) method, and the ST-dependent Lyapunov functions, some conditions for the existence of observer-based controller are constructed to ensure that the underlying system is σ-mean-square stable. Ultimately, the proposed method is validated by the single-link robot arm model.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of a Passive Shoulder-support Exoskeleton for Overhead Work
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Overhead work, commonly encountered in industrial scenarios, is recognized as a main contributor to work-related musculoskeletal disorders. Shoulder-support exoskeletons have the potential to provide assistance to workers and are usually passive for low cost and good wearability. However, current passive shoulder-support exoskeletons lack sufficient range of motion and assistive performance. Here, we developed a passive shoulder-support exoskeleton to assist the shoulder of workers during overhead work, containing the ergonomic shoulder structure and passive assistive mechanism. The former guarantees a sufficient range of motion in both sagittal and horizontal flexion/extension motion, and the latter leads to effective assistance. The performance of the proposed exoskeleton was evaluated through experiments of ten healthy individuals on the aspect of biological efforts. The results showed that the root mean square of the measured muscles was decreased (up to 49.6%), which indicates the proposed exoskeleton could reduce the risk of work-related musculoskeletal disorders. The proposed exoskeleton expects to compensate for shoulder gravity for workers, hence strengthening their physical health and enhancing work efficiency.

articleTitle: A linearization method for quadruped robots based on centroidal kinematics
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this article, for a three degree of freedom elbow quadruped robot, we first focus on linearizing the translational and rotational kinematic models of the quadruped robot, and retain more linearization terms to ensure the accuracy of the model. Furthermore, a model predictive controller is designed and the optimal ground reaction force of the supporting leg is solved using quadratic programming. Finally, simulations were designed for different gait types to verify the algorithm.

articleTitle: Displacement Profile Optimization of Free Piston Engine Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The free piston engine generator is a new type of power device. Compared with the traditional reciprocating internal combustion generator, it abandons the mechanical structure of the crank connecting rod. This difference in the mechanical structure between the two improves the freedom of piston movement. In actual applications, depending on load demand and operating conditions, the generator's output power may be adjusted to balance energy utilization and system stability. In view of this characteristic of the free-piston internal combustion generator, a piston displacement profile optimization method is proposed in this paper to maximize the average power. First, clarify the research objectives and constraints, and determine the variables and constraints that need to be optimized. Secondly, a mathematical model was established to describe the displacement and geometric relationship of the piston movement. Finally, a genetic algorithm was selected to find the optimal displacement profile, and compared with the average power of six typical displacement curves to verify the superiority of this method.

articleTitle: Data-Driven CACC of Vehicular Platoons Based on Adaptive Dynamic Programming with Initial Excitation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper studies the cooperative adaptive cruise control (CACC) problem for a platoon of vehicles with unknown system parameters. Data-based adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) method is adopted to solve the control gains of the vehicles from algebraic Ricatti equations by using online data. The ADP takes a two-layer filter structure, which only requires the initial excitation (IE) condition instead of the restricted persistent excitation (PE) condition when solving the iterative equation. Moreover, data-storage for integral computation is obviated compared with existing data-driven approaches. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on fault routing method of distribution network based on wavelet transform*
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To refine the accuracy of fault location in the case of single-phase ground faults in distribution networks, this research delves into the ephemeral part of the fault signal that arises from these faults, and forms a fault routing scheme based on the transient energy method and the great value detection method of wavelet transform. To enhance the distinction between the transient signatures of a faulted line and a healthy line in the aftermath of a ground fault, this study applies wavelet transform to dissect and then reassemble the zero-sequence current signals across every line, captures the high-frequency wavelet coefficients, and subsequently measures the energy across each high-frequency range and the eigenfrequency range, pinpointing the maximum energy and modal peak for every line. The detection of faulty lines is achieved by comparing the maximum energy of every line with the modal maximum to differentiate between faulty and sound lines.

articleTitle: Three-day and Twenty-day Compressive Strength Predictions of Cement Clinker Based on PSO-ELM
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Cement clinker has a lot of control indexes to pay attention to in the normal production process, among which, cement clinker strength is one of the important indexes. Cement clinker strength is usually divided into two aspects: flexural strength and compressive strength, of which 3-day and 28-day compressive strength are the most concerned indicators for cement plants. At present, the traditional methods of cement clinker strength prediction are mostly statistical analysis, multiple regression, etc. These traditional methods of predicting cement clinker strength have the problems of low precision, large error, and insufficiently comprehensive consideration of variables. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a PSO-ELM-based prediction model that can predict the 3-day and 28-day compressive strength of cement clinker more accurately, thus improving the accuracy of the prediction. At the same time, the model enables the operator to know the strength of the clinker of this batch in advance, which shortens the time of clinker quality determination, and plays a role in the improvement of cement clinker quality.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Prediction

articleTitle: Design, Fabrication and Analysis of a Inchworm-Inspired Soft Crwaling Robot Driven by Tensegrity
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Inspired by the characteristics of inchworms’ movement, a soft crawling robot with symmetrical annular scale pairs driven by tensegrity is proposed. Two ring-shaped scales that are made of different materials can be combined into an annular scale pair to produce high and low friction to mimic the bristles of the inchworms. The tensegrity is composed of the constringent spring embedded in silicone rubber as strut and the rope driven by the motor as cable. The tensegrity achieves reciprocating telescopic motion driven by the motor, which drives the annular scale pair to deform and form different angles between the scale pair and the contact surface. Due to the difference of friction coefficient between different materials and surface, the resultant force which is the low friction force from the high friction force drives the crawling robot to move in the intended direction, and the velocity of its motion is related to the difference of coefficient between different materials and surface. Besides, the electronic control system placed inside the soft body to realize fully untethered. The maximum crawling speed and crawling angle are 2.5 mm/s and 10°, respectively.

articleTitle: Delta Operator SMC of Three-level Inverter Based on Dynamic Reaching Law
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of system divergence in high-speed sampling of three-level inverter and ensuring the stability of the discrete system, a sliding mode controller based on dynamic reaching law via Delta operator discretization method for uncertain system is proposed. Firstly, Delta operator is used to discretize the three-electric plain continuous systems. Secondly, the improved Delta operator discrete reaching law based on arctangent function is used to replace the upper and lower bounds of the uncertain part of the system. Finally, the sliding mode control law of the three-level inverter is designed and the system’s stability is successfully demonstrated. The simulation results show that proposed Delta operator high-speed discretization is feasible in the three-level inverter sliding mode control system, and the discretized three-level inverter sliding mode control system is stable. The design method of Delta operator discrete reaching law control system improved by arctangent function is also correct, and it has good robustness to uncertain disturbance.

articleTitle: A Image steganography Technique based on Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Image steganography is the process of hiding secret information into an image while still keeping its original appearance intact. It plays a crucial role in secure communication and data storage. While deep learning-based techniques have shown notable progress in the field of image steganography, they still face challenges in extraction accuracy and robust security. This paper introduces an innovative image steganography method utilizing the diffusion model, which is the most powerful technique of image generation. Our method utilizes the sampling process of the diffusion model to hide the secret image in the generated image, and the receiver uses the secret key to extract the secret data accurately. The results of our experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, outperforming existing methods in security, capacity, and extraction precision, which shows the potential for practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Optimization Strategy of Integrated Energy System with Hydrogen-electric Coupling in Virtual Power Plant Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The reliability and economic operation of an integrated energy supply system in a virtual power plant environment are closely dependent on the operational strategy of renewable energy and energy storage systems. In this paper, we construct a framework for an integrated energy system at a substation within a virtual power plant environment. Utilizing wind and solar resources, as well as considering the characteristics of various energy storage technologies at the substation, we establish mathematical models for both the renewable energy system and the energy storage system using MATLAB, a commercial mathematical software.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Unmanned Health Monitoring System for Reciprocating Industrial Equipment Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Reciprocating industrial equipment is a crucial component of the industrial equipment, and unmanned health monitoring is the linchpin for ensuring its efficient operation. This paper proposes a digital twin unmanned health monitoring system for reciprocating industrial equipment utilizing deep learning for unmanned health monitoring. Initially, monitoring data are expanded through the integration of digital twin, simulation technology, and gradient penalized conditional wasserstein generative adversarial network. Subsequently, the accuracy of monitoring is enhanced by improving classification and regression trees, and unmanned monitoring is achieved by developing applications. Finally, the efficacy of the proposed method is corroborated using a reciprocating plunger experimental machine. The experimental results show that the digital twin model exhibits exceptional fidelity. Moreover, gradient penalized conditional wasserstein generative adversarial network learns the distribution of the simulated samples, thereby enhancing the robustness and the generalization ability of monitoring model while addressing the issue of limited or difficult to obtain field monitoring data. The improvement of the classification and regression trees led to a significant increase in the accuracy of the monitoring model. Furthermore, the mean square error and the mean absolute percentage error are reduced to some extent, which validates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: digital twin unmanned health monitoring system

articleTitle: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning-based Fault Classification for Industrial Processes with Small Sample
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the challenge of limited fault data in industrial production, this paper introduces a fault classification method based on model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML). This method synergizes the quick adaptability characteristic of MAML with the robust feature extraction capabilities of fully connected neural networks, targeting the intricate demands of feature extraction and modeling in classification tasks. MAML has attracted widespread attention in the field of machine learning due to its ability to rapidly adapt to novel tasks with a small amount of data. In this paper, we explore the application of MAML to classify industrial fault data, revealing that our approach can facilitate efficient and precise fault classification, even with extremely limited data samples. This research not only enhances the integration of MAML technology in the field of industrial fault detection but also provides a new perspective and solution for addressing similar issues of data scarcity.

articleTitle: A Novel Human Learning Optimization Algorithm Incorporating PSO
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the issues of slow astringent velocity and low optimization precision of Human Learning Optimization Algorithm (HLO), it is proposed to fuse the improved HLO algorithm with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to form Industrious Humans Learn Optimization Algorithms (IHLO). Firstly,the search performance of HLO is improved by using the particle update method in PSO for the update of the three operators of HLO; secondly, the probability of the parameters pr and pi is improved by adjusting their value changes to control the execution probability of each operator using nonlinear decreasing and nonlinear increasing respectively, which good improvement in algorithmic optimization seeking. Finally, the new optimization algorithm IHLO is compared with the HLO and the HLO-PSO . The experimental results show that IHLO significantly outperforms the HLO algorithm and HLO-PSO algorithm in both the speed of convergence and search precision.

articleTitle: D3QN-Based Online Sensor Scheduling for Remote State Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of remote state estimation in wireless sensor networks (WSNs), where the number of available wireless channels is often limited. We propose a novel sensor scheduling strategy using an improved Dueling Double Deep Q-Network (D3QN) algorithm to optimize transmission scheduling for enhanced estimation efficiency at a central gateway. By formulating the sensor scheduling issue as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), our improved D3QN algorithm, which enhances the traditional Deep Q-Network (DQN) framework for better decision-making efficiency, is applied to solve it. Comparative analysis with existing reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms demonstrates the superiority of our approach, as evidenced by simulation results showcasing improvements in estimation accuracy and network efficiency.

articleTitle: H∞ Filtering for Networked Systems: A Buffer-Aided Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper studies the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> filtering problem for networked systems. Bounded transmission intervals resulted from the limited network bandwidths are considered. To alleviate the effects of the transmission intervals on the filtering performance, a buffer-aided strategy is employed. By iterating the state equation, the state-space model is obtained at the transmission instants, and moreover, the measurements stored in the buffer can be processed simultaneously. The aim here is to design an H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> filter based on the obtained state-space model such that the filtering error is asymptotically stable and has the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance index. By a transmission-interval-dependent Lyapunov function, sufficient criteria are proposed to ensure the existence of the desired H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> filter parameter. A numerical example validates the the designed filter’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: SFM-GMDH: Sparse Feature Mapping GMDH Network for Time Series Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Time series prediction has become increasingly crucial in today’s big data context, providing a means to obtain future trends from historical observations. However, traditional time series prediction models are time-consuming and have many limitations when dealing with complex and large-scale datasets. These models often struggle to capture the potential deep correlations in the dataset, and their ability to accurately estimate future data is limited. In this context, the Group Method of Data Handling (GMDH) self-organizing network model has emerged. It effectively avoids the interference of personal subjective factors in the case of information explosion and incomplete information, and improves the accuracy of the model by continuously evolving to approximate polynomials. However, the independently applied GMDH network model has certain limitations when dealing with Chaotic time series datasets. To address this issue, this study introduces an innovative approach that combines sparse feature mapping module with GMDH in a network model. In this study, the input data is first processed by delay, and then represented the delayed sequence as random feature nodes through a random feature extractor. These random feature nodes were fed into the encoder network for encoding, in order to extract key features. Through the sparse representation of the generated vectors, the linear correlation between the newly generated feature nodes is effectively reduced. Finally, the sparse vector is fed into the GMDH network for more accurate prediction. To verify the superiority and robustness of the proposed network structure model, this study conducted extensive experiments using diverse time series datasets from the real world. The comparative experimental results show that the prediction model combining sparse feature mapping module and GMDH performs well in terms of performance and prediction error. This innovative method not only improves the predictive performance of the model, but also exhibits stronger adaptability and generalization when dealing with long time series data.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Delay/Disordering Attacks for Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the supervisory control layer of cyber-physical systems, attackers may introduce delays and disorder into the communication channel used for transmitting commands between the supervisor and the controlled system, thereby disrupting the order of command events. Building on this premise, this paper puts forth delay attack strategies and disordering attack strategies within a game-like command attack structure. Furthermore, we delineate the covert and race-free conditions that attackers must comply with. We discover that delay attacks can result in disordering effects, and then we also provide the necessary conditions for converting disordering attacks into delay attacks. Finally, we have obtained delay attackers and disordering attackers.

articleTitle: A novel defect localization method based on time reversal focusing method and Akaike information criterion with AE technique
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Pressure vessels play an important role in many fields such as critical assets evaluation in manufacturing, transportation and aerospace. In order to reduce the potential hazard caused by defects in vessels during operation, a fast and convenient defect localization method is needed. On the basis of acoustic emission (AE) technique, this paper proposed a novel defect localization method based on time reversal focusing method (TRFM) and Akaike information criterion (AIC). Compared with the time difference of arrival (TDOA) method, the time reversal focusing technology was proved to be superior in eliminating the pseudo defect locations and obtaining higher accuracy. Furthermore, the results were improved with a post-processing feature of the normalized AIC (NAIC), which is sensitive to the defect signal arrival and can be used to remove the artefacts. The localization experiments on a steel tank were implemented to testify the localized performance of the compared methods. Experimental tests clearly demonstrate that, the localization performance of time reversal focusing method is generally better than that of the TDOA method, in terms of localization accuracy and stability. In addition, the NAIC further helps to enhance the focusing effect of TRFM images on the defect signals and suppress the residual artefacts.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Graph Convolutional Neural Network for Marine Aquaculture Extraction Based on SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image segmentation is one of the hotspots in the field of remote sensing, and studying pixel level information and its relationships is of great significance. However, the coherent speckle noise and high sea state conditions caused by factors such as wind speed in SAR images pose challenges to feature extraction. Due to the fixed shape of convolutional kernels in convolutional neural networks (CNNs), it is difficult for the kernels to fully cover the marine aquaculture areas in SAR images. In this paper, we utilize the structural exploration and information propagation capabilities of graph convolutional networks (GCNs) between different pixels to complete this pixel-level task. In order to reduce the connection burden between different SAR pixels and the high computational cost of the entire SAR image, this the paper uses the superpixel segmentation method to segment SAR images, reducing the previously high pixel-level computational cost. However, modeling at a single scale can only extract a single feature. To break this limit and extract More representative of the characteristics, this paper proposes multi-level Superpixel structure diagram based on U-net combination GCN is used for SAR image semantic segmentation. In the meantime, The network constructs a new residual convolution attention Module (RCA). RCA modules include CNN and Beyond Self-attention. First, through CNN convolution, which provides a detailed initial space for the model Characteristic information; Then in Features to make it more accurate. This hybrid U-Net can be utilized The characteristics of SAR images are analyzed from multi-scale and hierarchical perspectives In perspective, its performance has been proven. Extensive experiments have been carried out on data sets of aquaculture methods such as floating rafts and cages in different areas. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified, and the Accuracy and other precision of the segmentation results are significantly improved, and the qualitative and quantitative performance of the proposed method is better than that of other advanced models.

articleTitle: Design of Terminal Sliding Mode Attack Guidance Law with Impact Angle Constraint
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at improving the control precision and stability of attack guidance control law against fixed targets and low-speed mobile targets. Combined with the sliding mode control theory, this paper first transforms the problem with angle of impact constraint into a sliding mode surface design problem with LOS angle and LOS rate as state space variables, and then carries out a joint design with the reaching law, and finally puts forward the terminal sliding mode attack guidance law. The stability and convergence of the guidance law are proved by the Lyapunov stability mathematical principle. The theoretical design and experimental data show that compared with the traditional guidance control law, the attack guidance law proposed in this paper can achieve good fall angle constraint and extremely high hit rate design, and have the advantages such as fast convergence and high robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Shellfish Text Entity Extraction Method Based on Pre-trained Models
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Shellfish text information has the problems of fuzzy entity boundaries and strong contextual semantic dependency, and a pre-trained model-based entity extraction method for shellfish text is proposed. The method adopts RoBERTa-wwm pre-trained language model for unsupervised pre-training, obtains word vectors with semantic information and inputs them into BiLSTM layer to further capture the semantic features of shellfish text; finally, the optimal label prediction is obtained by using CRF computation. By collecting shellfish-related raw corpus, preprocessing data and text annotation, a corpus for shellfish entity recognition is constructed, and comparison experiments are carried out based on this data. The experiments show that compared with BiLSTM and BiLSTM-CRF, etc., the proposed method can get the best comprehensive recognition effect, and the comprehensive F1 value is as high as 94.81%.

articleTitle: Herdability of signed networks based on leader role
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The paper investigates the herdability of signed networks from the perspective of leader role. First, we analyze the influence of interactions between leaders on the herdability of networks, which shows that the interactions between leaders do not influence the herdability of networks. Furthermore, we propose a necessary and sufficient condition for the herdability of the leader-composite networks, which indicates that the leader-composite network is herdable if and only if all disjoint subnetworks are herdable. In addition, we focus on the herdability of cycle networks, and give some leader selection methods to realize the herdability of cycle networks. The illustrative examples are provided to demonstrate the validity of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Collaborative design of transition rates and finite-time sliding mode controller against actuator saturation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper studies the collaborative design of the transition rates and sliding mode controllers for continuous-time Markovian jump systems under actuator saturation. Breaking through the assumption that the transition rates are priori, the stochastic finite-time boundedness of the unforced Markovian jump system is ensured by designing the transition rate matrix. Following that, a collaborative design strategy is presented for the transition rate matrix and sliding mode controller, establishing ample conditions to guarantee that the closed-loop system meets stochastic finite-time boundedness while approaching both the reaching and sliding motion phases concurrently. Furthermore, some examples are included to elucidate the provided transition rate design approach and collaborative design methodology.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Fault Detection for Nonlinear Delayed Systems With Deception Attacks Under Dynamic Event-Triggered Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper tackles the finite-time fault detection (FD) issue for a class of nonlinear systems with deception attacks and mixed time-delays including probability interval delays and distributed delays. For the purpose of alleviating the communication burden, a dynamic event-triggered mechanism (DETM) is introduced to arrange data transmission. The sufficient criteria are obtained to ensure that the FD system can achieve satisfactory performance. On this basis, the parameters of FD filter are obtained by the linear matrix inequality (LMI) method. At last, a simulation is provided to verify the effectiveness of proposed FD algorithm.

articleTitle: Switched Tracking Control for Unmanned Helicopter With Position Output Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, the switched tracking control scheme is investigated for the position loop of an unmanned helicopter (UH) with output constraints. To maintain the position within the restricted range, a switching trajectory boundary protection method is used to produce a constrained trajectory. Based on this, the error system can be represented as a switched system. The switching controllers and the switching rule are co-designed to guarantee the tracking performance. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Control performance monitoring of chemical industrial process based on model residual
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the increase in the scale of modern industry, control systems for chemical processes have become increasingly complex and intelligent, with more stringent requirements for control performance. This paper proposes a control performance monitoring method based on model residual for chemical process. First, the control performance index is constructed by canonical variable analysis. Then, the process model/disturbance monitoring index is proposed with the estimated disturbance innovation and the benchmark model residual. Next, in order to monitor the process-model mismatch, the process model monitoring index is defined using the ratio of the estimated actual disturbance innovation to the actual model residual. The disturbance monitoring index is proposed using the JS divergence of the actual model residual and the benchmark model residual, so as to detect the disturbance dynamics. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by Wood-Berry Distillation Column.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Control for Automotive Electronic Throttle based on Extremum Seeking
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the help of extremum seeking (ES), an improved adaptive sliding mode control (ES-ASMC) method is proposed to accomplish rapid and precise servo control of throttle angle. Some existing adaptive sliding mode control schemes applied to electronic throttle focus only on the switching gain, with limited attention to other parameters. While in the method presented in this study, all parameters of the sliding mode control (SMC) law are optimized simultaneously. An objective function is designed to measure the tracking error, which is subsequently reduced by ES with gradient descent to obtain a more favorable tracking response. In addition, a tracking differentiator is introduced to suppress the measurement noise of the output signal in place of the regular differentiator. Eventually, hardware experiments are conducted in an electronic throttle control (ETC) system to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Comparison with other solutions reveals the superiority of the ES-ASMC in terms of tracking accuracy and response speed.

articleTitle: Optimization strategy for inter station speed of fuel cell hybrid electric buses based on dedicated lanes
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative optimization strategy for the inter-station speed of fuel cell hybrid electric buses (FCHEBs) operating on dedicated lanes. The proposed method integrates real-time traffic light status and station location to optimize the speed of buses between stations. By harnessing advanced fuel cell technology combined with hybrid electric systems, this strategy aims to enhance the operational efficiency. Through a series of simulations and real-world trials, the paper demonstrates the efficacy of this optimization in streamlining bus operations, thereby contributing to a more sustainable and reliable urban transit system.

articleTitle: Online Identification Framework for AUV Based on PD-like Event-Triggered Mechanism and Data Filtering Window
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The development of the Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) has garnered significant attention. Establishing an accurate mathematical model is playing a crucial role in AUV control. In this paper, the least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) algorithm is applied to identify the vertical model of AUV for long-term operation. Additionally, a PD-like (proportional and derivative-like) event-triggered condition is proposed to determine the appropriate time of model updates. In addition, an online identification framework for AUV models is established by adopting a filtering window structure. The stochastic excitation experiments are conducted on simulated data to demonstrate that the proposed framework is highly adaptable and capable of maintaining a balance between model accuracy and computation time during long-term AUV operation.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Methods for Multibeam Sounding Line Layout
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The strategy of extensive ocean development in China is advancing, highlighting the demand for high-precision measurements in the surrounding marine areas. Submarine terrain measurement, as a fundamental surveying task, faces challenges in the accurate calculation of the overlap rate and coordinate width of survey lines. This paper proposes multi-beam bathymetric models based on plane geometry and solid geometry to address specific and general scenarios. For specific situations, the depth of seawater is calculated through the relationships of triangle edges and angles, while the sine theorem is applied to compute the coverage width and overlap rate. In general scenarios, the paper employs vector dot product operations and linear parameter equations to calculate the slope equation, survey line linear equations, and the linear equation of the outermost beam. The relationship between coverage width, distance from the sea center, and the angle between survey lines is then determined. The research findings indicate that variations in the angle between survey lines and the slope surface impact coverage width and overlap rate. This provides theoretical guidance for submarine terrain measurement, holding significant implications for the field of marine surveying and offering reliable support for marine resource development

articleTitle: Online Automatic Parameter Optimization of Marine Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Speed Controller Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: For the ship electric propulsion system, it is very important to maintain the stability of the speed. In this paper, the vector control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is introduced. At the same time, aiming at the shortcomings of traditional proportional integral (PI) control, such as sensitivity to motor parameters and insufficient control performance when the load torque fluctuation is relatively large, a speed control strategy based on Q-learning reinforcement learning theory is proposed, which replaces the manual debugging process with intelligent algorithm online debugging.

articleTitle: Intermittent Sampled-Data Synchronization for Space-Varying Reaction-Diffusion Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The present study investigates the intermittent sampled-data synchronization for a class of space-varying reaction-diffusion neural networks. In the proposed synchronization strategy, the intermittent sampled-data controller is activated only during the work time. We introduce a switching Lyapunov functional respectively related to the work and rest intervals, which is segmented, time-dependent, and continuous in time. By using Lyapunov stability theory, synchronization criterion is proposed to ensure the exponential stability of the synchronization error system. Futhermore control gain is determined, and obtained by solving a set of spatial linear matrix inequalities (SLMIs). Finally, a numerical example is presented to verify the feasibility of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Reshaping the Learning Behavior of College Students in the Context of High Quality Education
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the context of high-quality education development, it is particularly important to cultivate deep learning and higher-order thinking among students in order to improve their learning quality. The key to the effectiveness of high-quality education reform lies in the transformation of learning behavior. The article analyzes the current situation of learning behavior among college students through a questionnaire survey method, and based on this, constructs an equation model of learning quality and learning behavior structure. Research has shown that self-efficacy, learning attitude, and learning style have a significant enhancing effect on enhancing learning interest and improving learning behavior. Therefore, under high-quality education, efforts should be made to return to the original intention of educating students and cultivate their interest in learning, deep thinking, and independent learning abilities.

articleTitle: Distributed Event-Triggered Reactive Power Control for Islanded AC Microgrids with Quantization Information
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at reactive power sharing in islanded AC microgrid, this paper proposes a distributed secondary control strategy based on quantization transmission method and event-triggered communication. In this strategy, each distributed generator communicates with neighbors only when the triggering condition is met. At the same time, the transmission data is compressed by a uniform quantizer for the reduction of the amount of transmission data. Thus, the communication burden of the system is significantly reduced. Finally, the proposed control strategy is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Fault detection method of bearing structure based on singular spectrum analysis and SOM network
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The fault detection method of bearing structure is of great significance for timely detecting structural faults and ensuring the safe and stable operation of the structure. Fault detection can be seen as an unsupervised learning problem. Therefore, this paper proposes a fault detection method based on singular spectrum analysis and SOM unsupervised clustering. Firstly, Fourier transform is applied to the time domain signal of the bearing structure, and fault features are extracted by combining singular spectrum analysis. On this basis, the training and test samples are combined and substituted into the SOM network for unsupervised clustering. If the test sample is clustered with the training sample, it indicates that the test sample is a no faulty sample. If the test sample and training sample are not clustered together, it indicates that the test sample is a faulty sample. Finally, the proposed method was validated using a publicly available dataset of bearing structures. The results indicate that for 90 sets of test samples, the method correctly identified 88 groups. This paper provided a feasible method for fault detection method of bearing structure.

articleTitle: A Transformer-based Attention Network for Crack Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Pavement cracks have the characteristics of complex topological structure, uneven intensity and complex background. Therefore, accurate pavement crack detection is still a challenging problem for road maintenance. Since the rapid development of deep learning, detection methods based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) have achieved excellent results in crack detection tasks. However, the CNN-based model does not fully grasp the global information. Global information is crucial for accurate detection results. Transformer is powerful at capturing global information. Therefore, this paper fuses the CNN and Transformer framework to present an accurate crack detection model. To enhance the representation ability of the Transformer for global features, based on the improved self-attention mechanism, an enhanced Transformer unit is proposed. Meanwhile, an axis orientation attention module (AOAM) is proposed to optimize the extracted features at the encoder side, which realizes attention along both height and width directions through the self-attention mechanism. Experiments show that proposed model achieves an excellent results on two publicly available crack datasets.

articleTitle: Boundary control of a telescopic beam with elastic joints
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, an investigation is conducted on a beam system with elastic joints and a retractable configuration. Building upon the dynamics of the beam system, the dynamic characteristics of the retractable interface are comprehensively analyzed. The mathematical model of the system is established using the Hamiltonian principle. Subsequently, a boundary control stabilization system is designed based on the Lyapunov stability analysis theory. Finally, the designed controller’s effectiveness and the system’s ultimate stable state are validated through numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Distributed Extended State Observer-based Control for DC Microgrids With Cyber Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the stability of islanded DC microgrids under false data injection (FDI) attacks. A distributed resilient control method based on distributed extended state observer (DESO) is proposed to achieve the control objectives of current sharing and voltage balance in DC microgrids. The designed control strategy reconstructs the attack values based on the residuals between the observed state of the DESO and the actual output state, which offsets the effect of FDI attacks. The DESO-based control method does not require the location or information of FDI attacks. Finally, simulation results of DC microgrids with four distributed generation units (DGUs) are given in this paper to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Radiated Emission and Radiated Susceptibility of Shielded Twisted-pair Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The cable on missile used for energy transfer and information exchange is the nerve center of missile's devices. Due to the good anti-common interference capability, the shielded twisted structure is widely used by differential signal lines. Taking shielded twisted cable as the research object, the paper studies the radiated emission(RE) and radiated susceptibility(RS) from the perspective of field and circuit respectively. The simulation model was created by the finite element method in the first half of the article, threedimensional electromagnetic field distribution around the shielded twisted-pair cable was revealed, the relationship between shielding effectiveness, material and frequency was also analyzed. In the second half of the paper, the RS under 50kV/m electromagnetic pulse(EMP) interference of different kinds of cables was studied, the results show that shielded twisted-pair cable has a stronger ability to resist radiation interference than unshielded twisted-pair cable.

articleTitle: Distributed sliding mode control strategy for microgrids based on finite time consistency
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Microgrids are essential elements within the burgeoning energy Internet infrastructure. The synergy of communication networks and control systems facilitates the development of intricate microgrid management strategies; however, this integration also opens the door to various forms of interference. Moreover, inadequate primary control can lead to discrepancies between the actual frequency and voltage of the microgrid and their desired reference values, as well as imprecise distribution of active and reactive power. To tackle these challenges, an integral sliding mode-based quadratic control strategy is proposed. This tactic utilizes sparse communication with neighboring distributed power sources, thereby streamlining the complex communication network structure. It diminishes deviations caused by individual controls and counteracts the system's disturbance effects. Simultaneously, a finite-time consensus protocol is incorporated with the integral sliding mode control, which not only accelerates the convergence rate but also augments the overall convergence efficacy. The stability of the suggested control mechanism is substantiated through analytical proof, and its practicality is confirmed via simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Cooperative Encirclement and Capture of a Target with Cyber-Attack Capabilities by Multiple UAVs
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of securing a nonlinear Multiple unmanned aerial vehicle (multi-UAV) system against cyber-attacks, specifically with respect to time-varying formation (TVF) enforcement for an unknown input target. The cyber-attack considered is an unknown false data injection and replay attack at the sensor-controller section. To address this problem, a fully distributed adaptive predictive extended state observer (APESO) has been designed. The article introduces an analysis of the Lyapunov-Krasinski generalized functions framework. It provides sufficient conditions for the asymptotic convergence of the error and demonstrates that the proposed formation controller can form the desired time-varying formations while guaranteeing the specified performance. A series of experiments were conducted on a virtual simulation platform to test the proposed control method for multi-UAV formation target rounding. The study confirmed that the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) can successfully track the encircled target even when subjected to cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: Quality-related fault detection for dynamic process based on quality-driven LSTM and autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Fault detection always plays an important role in industrial dynamic processes since it can avoid production loss in time. However, since industrial dynamic process becomes more and more coupled and complex, which brings uneven dynamics hidden in collected data, extracting dynamic features effectively faces lots of challenges. In addition, it is a tricky business to distinguish whether the fault that occurs is quality-related or not, resulting in unnecessary repairing and large losses. In order to deal with these issues, this paper comes up with a novel fault detection method based on quality-driven long short-term memory and autoencoder (QLSTM-AE). Specifically, LSTM network is first used to extract dynamic features, and quality variables are embedded in parallel to learn the quality-related features. Then, a fault detection strategy based on reconstruction error statistic SPE and the quality monitoring statistic H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is designed, which can distinguish various types of faults to realize accurate monitoring for dynamic processes. Finally, Tennessee Eastman (TE) benchmark process demonstrate the reliability and effectiveness of the proposed novel method, which indicates it has higher accuracy and can separate different faults efficiently compared to some state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Control for Networked Control Systems under Denial-of-Service Attack
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the networked control systems controller design and synthesis under the denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. The denial of service attack will affect the communication and security performance of the system in the networked control system. In order to ensure the robustness of the system, a relative event-triggered mechanism is proposed, which is applied to the networked control system combined with the observer. Combined with the observer, it is applied to the networked control system, which can alleviate the communication pressure. In this paper, an observer-based control law is designed for the case where the system state is not completely known, the system can also have stable performance under the denial of service attack. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method in responding to and eliminating denial of service attacks, is verified by an example of an Internet-based testbed system.

articleTitle: Sampled-Data H∞ Control of Semilinear Fractional Reaction Diffusion Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this work, we think about the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control problem for a class of semilinear fractional-order reaction-diffusion system. For such system, the static feedback controller is designed with spatially sampled-data and continuous in time. Here we suppose that the sampled-in-space intervals are bounded, under point measurements (PMs), by using the fractional Lyapunov method, we have designed an H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller based on sampled-data such that the designed controller reduces the impact of the external disturbance on the system.
