articleTitle: Enhancing Yaw Tracking Stability in 4WS Vehicles: An Output Redefinition Approach to Overcoming Nonminimum-Phase Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to addressing nonminimum-phase in yaw tracking control for four-wheel-steering (4WS) vehicles, focusing on conditions of tyre force saturation. We propose redefining the control system’s output to include both yaw rate and lateral velocity, facilitating the use of a straightforward Proportional-Integral (PI) controller. This method effectively transforms the nonminimum-phase issue into a minimum-phase problem, simplifying the control strategy while ensuring enhanced stability and safety. Theoretical analysis and simulation results validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating significant improvements in system performance under challenging driving scenarios. This study contributes to advancing vehicle control systems, with implications for improved vehicle safety and handling performance.

articleTitle: Chattering-Free Fractional-Order Terminal Sliding Mode Control of High-Branch Pruning Manipulator Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The positioning process of the high-branch pruning manipulator is prone to vibration. Aiming at the above jitter problem, this paper proposes a chattering-free fractional-order terminal sliding mode control strategy based on neural network. Neural network control can reduce the gain of the switch and further reduce chattering. The singularity problem is solved by not differentiating the exponential term. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can better eliminate the chattering and is more stable than the existing control strategy.

articleTitle: Distributed Adaptive Output Feedback Control of General Linear Multi-Agent Systems with Switching Topology
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the leader-follower tracking control of heterogeneous multi-agent systems (MASs) with unknown switching topology. We put forward a distributed adaptive output feedback controller by using followers’ outputs and the state of neighbor leader. The sufficient condition is derived to ensure the closed-loop MASs internally stable with an L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> performance, by linear matrix inequalities (LMIs), without knowing the Laplacian matrix associated with the switching graph. Eventually, the effectiveness of the design methods is verified through simulation examples.

articleTitle: Bionic Binaural Sound Localization Circuit Design Based On Memristor
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We discuss a bionic binaural sound localization circuit based on memristors for a static monophonic source of low-frequency binaural cues in this paper, which is inspired by the principles governing sound localization in mammalian auditory systems. The study introduces a sound location model and a memristor model, summarizes the design of location angle and distance estimation in the bionic location circuit, and analyzes the simulation experiment and results. The overall circuit adopts a three-level layering design, improving accuracy for a large amount without a significant increase in area. Compared to existing sound localization technology, it utilizes memristors as basic units with reduced circuit energy consumption due to minimal calculations.

articleTitle: DTNET: Toward A Digital-Twin Computer Networks Education
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Computer networks is an important subfield under the discipline of computer science. Due to the inherent abstraction and difficulty of computer networks, in addition to theories classroom teaching, educators often deepen students' understanding by giving them hands-on practice. However, the current ways of practicing are too expensive or too abstract. To tackle this problem, this paper proposes DTnet, a computer networks education software platform that leverages digital-twin technology to give educators a cheaper and more vivid choice. DTnet creates the digital twin of computer networks, allowing students to step into the digital world of computer networks and better appreciate the knowledge. From a technical perspective, DTnet utilizes Unity technology to build 3D scenes of computer networks in schools, enterprises, etc., allowing students to interact and operate with the 3D network devices. From a pedagogical perspective, we design a series of DTnet-based experiments to teach students basic to advanced computer networks knowledge, including an experiment that utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to solve a traditional network problem. We also discuss the potential of DTnet to promote global cooperation in computer networks education. So far, DTnet has trained 259 students. DTnet's achievements in the field of pedagogy were awarded by the provincial government and the National Institute of Communications.

articleTitle: State of charge estimation of vehicle lithium-ion battery based on unscented Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Accurate estimation of battery state of charge (SOC) is an important safety guarantee during battery charging and discharging. Aiming at the estimation of SOC of lithium-ion battery, the hybrid pulse power characteristic experiment (HPPC) and dynamic stress experiment (DST) are designed. Firstly, A straightforward Thevenin model was selected as an equivalent circuit model(ECM), and a genetic algorithm(GA) was utilised to ascertain the parameters of this model. Secondly, estimation of battery SOC is done using Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) and Unsigned Kalman Filter (UKF). Finally, the effectiveness of EKF and UKF algorithms is verified in dynamic stress test at varying temperatures. The results demonstrate that UKF algorithm exhibits higher accuracy than EKF algorithm, and its estimation error can be maintained at a level of 1.25%.

articleTitle: Higher order Boolean networks under state-flipped control
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper devotes to trajectories analysis of the higher order Boolean networks with state-flipped control applied by some matrix approach. First, the theory of the new control method, called state-flipped, is applied in higher order Boolean models. Second, the trajectories study of the given higher order Boolean networks under the flip control is work out. Finally, a simple example under the control is given to support the proposed results.

articleTitle: LVRT Control Strategy for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverter Based on Improved Virtual Impedance
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The traditional LVRT control strategy does not consider the poor dynamic performance of the system and the increase of current harmonics during the grid fault. Therefore, in order to suppress the grid-connected current harmonics caused by grid voltage disturbance and improve the dynamic performance of the system, this paper studies an improved virtual impedance low voltage ride-through control strategy, which replaces the parasitic resistance on the traditional LCL filter by replacing the virtual impedance, and feeds back the real-time values of capacitance current and inverter current to the control loop through feedforward and feedback respectively, and autonomously adjusts the equivalent damping, so as to suppress the current harmonics during the grid fault and improve the dynamic performance of the system on the basis of cost saving.

articleTitle: Design of a follower positioning system for confined spaces
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The indoor positioning technology for confined spaces operation is widely used in the field of petroleum and petrochemical safety. Aiming at the problems of complex positioning systems and significant measurement error, a set of high-precision confined spaces follower positioning systems based on Ultra-wideband technology is designed to set up four fixed base stations and follower target sub-stations within the confined spaces, and the four-point localisation method of three-dimensional space is applied to improve the Chan algorithm and carry out the simulation and analysis, to determine the accuracy of the algorithm. The man-machine interface software is prepared, the improved Chan algorithm is used for a fast solution, the indoor positioning test is completed, and the three-dimensional positioning data of the follower substations are obtained. The accuracy of the positioning error is within 250mm, which can satisfy the design requirements. The scheme and algorithms of the system can provide references for the research on positioning in confined spaces.

articleTitle: Automotive Seat Surface Defect Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A method for detecting surface defects of car seats based on improved YOLOv5 is proposed to address the current issues of low efficiency, high missed detection rate, and difficult cost control in manual inspection of surface defects of car seats. In addition, in order to solve the imbalance problem of various defect images collected by industrial cameras, the methods of translation, cropping and adding noise are used to pre-enhance the images. Train the manually annotated dataset using an improved Yolov5 model, which uses K-means++ clustering anchor boxes to enhance adaptability to the dataset in this paper. At the same time, add a BiFormer module to the network to reduce the loss of small target defects and enhance the network’s feature fusion and extraction capabilities. The experimental results show that the mAP of the whole is increased from 67.1% to 78.2%, and the model can meet the requirements of the identification of car seat surface defects.

articleTitle: RRUCN: A Novel CSP-Dense Network with Spectral and Spatial Residual Reconstruction Units for Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, hyperspectral image (HSI) classification models based on convolutional neural networks have developed rapidly due to their superiority, among which densely connected networks based on spectral-spatial dual branches are more popular. However, this type of network does not fully extract spectral and spatial features, and there is large parameter redundancy, which affects classification performance. In response to this, a novel CSP-Dense network (RRUCN) with spectral and spatial residual reconstruction units for hyperspectral image (HSI) classification is proposed in this paper. The network is mainly composed of two parts spectral branch and spatial branch. (ach branch contains a CSP-Dense block and a residual reconstruction unit (RRU). The CSP-Dense block is used to lightweight and efficiently extract HSI feature information, while the RRU is used to reconstruct feature maps to enrich feature extraction capabilities. A series of comparative experiments and ablation experiments on the Indian Pines (IP) and Pavia 8niversity (8P) datasets show that the performance of RRUCN is better than the current mainstream related algorithms, and the combination of the modle’s blocks in RRUCN achieves the best effects.

articleTitle: Analysis of working characteristics of five-cylinder reciprocating pump based on digital twin and development of monitoring platform
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Water injection development is the main development mode of Shengli Oilfield. Reciprocating pump is the key equipment to increase injection pressure, but there are problems such as pump valve damage, plunger wear and so on. Aimed at the problem of stopping the reciprocating pump for maintenance due to the sudden failure of the pump due to the failure to effectively monitor the operating conditions of the pump, according to the design parameters of the on-site five cylinder single acting reciprocating pump, the How and pressure mathematical models were established through MATLAB analysis software and the accuracy verification was completed; The unit real-time content development platform software is used to establish the dynamic 3D model of the reciprocating pump, and the virtual entity model of the water injection pump is created in a digital way, so as to develop a reciprocating pump status monitoring platform based on the digital twin technology; Through the simulation operation of the digital twin of the reciprocating pump, combined with the actual common faults, the pressure and How data under the fault condition are obtained, the actual and theoretical working flow pressure data of the reciprocating pump are analyzed, the monitoring of the operating condition of the reciprocating pump is realized, and the whole life cycle process of the simulation and prediction of the pump unit is realized. The research content is of great significance to ensure the long-term, safe, efficient and stable production of oilfield water injection system, reduce maintenance costs and improve economic benefits of oilfield development.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fault-tolerant Cooperative Guidance Law under Actuator Fault
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper studies the time-varying line-of-sight (LOS) formation tracking guidance problem for the multi-missile system under the actuator fault. Firstly, a two-dimensional guidance model is established and an actuator fault model is expressed. Secondly, an adaptive fault-tolerant cooperative guidance law based on consistency theory is designed to deal with the unknown actuator fault, the nonlinear part of the system and the leader’s input. Thirdly, by using the Lyapunov theory, it is proved that the error of the follower’s LOS formation tracking guidance is semi-globally uniformly bounded. Finally, a numerical simulation verifies the effectiveness of the adaptive fault-tolerant cooperative guidance law.

articleTitle: Global Asymptotic Synchronization of Coupled Neural Networks with Reaction Diffusions and Unbounded Time-varying Delays
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article investigates global asymptotic synchronization of coupled neural networks with reaction diffusions and unbounded time-varying delays (RDUDCNNs). Through designing a centralized adaptive controller and corresponding updating laws of time-varying control gains, under two different upper bound of control gains, an asymptotic convergence lemma under unbounded time-varying delays and the Barbarat lemma are used to derive global asymptotic synchronization of RDUDCNNs, respectively. The effectiveness of the obtained conclusion is verified through a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Secure Control for Switched Positive Systems Against False Data Injection Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, based on the average dwell time (ADT) switching policy, the issue of secure control, for discrete-time switched positive systems, is studied under false data injection (FDI) attacks. Attacks are considered as a unforeseen behavior that occur randomly through network communication, and can be appropriately characterized by Bernoulli random variables. Feedback controllers are developed for individual subsystems, a suitable copositive Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) is built, and the stochastic stability criterion of switched positive delayed systems under FDI attacks is also established. Eventually, an academic example is provided to confirm the efficacy of the suggested scheme.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Storage Wind Power Fluctuation Smoothing Strategy Based on Improved Beluga Whale Optimization with Kalman Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of large-scale wind power grid integration affecting the overall safe operation of the power grid due to the fluctuation of wind energy with the seasons and day and night, a hydrogen storage wind power fluctuation smoothing method integrating the improved beluga whale optimization(IBWO) and Kalman filtering is proposed. The control method proposed in this paper combines China's relevant requirements for wind power with the objective of minimizing wind abandonment and optimizing the overall economy to achieve the distribution of wind power grid-connected power and hydrogen production power, which can effectively make up for the grid- connected fluctuation disadvantage of wind energy.

articleTitle: An improved sensorless control strategy for five phase permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach to low-speed, sensorless control for five-phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSMs). Departing from conventional techniques that typically involve the injection of rotating or pulsed high-frequency signals into the motor’s stationary coordinate system, this strategy leverages the analysis of the induced carrier current to deduce the rotor’s position. The paper focuses on refining the precision of signal processing and position estimation to enhance accuracy, the paper detailed the design process of the filter and adopted a phase-locked loop similar to a simplified Kalman filter to obtain the final rotor position estimation value. Through simulation verification, the proposed method demonstrates fast and accurate position information acquisition ability at low speeds, while maintaining good system stability and dynamic characteristics. This improved control strategy provides a new solution for optimizing the performance of five phase permanent magnet synchronous motors during sensorless low-speed operation.

articleTitle: A way to detect residents’ throwing behavior base on AI
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to publish refuse classification, "Throwing garbage at a fixed time and fixed location" has been published. Big amount of money and workload have been required because it needs a supervisor. This essay proposes a way to detect residence’s throwing based on machine vision technology. This way not only replace human by AI but also can collect big data about residence’s throwing behaviour,

articleTitle: Adaptive Time-Varying Displacement Constraint Control for Active Suspension Systems with Dynamic Event-Triggered Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper gives a dynamic event-triggered control (ETC) algorithm for nonlinear active suspension systems(ASSs) with time-varying displacement constraints. An adaptive controller and adaptive law are designed. A time-varying displacement constrained control scheme is proposed according to Barrier Lyapunov function, which uses the backstepping technique to stabilize vehicle attitude and improve passenger comfort. On this basis, an adaptive controller design approach based on neural networks is proposed in this paper in the presence of modeling errors and unknown masses, which not only ensures driving safety and handling stability, but also improves vehicle ride comfort. Through a series of simulation experiments, we have obtained remarkable results, which fully demonstrate the significantly higher time response efficiency of our method in response to steady displacements, thus validating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Consensus Control for Multi-Agent Systems Based on Distributed Unknown Input Observers
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A novel integrated approach for distributed entire state estimation and consensus control based on distributed unknown input observers is introduced for multi-agent systems under strongly connected graphs. By utilizing local output information, the distributed output estimation algorithm is devised to estimate the all agents’ output, and then the state estimation is achieved by constructing the distributed unknown input observers. Furthermore, the control law based on the entire state estimation is proposed to realize consensus for the multi-agent systems. The main feature of the proposed algorithm is its capability of addressing the issue of sensor failures. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated through both theoretical analysis and simulations.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Model for Accessory Gearbox Based on Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The accessory gearbox, as a critical component determining the performance of aircraft engines, directly influences the safety and reliability of the engine. However, in practical operation, the limited number of available fault samples due to changes in working conditions results in a small sample problem. This small sample issue can lead to underfitting of deep learning models. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a deep transfer learning approach based on the DenseNet-121 network for fault diagnosis. Experimental validation shows that with the application of transfer learning, the model achieves an accuracy of over 90% in identifying faults under different load conditions and speed conditions in small sample data. This method effectively enhances the accuracy and efficiency of fault diagnosis, providing a new perspective for addressing the small sample fault diagnosis problem in the accessory gearbox of aircraft engines under different conditions.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation of Ultra-high-resolution Remote Sensing Images Based on Global-local Branch Asynchronous Feature Interaction Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, semantic segmentation of ultra-high-resolution remote sensing images (UHRRSI) has made certain progress. UHRRSI are characterized by large spatial resolution. Using the entire UHRRSI for model training will make the computational cost almost unaffordable. Common processing methods are to downsample or crop UHRRSI. However, both methods have their own shortcomings. The downsampling operation may destroy the details of the image, and the cropping operation may damage important contextual information. Therefore, this paper proposes a structure based on global-local branch asynchronous feature interaction. The global branch is used to process the downsampled images, while the local branch focuses on processing the cropped images. During the decoding stage, the decoding features of the two branches are asynchronously interacted. In comparative experiments conducted using the Potsdam and Vaihingen datasets, our model exhibits excellent results in semantic segmentation performance.

articleTitle: Predictive Path Planning Strategy for Multi-UAV Systems against Covert Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This study introduces a predictive path planning framework for controlling multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) to follow their formation reference trajectories with minimized tracking and formation errors against covert attacks. Utilizing the leader-follower formation control strategy and the model predictive control (MPC) approach, it proposes predictive attack and defense strategies in the single neighbour and the double neighbours scenarios for a UAV swarm outfitted with the Ultra-Wideband (UWB) and GPS sensors. The covert attacker manipulates GPS data, which is undetectable by the UWB sensor, to maximize the formation error and the deviation between the attacked path and reference path, while the defender aims to reduce the bad effects on the UAV flight. The paper presents two algorithms for real-time optimization of attack and defense strategies and employs the Euler method for discretization.

articleTitle: Active disturbance rejection controller design in droop control framework for aviation hybrid propulsion systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: It is well-known that the decentralized control has the characteristics of plug and play in direct current grid energy management for aviation hybrid propulsion systems. The droop control is a kind of the decentralized control. When the battery or generator is on/off grid, there exists fluctuation of dc bus voltage in the framework of droop control. This paper presents a secondary voltage controller to mitigate the fluctuation of the voltage of direct current bus. The active disturbance rejection control algorithm can make the secondary voltage controller get better control performance than proportional integral control algorithm, which has been verified by the simulation results in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Prescribed-time input-to-state stability of infinite-dimensional systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We address the notion of prescribed-time input-to-state stability (PTISS) for infinite-dimensional systems (InFDSs). We prove a PTISS Lyapunov theorem, which indicates that if the system admits a PTISS Lyapunov functional (PTISS-LF) then it is PTISS. In addition, we provide a sufficient condition for ensuring the existence of a PTISS-LF for certain InFDSs under the framework of Hilbert spaces. As an example, we verify the PTISS property of parabolic equations with in-domain disturbances and conduct numerical simulations to illustrate the obtained result.

articleTitle: AGV Path Planning: An Improved A* Algorithm Based on Bézier Curve Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To solve the problem of unstable speed and easy collision with obstacles caused by too many turning points in the path planning of AGV (automated guided vehicle), this article proposes an improved A* algorithm based on 5-search neighborhood combined with Bézier curve. The main improvements are as follows: 1. the search neighborhood of the A* algorithm is improved to be a 5-search neighborhood; 2. the heuristic function of the A-star algorithm is improved; and 3. the obtained paths are smoothed by using Bézier curves. Simulation experiments were conducted on the improved algorithm, and the results showed that the improved A* algorithm could complete path planning tasks for different maps and obstacle layouts, bypass the fixed obstacles to reach the target point smoothly, and possess the ability to smooth the path, which verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Application realization of 3D virtual motors and virtual experiments
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to better combine the motor virtual experiment with 3D mode, this paper designs a 3D virtual motor experiment system. Through model construction, 3D scene construction, functional blueprint design, H5 framework construction, and server configuration, 3D virtual motor experiments are finally realized. In this paper, the experimental equipment and scene model are constructed through the MAYA software, the material properties of the model are designed, the virtual experimental scene and the experimental equipment are built, and the 3D structure surface of the model is UV unfolded. Using the C++ blueprint, the interactive program of the related model was written, and the related functions of the experiment and the logical structure of the judgment were designed and realized. Use the Canvas tag to build an HTML5 webpage based on pixel streaming, complete the loading in the HTML5 webpage to achieve access to 3D virtual experiments, configure a Huawei cloud server, load the designed webpage on the Huawei cloud server, and enter the IP can access the corresponding 3D virtual experiment content.

articleTitle: Low-Rank Matrix Aided Texture Occlusion Automatic Segmentation of Building Facades
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Limited by flight height and scanning angle, the building façade texture is inevitably obscured resulting in missing unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) data. However, the current segmentation methods have the problem that the target is fixed or requires manual interaction. Therefore, this paper proposes an automatic segmentation method based on low-rank matrix decomposition for facade texture, starting from the low-rank nature of building facade images. Firstly, matrix decomposition is utilized to complete the coarse extraction of the sparse occlusion of the façade texture; then the sparse breakage obtained from decomposition is subjected to image processing such as thresholding segmentation, dilatation, and filling. The result shows that: Our segmentation is as good as the manual marking, achieving the automatic extraction of the occluded façade.

articleTitle: Analytical Model for Pressure Sensing with Capacitive Micromachined Ultrasonic Transducer
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Capacitive micromachined ultrasonic transducer (CMUT) is a proven physical sensor for its high sensitivity, low power consumption, and ease of integration with CMOS circuits. This paper explores the potential of CMUTs in pressure sensing. Through electromechanical coupling analysis, we established a analytical model to describe the frequency response under the combined loadings of pressure and electrostatic force. The CMUT exhibited high linearity, and the analyzed pressure sensitivity was as high as 4.06Hz/Pa, the accuracy of which was examined by finite element simulation. The maximum deviation of the two simulations was 0.7%, verifying the effectiveness of the analytical model.

articleTitle: Integrated production and maintenance planning for closed-loop manufacturing assembly system with deteriorating machines
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper presents an optimal integrated production and maintenance planning for a closed-loop manufacturing assembly network model. This study aims to design a production and maintenance model and reduce the total objective cost. The network model is subjected to machines with failure rate. Without maintenance strategies, failure rate is fluctuated with the deterioration of machines. The implementation of preventive maintenance in the manufacturing process can reduce the defective rate of the items, prevent the sudden breakdown of the machines, and play a very important role in the production of the product and the safe operation. By calculating the proposed model, we can cut down the cost of the closed-loop manufacturing network by 4.37%. The numerical results highlight the availability of the method. The proposed model reduces the total cost and ensures the efficient and safe operation of the manufacturing process.

articleTitle: An Improved Semi-Stochastic Filtering Approach for Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Stochastic Degrading Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Affected by the interaction between internal and external factors during lifetime, industrial systems always suffer from inevitable performance degradation, resulting in unexpected shutdown, extra risks, and increment in operating costs. Recognized as the key technology of prognostics and system health management(PHM), remaining useful life (RUL) prediction has been drawn attentions from both scholars and engineers in recently years. Among the various RUL prediction approaches, the semi-stochastic filtering based methods have established a simple and direct prognosis framework, integrating both the historical life-cycle condition monitoring (CM) data from similar systems and the online CM data from the specific concerned inservice system. However, the implementation of semi-stochastic filtering approach for RUL prediction premises the conditional distribution of CM data given the RUL of the system, which is quite challenging to construct by the exiting experiential methods. Besides, from the point of control theory, the semi-stochastic filtering approach is a state observer without the feedback item, which may influence the accuracy, convergency, and robustness of the predicted RULs. Therefore, this paper attempts to improve the performance of semi-stochastic filtering approach for RUL prediction through two aspects. On the one hand, a nonlinear diffusion process has been introduced to obtain the conditional distribution of CM data given RUL of the system, which enhances the flexibility and accuracy concurrently. On the other hand, a feedback item has been added to the state function, which increases the convergency rate and guarantees the asymptotic accuracy of the predicted RUL. The proposed improved semi-stochastic filtering approach for RUL prediction has been demonstrated and validated by a case study on the CM data of button cells.

articleTitle: Extended Information Filter Based on Maximum Correntropy Criterion with Student’s t Kernel Function
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of information filtering for nonlinear systems with Student’s t noise interference. In the information filter framework, a new non-Gaussian extended information filter is developed under the MC criterion with Student’s t kernel function (TMCEIF). Firstly, the maximum correntropy (MC) filtering performance criterion with Student’s t kernel function (StKF) is defined. By comparing the Gaussian kernel function and adjusting the kernel bandwidth of the StKF, the StKF decays to zero more slowly for the large error, when the freedom degrees are small. Secondly, the MC criterion with the StKF is applied to design the new extended information filter (EIF). The robustness of the algorithm is verified by the final numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Fixed-time synchronization of complex networks with time-varying delays base on sliding mode controller
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A new sliding mode control strategy is offered for achieving fixed-time synchronization in complex networks that incorporate time delays. A new sliding mode controller is offered, and its effectiveness in achieving synchronization is demonstrated using Lyapunov stability theory. This approach ensures synchronization throughout both the sliding phase and the arrival phase. Lastly, a numerical example is offered to substantiate the utility of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Improved lightweight flame smoke detection algorithm for YOLOv8n
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the problems of untimely early fire detection and early warning and low precision, target detection of early small flames with leakage, and large number of model parameters, a lightweight flame smoke detection algorithm is proposed to improve the You Only Look Once version 8 (YOLOv8) method. In terms of network structure, first, the bottleneck in the Context module to fuse features (C2f) module of YOLOv8 is replaced by FasterNetBlock in FasterNet in the backbone network to make the network lightweight and reduce the number of parameters of the network model; second, the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is introduced so that the network can improve the ability to extract features from the channel and the space to avoid the problems caused by the lightweighting of the network model. To enhance the detection of small targets, a new small target detection header with an output size of 160 × 160 pixels is added, which is generated by the first C2f module in the backbone network. Finally, the Enhanced Intersection over Union (EIOU) loss function is introduced as the target frame regression loss function to improve the imbalance between positive and negative samples in the dataset. In terms of the dataset, fire scenes with different backgrounds are selected, including the early, middle and late stages of the fire, and 15% of sunset, lighting and other interference images are added for a total of 6600 images. For the presentation of the results, a visualization interface was designed based on Streamlit. Compared with the previous model, the improved YOLOv8n improves the model accuracy by 8.4%, while the model size increases by 0.1%, which effectively achieves EIOU a balance between model weight and performance.

articleTitle: Aeroengine Gas Path Fault Diagnosis Based on Attention Mechanism-optimized 1DCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for aeroengine gas path based on an attention mechanism-optimized one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1DCNN). Firstly, a multi-layered 1DCNN model is used to extract hierarchical information from fault data. Then, to address the shortcomings of 1DCNN in global feature extraction and important feature extraction capabilities, an attention classification module is designed. This module outputs the feature extraction results of various levels of the multi-layered 1DCNN model. Finally, the classification results of features from various levels are fused to obtain the ultimate diagnostic result. In the experiment, the proposed model was compared with long short-term memory (LSTM), temporal convolutional network (TCN), and other models. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is a fault diagnosis approach with relatively low time consumption and high diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: Vibration reduction of an uncertain nuclear refueling machine
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper focus on the vibration suppression of the nuclear refueling machine (NRM) system with parametric uncertainties. Under the original distributed parameter model, an adaptive boundary control strategy is employed to regulate the vibration of the fuel rod and simultaneously drive NRM to the given position. The radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) is introduced to approximate the unknown items of control system. Simulations and theoretical Lyapunov stability analysis are carried out to illustrate the feasibility of the designed control strategy.

articleTitle: A Novel Vision-based Fire Detection Model via OctConv Network from Optical Images
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Fire recognition plays an important role in protecting human life and property and preventing fire accidents. However, the shape and structure of fires vary due to the influence of combustible materials and conditions. In addition, complex backgrounds and different lighting conditions also present significant challenges for accurate fire recognition. Faced with challenging factors, this paper proposes a novel vision-based fire recognition model based on Residual Octave Convolution (OctConv). To obtain strong feature representational capacity, a residual OctConv block is built to build the backbone network, which could well learn features at multiple scales simultaneously. For the OctConv, the high-frequency components capture fine-grained details, while the low-frequency components capture more global context, which enables the network to better recognize objects, leading to improved accuracy. Meanwhile, to retain important feature information while reducing feature redundancy, a shuffle attention mechanism is further introduced into the residual OctConv block to improve the detection performance of small targets. Combined with a self-built dataset, the prediction accuracy of fire recognition has reached 97.87%. Meanwhile, compared to some typical classification networks, proposed model has achieved significant improvements, which could well prove the potential of proposed method in safety monitoring.

articleTitle: Selection of Reference Points for Path Tracking Control Based on Rolling Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Path tracking control techniques are commonly used in automated traveling systems for mobile equipment, where the role is to control the mobile equipment to travel along a reference path. The selection of reference points on the reference path is critical for path tracking control. However, current methods for selecting reference points face difficulties in simultaneously ensuring the accuracy and real-time performance required for path tracking control. To solve the problem, a method for selecting path tracking control reference points based on rolling prediction is proposed. The principle of this method is to predict the search range of the next control period by parameters such as the reference point of the current control period, the speed of the mobile equipment, the control period, and the mileage interval between adjacent points of the reference path. Subsequently, a localized optimization technique identifies the point on the reference path closest to the mobile equipment and is selected as the reference point. Our proposed rolling prediction method demonstrates commendable performance in ensuring path tracking control’s accuracy and real-time capabilities. In the simulation results, the absolute value of the displacement error in path tracking control does not exceed 0.1872 m. Compared with the equal-interval point selection method, the magnitude of reduction in the absolute value of displacement error can achieve at least 33.12%. Additionally, the average value of the time consumed in each control period by the rolling prediction method does not exceed 0.0709 ms and does not more than 2.87% of the average value of the total time consumed by the path tracking controller in each control period. In contrast, the existing global optimization method can occupy up to 82.36% of the total time.

articleTitle: Formation control of robot cars with obstacle avoidance
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the process of studying the formation of robot cars, the route generated by the A* algorithm in the path planning process of robot cars can often be found that it is often broken lines with many inflection points. To solve this problem, a method is proposed to further process the route generated by the A* algorithm and generate smooth curves as the route is more conducive to the execution of robot cars. Although a certain amount of time will be spent in A* algorithm path planning, successful obstacle avoidance cannot be guaranteed if only the A* algorithm is used for path planning in scenarios where obstacles suddenly appear. Therefore, this paper combines the A* algorithm with the artificial potential field method. After the obstacle appears, the artificial potential field method is used to calculate the potential field, and the potential field direction where the robot car is located is taken as the direction of the control speed, and a new path is planned..The reliability of our proposed method is verified by engineering practice, which provides a way of thinking for unmanned vehicle path planning and obstacle avoidance.

articleTitle: Distributed Localization of Multi-Agent Systems Based on Local Bearing Information
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This work addresses localizability of local-bearing-based directed multi-agent systems, which are more general but also more challenging than bearing-based undirected one. By using the local bearing measurement information, an orientation estimation algorithm is proposed, which does not require relative orientation measurements. Combined with the orientation estimation, a distributed localization estimation scheme is proposed to solve the problems of multi-agent systems absolute localization estimation. The global convergence analysis is derived based on the cascade system. A distinctive advantage of the proposed distributed estimation scheme is that it can be adopted to realize accurate orientation and absolute position estimation merely using the local bearing measurements. Several numerical simulation results are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Adaptive Heading Asymptotic Tracking Control of Marine Vehicles with Stochastic Noise
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: For the marine vehicles with stochastic noise, the adaptive heading asymptotic tracking problem is studied in this paper. Firstly, the unknown nonlinear function terms are approximated by a fuzzy logic system (FLS) to compensate for the impact of them. Then, during the design of the controller, the improved dynamic surface control (I-DSC) technology is employed, which effectively avoids the problem of explosion of complexity (EOC) associated with the conventional backstepping method. The stochastic Barbǎlat’s Lemma is incorporated into Lyapunov stability, which demonstrates that every signal within the mentioned system is bounded and the tracking error will converge to 0 in probability. Finally, simulation results are presented to show the effectiveness and performance of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Resilient Formation-Tracking of Double-Integretor Multi-agent Systems against Byzantine Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article studies resilient formation tracking of multi-agent systems (MASs) against Byzantine attacks in a second-order system. Since Byzantine agents broadcast erroneous information to their neighbors, this paper proposes a safe centroid aggregation-based formation control strategy to enhance system robustness under Byzantine attacks. By setting the safe centroid as the leader and tracking it, all normal agents adjust their positions and velocities concerning the safe centroid, thereby maintaining the predetermined formation shape. The experimental results show that the proposed control strategy effectively ensures that normal agents maintain the desired formation shape, despite the presence of Byzantine agents. This demonstrates strong robustness and adaptability.

articleTitle: Centrality Graph Deep Attention Network and Its Application to Chiller Systems Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Precise monitoring of chiller systems refers to the real-time detection of equipment or system status using various monitoring techniques. However, traditional state monitoring methods rarely take fault information into account. For this purpose, the centrality graph deep attention network (CenGAT) is proposed for precise monitoring of chiller systems. Firstly, the fault-related variables are selected based on the distribution differences before and after faults to construct the centrality graphs. Then, we utilize graph attention networks to update the centrality graph, which can effectively capture the complex relationships between nodes, thus the nodes with significant influences can be specially monitored. Finally, the autoencoder is carried out to reconstruct the output features to interpret the detected anomalies and enhance the interpretability of the monitoring results.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Consensus of Second-order MASs over Directed Graphs*
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The optimal consensus problem (OCP) for multiagent systems (MASs) is addressed in this paper. The dynamics of agents are second-order. These agents communicate with the neighbors through a directed graph. It is assumed to be strongly connected and weight-balanced. In the system, each agent has a local private cost function. The global cost function is the sum of those local cost functions. In order to address such OCP, based on the tracking method, a novel distributed control strategy is proposed. The state information (position or velocity) of the agents does not need to be communicated with the neighbors, which implies that the proposed control strategy can protect the real state information to be known by the neighbors to some extent. Under assumptions that the local private cost function are strongly convex and continuously differentiable with Lipschitz continuous gradients, the sufficient criteria are given, under which the positions of all agents controlled by the designed controllers can achieve consensus on the optimal solution of the global cost function exponentially. Finally, two simulation examples are provided to illustrate the efficiency of the designed distributed control strategy.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Multi-Sensor Hybrid Fusion Under Bounded Noises
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A hybrid fusion framework combines centralized and distributed framework is developed in this paper to configure measurement units and computational power in the event-triggered communication network flexibly. For the purposes of handling the bounded noise, based on spectral radius, an upper bound of the squared error is constructed and a optimal fusion estimator is derived by minimizing this upper bound. Finally, a target tracking system is given to show the effectiveness of the designed fusion framework and the advantages of proposed method especially when the characteristics of the noise are not recognized statistically.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of unknown device based on dynamic model and domain generalization
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The data-driven fault diagnosis of rolling bearings is widely used, but the methods often rely on a large amount of available data. However, in actual industrial processes, the operating conditions of bearings are complex and variable, and it is difficult to obtain the working condition data that needs to be diagnosed, which increases the difficulty of cross working device fault diagnosis. This article proposes a fault diagnosis method that combines simulation models with domain generalization, and establishes a new domain generalization network. Train the model using simulation models to generate bearing vibration data under target operating device, and generalize it to other actual operating devices. Combining knowledge distillation and adversarial methods in domain generalization networks, embedding the student network of knowledge distillation into the inter domain invariant feature extractor to extract intra domain and inter domain invariant features. The method has been experimentally validated to have high accuracy even under unknown device.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Tracking Control Approach for a Quadrotor Transporting a Cable-Suspended Payload
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This study presents an adaptive control system for controlling the motion of a quadrotor transporting a cable-suspended payload. The technique uses adaptive updating rules to estimate the unknown disturbance operating on the pay-load. This work employs the Lyapunov method and LaSalle’s invariance theorem to examine and demonstrate that the suggested algorithm ensures the control system’s asymptotic stability. The simulation at the end of the paper validates the performance of the constructed adaptive controller.

articleTitle: Disturbance Compensation Sliding Mode Control for Discrete Systems with Unmatched Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming to the chattering problem on a class of discrete systems with unmatched uncertainties (DSUU), a sliding mode control (SMC) strategy is considered based on disturbance compensation reaching law in this paper. First, a novel reaching law with disturbance compensation via hyperbolic tangent function is proposed and the dynamic characteristics of sliding mode are analyzed. Then, a sliding mode controller with disturbance compensation is designed via the proposed reaching law and the linear sliding surface function. Furthermore, the reachability of quasi-sliding mode (QSM) is constructed in finite time and the stability of system dynamic trends is obtained by the proposed reaching law for DSUU. Through comparative analysis, the steady performance of system by new controller is better than those systems by traditional reaching laws and its QSM has a narrower bandwidth. Finally, simulation results illustrate that the proposed SMC strategy is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Using Definite Integral Calculator to Calculate Line Integral of Arc Length
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the limitation of existing definite integral calculators in computing the integral of arc length curves, a novel methodology is introduced herein. This approach entails the conversion of the integral input format for arc length curves into the established format for definite integrals. Initially, a delineation of four distinct input formats for definite integrals and thirteen formats for arc length curve integrals is presented. Subsequently, a systematic method is devised to translate the integral input format specific to arc length curves into the standardized definite integral format. Lastly, a computational technique leveraging a definite integral calculator is outlined for the computation of arc length curve integrals. Empirical findings substantiate the efficacy of the enhanced definite integral calculator in accurately computing arc length curve integrals.

articleTitle: Distributed Divided Difference Filtering Based on Covariance Intersection over Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper explores the distributed state estimation (DSE) for the nonlinear systems over a sensor network. Divided difference filtering (DDF) is one of the well-known sigma-point Kalman filtering algorithms, which can be categorized into the first-order divided difference (DD1) filter and the second-order divided difference (DD2) filter. Compared with the extended Kalman filter (EKF), DDF possesses numerous advantages. However, a corresponding distributed filtering algorithm has yet to be developed. Therefore, this paper combines the covariance intersection (CI) fusion algorithm and DDF to propose two distributed DDF type consensus algorithms, called the covariance intersection-based first-order divided difference (CI-DD1) filter and the covariance intersection-based second-order divided difference (CI-DD2) filter, which retain the advantages of distributed filters and the DDF. The effectiveness of the two proposed algorithms is demonstrated via a typical air traffic control scenario.

articleTitle: Point Cloud Registration Based on Improved Tuna Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To enhance the performance and efficacy of point cloud registration, this research paper proposes a registration methodology centered on an enhanced Tuna Swordfish Optimization (TSO) algorithm. In order to tackle the issue of non-uniform population distribution resulting from random initialization in TSO, the Tent chaotic mapping technique is employed to initialize the population parameters, thereby augmenting population diversity. To prevent convergence to local optima, the Levy flight strategy is introduced to fortify the system's escape capability. Through the utilization of a nonlinear weight factor, the algorithm effectively balances global exploration and local optimization abilities. Ultimately, the fine registration is achieved by employing the Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm. Experimental results, conducted on the Bunny model of a publicly available dataset, demonstrate that the algorithm significantly enhances alignment accuracy by 66.73% and 25.73% when compared to the ICP algorithm and the ITSO algorithm, respectively. Furthermore, the algorithm's validity is corroborated through its application to multiple datasets.

articleTitle: Oriented Ship Detection in SAR Image with Data Augmentation Based on Swin Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image, oriented ship detection can reveal the true shape and direction information of the ship for better identification, tracking, navigation and monitoring. However, the performance of existing oriented detectors based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) is restricted due to the difficulty of capturing long-distance dependencies. In addition, there is an unbalanced distribution among the number of ship directions, easily leading to overfitting. In response to these problems, we propose a method of oriented ship detection in SAR image with data augmentation based on Swin Transformer. Firstly, the oriented data augmentation method is used to solve the problem of uneven distribution in ship directions, allowing the model to allocate equal effort in learning different kinds of orientation features. Secondly, the Swin Transformer is employed as the backbone to extract hierarchical features of SAR image to solve the problem that CNNs may be difficult to effectively capture global information, allowing the network to better cope with dense arrangement. Additionally, Gaussian distance loss is used to suppress the impact of scattering interference in SAR image. Experiments conducted on two benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Active control of an underwater flexible manipulator subject to external disturbance
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article studies the boundary control design for an underwater based-vehicle flexible manipulator subject to external disturbance. Combined with the Hamilton principle and variational principle, the dynamic model of underwater flexible manipulator is derived as a coupled partial differential equation-ordinary differential equations. We propose a boundary control to achieve vibration suppression and attitude and position tracking control. A hyperbolic tangent function is constructed to handle external disturbances. Boundary control given in this paper ensures the practical stability of the underwater flexible manipulator system via Lyapunov analysis.

articleTitle: Day-ahead power load forecasting based on Patch-LSTM-MLP
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Day-ahead load forecasting belongs to short-term forecasting, which is the basis of new energy utilization as well as power system operation. The large-scale consumption of new energy and the uncertainty of the demand side bring new challenges to day-ahead load forecasting. Traditional recurrent neural networks have limitations in feature extraction capability and learning efficiency. In order to fully learn the features in the load data, we propose a model Patch-LSTM-MLP combining LSTM, patch technique and multilayer perceptron for day-ahead load forecasting. Patch-LSTM-MLP consists of two multilayer perceptron blocks and an LSTM model based on the novel patch technique. Specifically, the proposed model employs LSTM to capture the global temporal patterns of load sequences, and introduces local multilayer perceptron and variable multilayer perceptron to enhance the model's ability to capture local temporal patterns and correlations among variables. In this paper, two public load datasets are selected to validate the effectiveness of the proposed model, which provides new ideas for the application of recurrent networks in day-ahead load forecasting.

articleTitle: Improved Small Defect Detection on Ceramic Surfaces with YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In contemporary engineering construction, ceramics have emerged as a pivotal material, presenting significant challenges in defect detection due to intricate surface patterns and the diminutive nature of flaws. The imperative to augment the precision of ceramic defect identification is twofold: enhancing product quality and elevating manufacturing throughput. This study introduces an advanced method for the identification of surface imperfections in ceramics, utilizing an enhanced YOLOv8 algorithm. Initially, to accommodate the minimal size of ceramic surface defects, images are partitioned into smaller, uniformly-sized segments during the training phase. Subsequently, in the detection phase, a sliding window technique is employed for flaw identification. Observational data analysis revealed that defects predominantly manifest as small, with a minority being medium-sized. To refine detection fidelity, the incorporation of two supplementary detection heads specifically for diminutive targets was enacted. Additionally, to effectively discriminate between complex surface patterns and genuine defects, an innovative selective attention module, dubbed LSKnet, was integrated into the YOLOv8 architecture. Comparative analysis of various Intersection Over Union (IOU) metrics led to the selection of the DIOU metric for this model, aiming to enhance precision further. An experimental endeavor to excise the larger detection head was undertaken to potentially boost model training velocity and accuracy. This methodology was empirically validated on the Tianchi ceramic tile defect dataset, culminating in the improved model achieving an average precision rate of 69.1%, marking an 8.1% accuracy enhancement over the baseline YOLOv8 model following image segmentation.

articleTitle: Robust Set Stability of Boolean Networks: Transitioning from Initial State Sets to Targeted Destination State Sets
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper delves into the robustness of set stability in Boolean networks, under the influence of function perturbations. Deviating from traditional notions of robust set stability, this paper concentrates on the transition from a predetermined initial set (IS) to a destination set (DS) in the context of such perturbations. It is premised on the assumption that set stability is initially achieved prior to the occurrence of function perturbations. In this setting, the concept of a reachable set is introduced and defined. Subsequently, the state space is partitioned into a number of distinct parametric sets. Criteria for robust set stabilization, specifically the transition from the IS to the DS, are developed. To validate the applicability of these established criteria, the paper includes an illustrative example.

articleTitle: Dynamic Sliding Mode-based Fault-Tolerant Control for Ship Dynamic Positioning Based on T-S Fuzzy Piecewise Affine Models
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy-affine-model-based fault-tolerant control problem for ship dynamic positioning (DP) systems is investigated. Firstly, the ship is modeled as a T-S fuzzy-affine model. Secondly, a dynamic sliding mode controller is designed for the ship dynamic positioning system. Thirdly, the dynamic sliding mode controller is combined with a fault-tolerant control strategy and an optimal thrust allocation algorithm in case of ship thruster failure. With the proposed control scheme, the DP problem for ships is achieved with thruster failure. Eventually, the simulation consequences demonstrate the effectiveness of the dynamic sliding mode DP controller as well as the fault-tolerant control strategy.

articleTitle: Mapless Navigation for Mobile Robots Based on Improved Soft Actor-Critic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low training efficiency and slow convergence in deep reinforcement learning algorithms for mapless navigation tasks, this paper proposes an Improved Soft Actor-Critic (ISAC) algorithm based on the original Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm. The ISAC introduces an advantage structure into the critic network to improve the speed of policy learning. A reward function that includes action information and minimum obstacle distance information is designed to improve training efficiency. Through simulation experiments, the ISAC algorithm is shown to improve the convergence speed of the model during training. In policy model evaluation, the policies trained by the ISAC algorithm have better navigation performance and generalization ability than those trained by the original SAC algorithm in the same number of training episodes. In addition, we validated the effectiveness of the models in a real environment.

articleTitle: Research on cotton pest and disease identification method based on RegNet-CMTL
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Cotton is an important crop in China, and it is important to realize accurate identification and classification of cotton pests and diseases to improve the quality of cotton. In this paper, a RegNet-CMTL algorithm is proposed, which not only effectively improves the accuracy of cotton pest and disease identification, but also significantly reduces the false alarm rate. First, the risk of overfitting is reduced by regularizing the data enhancement method. Meanwhile, CBAM attention mechanism and multi-scale feature fusion strategy are added to enhance the feature extraction and fine-grained classification ability of the model. Finally, a migration learning strategy is applied to further optimize the overall performance and convergence speed of the model. The experimental results show that the RegNet-CMTL model improves the average recognition accuracy by 5.416% and reduces the average false alarm rate by 1.110% compared to RegNet, and compares with other convolutional neural networks such as Shufflenet, ResNet34, VGG-16, Alexnet, and Googlenet, the average recognition accuracy is improved by 25.226%, 11.064%, 3.924% and 1.742%. Therefore, the RegNet-CMTL algorithm can effectively reduce the error of mixing pest and healthy cotton during the cotton picking process, thus improving the overall quality of cotton.

articleTitle: Research on Identifying Differential Behavior in Complex Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Group behavior recognition is a significant research area in computer vision and pattern recognition. However, recognizing an individual who behaves differently from the majority in complex scenes, such as malls and transport stations, is even more crucial. This paper proposes a novel approach for group behavior recognition based on deep learning and graph theory. The approach comprises two main stages: feature extraction and graph-based classification. In the feature extraction stage, visual features are extracted from each individual in the group. In the graph-based classification stage, a graph representation of the group is constructed, and graph convolutional networks (GCNs) are utilized to classify the group behavior and differentiate the anomalous behavior.

articleTitle: Feedback-linearization-based Model Predictive Control for Multiple-DOFs Manipulators via Logarithm Sliding Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a new control approach for two degrees of freedom manipulators is proposed by combining the classical model predictive control scheme with a lgarithm sliding mode manifold. Firstly, we simplify the dynamic model of manipulators through logarithmic sliding mode and feedback linearization. After that, the simplified dynamic model is uesd for model predictive control. In order to show the suitability of the proposed control approach, a group of simulations and result analysis are provided.

articleTitle: BILSTM based on quality driven attention for product defect prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Deep learning-based soft sensors play a crucial role in modern industrial process monitoring and measurement by establishing predictive models between high-quality data and easily measurable variables. However, traditional deep learning methods encounter challenges such as the high dimensionality of process variables, fluctuations in predictor variables, and weak correlations among variables. Addressing these issues, this paper introduces a novel approach called Quality-Driven Bidirectional Attention Mechanism LSTM (QBILSTM). The model prioritizes variables related to quality indicators in the input data by calculating the maximum mutual information coefficient (MIC). During training, it further enhances the importance of key variables by integrating quality indicator-related information through an attention mechanism. Moreover, to capture trends in quality variables comprehensively, the model incorporates a two-way propagation structure, and hyperparameter selection is optimized effectively using the Bayesian optimization algorithm. Finally, the superiority of QBILSTM is demonstrated through testing in real industrial processes.

articleTitle: Ship Path Following Control Based on Modified Line of Sight Guidance Law
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A modified line-of-sight (LOS) guidance law that can be adaptively adjusted according to a reference path is presented for the development of smart ships and the realisation of autonomous navigation. A time varying lookahead distance and an advanced turning strategy, based on the path turning angle, are proposed to achieve flexible steering tracking capability. The path following control experiment was conducted with the container ship ZYHY LV SHUI 01 serving as the control object. The results of the simulation experiment demonstrate that the proposed MLOS algorithm is capable of adapting to changes in the path and achieving smooth steering, which enhances the accuracy of the tracking process, reduces energy consumption, and reduces the steering frequency. These outcomes are of great significance for smart ships to achieve autonomous navigation.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Clothing Detection Model for E-Commerce Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the challenge of clothing recognition in the rapidly expanding e-commerce sector, this paper presents an improved YOLOv7-based algorithm for efficient detection. The enhanced model incorporates enhancements to the PConv(Partial Convolution) operator and a redesigned Backbone, which collectively facilitate enhanced inference speeds while maintaining accuracy. Furthermore, the use of the CARAFE(Content-Aware ReAssembly of FEatures) up-sampling operator preserves crucial semantic information, while the implementation of the MPDIoU(Minimum Point Distance Intersection over Union) loss function enables faster selection of optimal recognition frames. The proposed technique demonstrates notable improvements, including a 9.2% enhancement in inference speed, reaching 95.3 frames per second; a substantial 20.5% decrease in GFLOPs; and enhanced detection accuracy relative to the original YOLOv7 model. These outcomes highlight its effectiveness in clothing detection tasks.

articleTitle: Maximally Permissive Robustness Control of Automated Manufacturing Systems Using Petri Nets and Inhibitor Arcs
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: For automated manufacturing systems, resource failures are very common. So, robustness is a primary concern. Although there are many robust control strategies, most of them are deficient in achieving maximally permissive robustness control. This paper design maximally permissive robustness controller using Petri nets (PNs) and inhibitor arcs. We show that unreliable resource failures can be formalized by using a new PN structure with inhibitor arcs, called failure-recovery subnets. The input transitions of unreliable resource places, denoted as unreliable transitions, are prevented from firing by the corresponding failure-recovery subnets. We further show that there exist reliable transitions which are "dangerous"; namely, they are eventually forbidden to fire by unreliable transitions after they occupy the reliable resources which are necessarily required by the reliable subnet systems to proceed repeatedly. This damages the robustness of the system. Therefore, we identify the dangerous transitions by solving a set of integer linear programming problems and prevented them from firing by designing a robust controller. A lots of example are presented to illustrate the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Neural-Network-Based State Estimation for Nonlinear Systems with Measurement Outliers and Amplify-and-Forward Relays
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the state estimation problem for a class of nonlinear systems subject to amplify-and-forward (AF) relays and measurement outliers. The AF relay is implemented between the sensors and the estimator, which amplifies and forwards the measurement signals. A novel algorithm is proposed to detect measurement outliers based on historical measurement data. For the nonlinear system, a neural network based method is used to approximate the general nonlinearity. By solving matrix recursive equations, upper bounds are first derived on the estimation error covariance and the neural network weight estimation error covariance, and then the derived upper bounds are minimized through designing adequate estimator gain and tuning scalar. Finally, the validity of the proposed estimation approach is confirmed by an example.

articleTitle: Pseudo-Huber loss function-based affine registration algorithm of point clouds
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Point cloud registration is a fundamental and important technology in the field of intelligent mobile robots, which is widely used for robot localization, environment perception, route planning, construction of 3D environments and accurate grasping of target objects. For 3D point clouds with noise and missing data, the traditional affine registration algorithms are poor in robustness and accuracy. To overcome these weaknesses, a pseudo-Huber loss function-based affine registration algorithm of 3D point clouds is proposed. Since the pseudo-Huber loss function is insensitive to noise and outliers, it is introduced to establish the nonlinear optimization model of affine transformation between two 3D point clouds. Then, the initial value of affine transformation is obtained by using independent component analysis (ICA) algorithm. After that, the nonlinear optimization model is optimized by using the framework of affine iterative closest point to achieve the optimal affine transformation. The valid of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated by several experiments, and the resulted indicate that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the influence of noise and missing data, and accurate affine registration can be realized.

articleTitle: Distributed Spatiotemporal Formation Control with Multiplex Information Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Current formation control algorithms mostly focus on the single information exchange infrastructure and result in fixed and non-evolving spatial formation properties. For performing complex formation assignments, this paper introduces the multiplex information exchange rules and investigates the spatiotemporal formation of multi-agent networks. First, this paper considers a three-layer interaction network and presents a distributed leader-follower formation algorithm under the holistic planning and multi-step control (HPMSC) framework, which gives the capable leader-agents the ability to alter the size and the orientation of formation configuration spatially. Then, introducing a motion planning method and time projection method shows that the formation configurations and formation properties can be controlled within an appointed settling time. Moreover, it is feasible to extend the presented results to time-varying formation problems and more complex formation configurations over multiple information networks (more than three layers). Finally, a simulation example indicates the effectiveness of the presented algorithms.

articleTitle: Event-triggered interval observer design for a class of Cyber-physical systems with attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
