abstract: For Cyber-physical systems under deception attack, we study the state interval estimation. At the same time, To enhance the utilization rate of network resources, the event-triggered mechanism is adopted to reduce unnecessary data communication. Based on the positive system theory and Lyapunov stability theory, a sufficient condition for the boundedness of the interval observer is given by analyzing the convergence of the error system. And by solving the observer gain matrix with LMI, an event-triggered interval observer is designed, and the interval estimation of Cyber-physical systems is realized. Finally, we verify the rationality of the event-triggered interval observer through simulations.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm can Promote Cooperation in Public Goods Game with Costly Punishment
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Previous researches have well demonstrated the importance of costly punishment for promoting the evolution of cooperation in spatial public goods games, while it remains unconsidered sides about the role of strategy-updating mechanisms. Inspired by the algorithms in the field of Machine Learning, in this paper, we propose a game strategy updating mechanism based on Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm for spatial public goods game with continuous strategies, and explore the impact of tolerance-based punishment mechanisms on the evolution of cooperation. The results of simulation experiments show that the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm can effectively promote cooperation under appropriate parameter settings. This result reveals that hybrid learning is more conducive to maintaining cooperation than a single learning mechanism (social learning or self-learning), and can prevent the spread of betrayal and maintain a high level of cooperation when betrayal strategies invade.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant control allocation for octocopter UAV
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A new fault-tolerant control allocation method is proposed for the octocopter unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with respect to the problem of actuator failure in the power system. A non-linear model of the UAV in the case of actuator failure is developed through kinematic and kinetic analyses, transforming the control allocation problem into a non-linear convex optimization problem that achieves the desired objective while satisfying the need for three-axis moments and given actuator position and rate constraints. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method have been simulated and verified on the Matlab experimental platform. The simulation results show that this method is more effective than the traditional control distribution method in solving the actuator velocity distribution problem when a local fault occurs in the eight-rotor UAV, and can achieve the desired attitude tracking.

articleTitle: Study on power prediction of hydrogen fuel cell electric reactor system based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the aggravation of environmental pollution and energy crisis, new energy vehicles have attracted much attention in recent years. Hydrogen fuel cell electric stack system is an important power system in new energy vehicles, which realizes the driving of the vehicle by using the reaction of hydrogen and oxygen. In this paper, we propose a long-term prediction method based on power data of the stack and the Transformer model, which adopts the self-attention mechanism to better capture the long-term dependency relationship in the time-series data, thus realizing the long-term prediction of power stack power. Power stack prediction experiments show that the Transformer model has higher prediction accuracy in long-term prediction compared to LSTM and RNN models.

articleTitle: ProCAST-based valve body casting process design
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Valve body castings are widely used in power plants, mainly used to control the opening and closing of pipeline fluid, flow direction, flow, pressure, and temperature. This paper maies ProCAST software to analyze the finite element of the valve body, and then determine the optimal casting scheme. The process parameters of the casting system and shrinkage system are simulated and calculated. Realizing the casting instead of the forginnly usg process, the actual production has a guiding role in helping.

articleTitle: Virtual Simulation Experiment Based on Magnetic Resonance Imaging Theory, Structure and Application
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Addressing the constraints of MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) equipment, such as its complex structure, bulky size, high cost, and the workload of hospitals, we have designed an MRI virtual simulation experimental course teaching project based on VR and 3D simulation technology. This project can run on a PC equipped with a Windows 10 operating system and provides practical teaching services through head-mounted devices. The project covers the imaging principles of MRI, the equipment structure of MRI, the clinical applications of MRI, and other content, effectively improving teaching efficiency and quality, and enhancing students' understanding and mastery of MRI-related knowledge. This project provides a new solution for MRI teaching practice in medical education, carrying significant theoretical and practical implications.

articleTitle: RGB-IR YOLO combining Modality-Specific Reconstruction and Information Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Utilizing cross-modality information between infrared and visible light presents a novel approach to enhancing detection performance. However, existing methods for leveraging visible-infrared information are relatively simplistic, failing to thoroughly explore the relationship between infrared and visible light features. Therefore, this paper introduces RI-YOLO, a new framework for infrared-visible images object detection. Firstly, to retain the inherent advantages of each modality image, we propose G&M-DI, a technique for modality-specific reconstruction and cross-modality information fusion. Secondly, by introducing AWI, we employ an adaptive weight allocation strategy to mitigate cross-modality interference, effectively leveraging the relationship between different modalities. Experimental results on datasets M3FD and LLVIP demonstrate that RI-YOLO surpasses existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) models.

articleTitle: Lightweight Intrusion Detection Based on Hybrid Feature Selection Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Industrial control security is the lifeblood of a country and the core component of production and life. It targets the issues of diverse attack methods and unbalanced training sample data in traditional industrial control systems. This paper proposes a novel hybrid machine-learning model that integrates PSO-CNN-Attention-BiLSTM. SMOTE algorithm is used to solve the problem of small samples and unbalanced attacks in training and generate missing sample data. The backbone network employs a CNN-Attention-BiLSTM hybrid model for training, extracting feature characteristics from sample data. The backbone network considers the time series relationship in the input sample and the degree of spatial feature relationship inside the sample. It uses an attention mechanism to extract relationship features within samples. Finally, it uses the classification module to classify the prediction results. Through experimental tests, the model has a classification accuracy of 98.18% and an F1 score of 0.9809 on the intrusion detection data set of an industrial production PLC device in Hebei Province. Compared with the conventional intrusion detection model, this method has a higher classification accuracy and better performance than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning of Underwater Vehicle with Optimal Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of “the shortest distance is not the lowest energy consumption” in the traditional path optimisation algorithm, an autonomous underwater vehicle path optimisation algorithm based on the energy-optimal improved ant colony algorithm is proposed. The algorithm establishes the force model of the underwater vehicle in the process of moving through the hydrodynamic analysis of the underwater vehicle, obtains the energy consumption calculation formula of the moving path of the vehicle, and proposes an improved ant colony algorithm with optimal energy consumption, which adopts the inverse of the energy consumption of the path as the value of the path pheromone, and achieves the purpose of the energy consumption guiding the evolution of the ant colony. The experimental results show that: the path length of the algorithm is 2356.4m, the energy consumption of the underwater vehicle is 114720J, and the number of iterations of the algorithm is 19 times, while the path length of the traditional distance optimal algorithm is 2350.8m, the energy consumption of the underwater vehicle is 115390J, and the number of iterations of the algorithm is 14 times. Although the path distance planned by this algorithm is longer than the traditional algorithm, the energy consumption is reduced, which is advantageous for reducing the energy consumption of the underwater vehicle and improving the endurance.

articleTitle: Fixed-time Sliding Mode Control for Robot Manipulators
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A fixed-time sliding mode control (FSMC) approach is presented in this paper, which defines the constant settling time to the origin of the system regardless of the initial conditions. The control approach is subsequently implemented on robot manipulators. The paper begins by presenting and analyzing a robot manipulator system. Subsequently, a fixed-time sliding mode (FSM) controller is established utilizing the FSM surface and fixed-time stability theory to guarantee the asymptotic convergence of tracking error to zero within a fixed time frame. Lastly, simulations are conducted on the robot manipulator to verify the practicality of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Design of CDC Semi-active Suspension State Observer Considering Additional Dynamic Forces
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In light of the additional dynamic forces present in the four sub-suspension systems during vehicle acceleration, deceleration, and cornering maneuvers, this paper introduces a novel suspension state observer design that integrates these dynamic forces. Initially, an analysis of the vehicle's dynamic behavior under various conditions is conducted to derive expressions for the additional dynamic forces. Subsequently, recognizing that these forces vary with changes in vehicle loading, this study employs the Recursive Least Squares (RLS) algorithm to perform real-time estimation of the vehicle's weight. Moreover, to mitigate the influence of vehicle loading on observer precision, the vehicle loading is treated as a premise variable. A load- adaptive observer design is then formulated within the framework of T-S Fuzzy modeling, ensuring robustness against variations in vehicle loading. Finally, through CarSim-MATLAB cosimulations, the efficacy of the proposed suspension observer across diverse operating conditions is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Emergency Response for Super-Large Vessel Navigation in Port Areas Based on Cloud Modele
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to better solve the problem of emergency response for super-large vessels navigating in the port area, this paper proposes an evaluation method based on the combined weighting cloud model. Firstly, the risk factors are analyzed and evaluation indicators are established based on three aspects: environment, vessels, and the development of emergencies. Secondly, AFP and entropy weight method are introduced and combined with cloud model theory and technology to construct an emergency response evaluation model for port navigation. Through case analysis, it is demonstrated that the model accurately assesses the risk of ultra-large ships when sailing in the port area, which providing a theoretical basis for ports and shipping enterprises to improve their emergency response capability.

articleTitle: Differential-Driven Unmanned Surface Vessel Patrol Path Tracking Control With Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article proposes a patrol path tracking control strategy based on sliding mode control (SMC) for a differential-driven unmanned surface vessel (USV). Aiming at differential-driven USV, the mathematical model of propeller motor is constructed. The PWM duty cycle of propeller motor is used as the direct control input in this article, so it is convenient to be applied in practice. The controller has been designed using a combined approach of Line-of-Sight (LOS) guidance and SMC. Then the stability of the designed controller is analyzed by using the Lyapunov stability theory. The circular patrol path of USV is designed and the tracking situation is analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of the SMC strategy is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Consensus Control for Coupled Linear Systems Based on Off-Policy Integral Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article studies the consensus problem for coupled linear multi-agent systems with completely unknown system dynamics. These coupled individual agent systems aim to achieve consensus for their system states while minimizing a novel type of cost function which can result in distributed control law for each agent system. The optimal distributed controller of each agent is designed using adaptive dynamic programming (ADP). The decoupled value function is derived first, and the model-based ARE is solved iteratively using policy iteration method. Without knowing the system models, the off-policy integral reinforcement learning method is applied, and a linear regression equation is solved to derive the optimal control gains from data collected online. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the designed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Distributed Space Remote Sensing Data Processing System
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the increase of the amount of aerospace remote sensing data, the processing speed of relevant data is getting higher and higher, and the traditional stand-alone mode can no longer meet the current big data business needs. In response to the above requirements, this paper uses distributed technology to improve processing performance, parses data in real time and stores it on the big data platform, and provides structured data for subsequent applications. Based on the cloud platform, the system dynamically applies for computing resources, and flexibly scales linearly on demand to achieve load balancing of the overall performance of the system and avoid the problem of single point of failure.

articleTitle: Consensus for Second-Order Sampled-Data Multi-Agent Systems with Antagonistic Information and Communication Noise
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This note investigate the bipartite consensus problem for second-order sampled-data stochastic multi-agent systems (SMASs) with communication noise and antagonistic information. To reduce the influence of noise, we first consider a control gain that is a time-varying, as well as the bipartite sampled-data based stochastic approximation (SA) control protocol is proposed. The proposed protocol utilizes the state information from its neighbours and the agent’s own state feedback. Based on this control protocol, the bipartite consensus problem for sampled-data SMASs with communication noise can be solved. Meanwhile, the initial position and initial velocity may specify the final state for SMASs. Finally, the feasibility of our result is illustrated by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Standard Compliance Detection in Power Field Operations Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, power field construction accidents have occurred frequently. The safety guarantee measures for construction personnel are thrown into sharp focus. Wearing safety harnesses is one of the most important requirements to protect the safety of construction personnel. Therefore, it is necessary to check whether personnel working at heights are wearing safety harnesses. The existing safety harness wearing detection algorithms face challenges such as target obstructions, substantial variance, and complex environments, leading to low detection accuracy. To address these issues, in this paper, a standard compliance detection model in power field operations based on improved YOLOv7 is proposed. The biformer attention mechanism is incorporated into the backbone network of YOLOv7 for the feature extraction, which can bolster the target detection performance. The experiments show that the detection precision of improved YOLOv7 is 4% higher than YOLOv7. Meanwhile, the mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95 are 0.4% and 1.6% higher than YOLOv7, which meet the accuracy requirement of the safety risk management in the field operations of power systems.

articleTitle: Analysis and prediction of factors affecting student grades based on machine learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The importance of analyzing and predicting the impact of student achievement is a key topic in education. Based on the open data set provided by the University of California, Irvine as a data sample, we propose a machine learning algorithm to cluster and predict the performance of students and students’ grades, so as to obtain the correlation between relevant factors and students’ grades. The experimental results indicate that this machine learning algorithm can better analyze the relationship between relevant factors and academic performance and predict students’ daily performance. Thus educators can teach students in accordance with their aptitude, thereby improving their grades.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Control for Nonlinear Multi-Agent Systems Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a new reinforcement learning-based model-free adaptive control algorithm is introduced for discrete-time nonlinear multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, while the equivalent dynamic linearization algorithm is applied to design the optimal controller. The strategy for Q-Learning and the actor-critic neural network are specifically redesigned to achieve consensus control in multi-agent systems. The proposed reinforcement learning algorithm can adjust the dynamic linearization parameters in real-time only based on input and output data. The stability of the closed-loop system is proven by Lyapunov theorem. Furthermore, the method’s effectiveness is verified by a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Active vibration isolation control method for cold atom gravimeter based on nominal model
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Addressing the high sensitivity of cold atom gravimeters to environmental vibrations, this paper proposes a novel active vibration isolation control method. The approach evolves through meticulously designed steps: it begins with the construction of an active vibration isolation model tailored for cold atom gravimeters; followed by the development of a nominal model that reflects the characteristics of the actual system; it then devises a specific control law based on the nominal model; and ultimately formulates the complete control strategy for the cold atom gravimeter’s active vibration isolation system. This control method takes into account the unpredictability of external disturbances and the imprecision of models, tackling challenges often overlooked by traditional control technologies. By establishing a solid and robust nominal model, the method ensures rapid convergence of vibration velocity and displacement within the isolation system, significantly enhancing the precision of the control system. Simulation results have validated the effectiveness of the proposed method, confirming its success in suppressing vibration interference and markedly improving the measurement accuracy and performance stability of cold atom gravimeters. This research contributes important theoretical and practical advancements to the progress of cold atom gravity measurement technology and also offers a new solution for active vibration isolation to ensure the reliable operation of precision instruments in complex environments.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life prediction method for rotating machinery based on multi-stage information fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Deep learning algorithms have been widely used in the field of remaining useful life (RUL) prediction for rotating machinery in recent years due to their powerful feature extraction and self-learning capabilities. However, the increasingly complex industrial environment puts forward higher requirements on the RUL prediction accuracy of equipment. For this reason, this study improves the algorithm of Transformer class based on the global-local information fusion method to achieve the RUL prediction of bearings. Using Transformer model for local life prediction, frequency enhanced decomposed Transformer (FEDformer) model for global life prediction and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm to optimize the weighting coefficients, a multi-stage information fusion RUL method, named multi-stage fusion Transformer (MSFformer), is designed, which realises the optimal combination of global and local information and improves the prediction accuracy. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified on the XJTU-SY dataset.

articleTitle: H∞ Control for Networked Control Systems with Packet Loss and Deception attack
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, the robust H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control problem is considered for a class of networked system with packet losses and deception attacks. There are random packet losses occur from sensor to controller and deception attacks occur from controller to actuator in this system. It is assumed that the random packet losses and deception network attacks both obey Bernoulli random binary distributions. Observer-based controller is designed because the state of the system cannot be fully observed. The closed-loop NCS is robustly stochastically exponentially stable and has achieved the prescribed H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> disturbance rejection attenuation property. Then, we conduct an analysis of the stability of the system exhaustively and address the controller synthesis problem. The controller design is effective when the LMI is shown to be solvable under certain conditions. Finally, the proposed LMI method has been proven to be effective through the use of a simulation example of uninterruptable power supply.

articleTitle: Utilizing Time Varying Tangent Barrier Lyapunov Function for Prescribed Performance Backstepping Sliding Mode Control Suppressing Bursting Oscillation of HTGS
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Crucial for hydroelectric units, the hydro turbine governing system (HTGS) encounters multiscale coupling effects among its subsystems. Catering to the multiscale coupling effects among subsystems of HTGS, periodic variations of self-adjustment coefficients are introduced to change HTGS’s transient torque response frequency. Thus, the multiscale HTGS is established. In this paper, initially, the bursting oscillation behavior resulting from improper selection of PID controller parameters and changes in excitation frequency is analyzed in multiscale HTGS through numerical simulations. Subsequently, a prescribed performance backstepping sliding mode controller based on time-varying tangent barrier Lyapunov function (TTBLF&PPC-BSMC) is designed to suppress this phenomenon. Simulation experiments are ultimately conducted to verify the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed control strategy, contrasting it with traditional methods.

articleTitle: Bioaerosol fluorescence lidar control system design
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Fluorescence lidar is one of the effective means to detect bioaerosols. In this paper, based on the research of bioaerosol detection principle and single photon detection technology, a set of fluorescence lidar control system for detecting bioaerosol is designed, and the control software is designed accordingly, the influence of different parameters on the performance of the system is investigated through simulation calculation, and the observation experiments are carried out to validate the system’s detecting ability and the stability of the control software.

articleTitle: Supervised Long Short Term Memory Network for Quality Prediction in Industrial Polyethylene Process with Limited Samples
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To improve the quality prediction performance in industrial polyethylene process with limited samples, a supervised long short term memory (SLSTM) network is applied and modified in this study. In the proposed method, the historical samples of other grade are used for model training, i.e. the structure and parameters of SLSTM network. Then the trained model is fine-tuned by the limited available samples of the target grade. So that only some weight parameters are further modified based on the limited samples. In this way, the qualities of key variables can be fast and accurately predicted by the proposed method. By comparison, the prediction results in the industrial polyethylene process are obviously improved by the proposed method, showing advantages than the existing methods.

Author Keywords: supervised long short term memory network

articleTitle: State prediction of spindle and feed axis status of CNC machine tools based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The health status of the spindle and feed axis has a direct impact on the reliability and accuracy retention level of the machine tool. Vibration acceleration data of the spindle and feed axis is collected by installing three-axis vibration acceleration sensors on the GZ002 model machine, which is processed to calculate two feature values, namely "surface quality-related features" and "dimension-related features". After normalizing and differential transformation on the feature data, the training data and label data are obtained by the time window, which are input into the LSTM model for learning and predicting the future 10 states of the CNC machine tool. Experimental results indicate that the MAE values of the predicted features in each axis and direction are all less than 0.1, and the MSE values are all less than 0.015, demonstrating the accurate prediction of the future states of the spindle and feed axis.

articleTitle: Enhancing One-Shot Action Recognition from Occluded Skeletons with a Spatial-Temporal Denoising AutoEncoder
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we tackle the challenge of one-shot action recognition from occluded skeleton data. The task uses limited labeled samples to learn an action recognition model to cope with the time-consuming and laborious problem of annotating a large amount of data. Additionally, the unavoidable occlusion of human joints in real-life scenarios significantly complicates skeleton action recognition efforts. To address these issues, we introduce a novel Spatial-Temporal Denoising AutoEncoder (ST-DAE) designed for skeleton-based one-shot action recognition. Employing an encoder-decoder architecture, the encoder extracts intrinsic patterns of movements from input occluded skeletons, whereas the decoder learns to reconstruct the skeletons under the supervision of clean skeletons. Then a Spatial-Temporal GCN (ST-GCN) backbone network learns to map the reconstructed skeletons into a high-dimensional feature space to capture their essential characteristics for action recognition. Finally, one-shot action recognition is achieved by a KNN classifier in the learned feature space. Experimental validations on the comprehensive NTU-RGB+D 120 RE occlusion dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed spatial-temporal denoising autoencoder against noisy skeleton data.

articleTitle: Virtual Synchronous Generator Based on Full-order Terminal Sliding Mode Backstepping Control
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To promote the response speed and accuracy of the output power, the traditional sliding mode control has been used in the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) based inverter. However, the inherent chattering of the sliding mode control is not eliminated, and the disturbance of matched and non-matched in the system is not fully considered, which will lead to inaccurate control. In this paper, a full-order terminal sliding mode (FTSM) backstepping control method is proposed, which aims to improve the robustness of the system to resist internal parameter perturbations and external disturbances, and eliminate the chattering caused by high-frequency switching. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are proved by simulation and experiment results.

Author Keywords: full-order terminal sliding mode backstepping controller

articleTitle: ATL-Net: Ocean Current Prediction Based on Self-Attention Mechanism and Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The prediction of ocean currents is crucial to the development and utilization of marine resources. However, traditional prediction methods often fail to accurately capture the irregular behavior of ocean currents, which results in low accuracy. To solve this problem, this paper introduces a novel network for ocean current prediction, termed ATL-Net, which integrates the self-attention mechanism, temporal convolutional network (TCN), and long short-term memory (LSTM) network. ATL-Net enhances feature extraction through the inflated convolutions of TCN, captures ocean current dynamics more effectively with the self-attention mechanism, and uses LSTM for its ability to memorize long sequences of current information. Experimental results on WaMoSII data demonstrate the effectiveness of ATL-Net, which achieves the current speed prediction accuracy of 92.9% and the current direction accuracy of 90.4%. The results outperform those of existing methods. The method proposed in this paper is not only vital for the development and utilization of marine resources but also presents an efficient method for accurate ocean current prediction.

articleTitle: Quantized stabilization of Markov jump system with time-delay and deception attack
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The mean-square exponential convergence of Markov jump systems (MJSs) with time-delay and deception attack is studied by using the event-triggered control and quantized measurements. The coupled influence of switches, time-delay and deception attack result in a complex mismatch between the system mode and the controller mode. To deal with this issue, we first introduce a virtual system reducing the effect of network induced delay. Then the quantization rules are developed for different cases based on whether the system is under attack and whether the triggering interval is switched. Next, the decreasing and increasing rates (DIR) of the Lyapunov function are gained for different situations. Based on this, we derive the sufficient conditions guaranteeing the exponential convergence in the mean sense of the closed-loop system. Finally, the effectiveness of the main results is verified through two-tank system.

articleTitle: Alignment of human body and scenes in 3D reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, virtual human technology has been developing fast, and accordingly, the 3D reconstruction of the human body and scenes is required in many applications. Usually, the human and the scene are rendered separately before merging them during the reconstruction, which thus requires a coordinate alignment between the human body model and the scene model. However, this alignment still depends on manual setting in most cases and sometimes significant deviations can occur if the setting is not reasonable. To solve this issue, we propose a new method to adaptively make alignment of the human body and the scene by using a natural physical constraint between these two. We first construct the ground plane model as well as the plane model that the feet of human body stands on. and then make these two models alignment. Experiments illustrate that our method is effective and adaptive, showing the potential to be used in practice.

articleTitle: Research on position sensorless control of PMSM based on new SMO
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the times, permanent magnet synchronous motors(PMSM) have gradually been widely used in agriculture, industrial manufacturing, CNC machine tools and other fields due to their advantages such as high precision, high efficiency, high power density, and low noise. In the position sensorless control based on the sliding mode observer(SMO), the SMO has problems such as large chattering and large errors. This paper designs a new exponential reaching rate, which is equal to the constant speed of the traditional exponential reaching law. Add the polynomial of f(s) to the term, replace the discontinuous sgn(s) function with the continuous and smooth sigmoid(s) function, and improve the extraction of rotor position information. The Matlab-Simulink is applied to simulate and compare the traditional and new SMO. The simulation results show that the new SMO designed in this article can effectively weaken the chattering and reduce the difference between the estimated speed and position information and the real speed and error in location information.

articleTitle: Short-term Forecasting of Multienergy Loads in Integrated Energy System Based on Improved Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a short-term load forecasting method based on improved Transformer to increase prediction accuracy of multienergy loads in integrated energy systems. Firstly, the multienergy load data is combined with weather information to construct different feature sets. Then, we propose an improved Transformer structure for prediction. The performance of our proposed model was verified through actual data from an IES. The results show that the proposed method can effectively increase prediction accuracy for electricity, cold and heat loads.

articleTitle: State estimation of reaction–diffusion impulse genetic regulatory networks with semi-Markovian jump parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper focuses on a class of state estimation problems for impulse genetic regulatory networks with reaction– diffusion terms. First, considering the influence of environment on the target systems, a semi-Markovian jump process is used to model the genetic regulatory networks. In addition, considering the activation and repression of transcription factors and the transient nature of signaling, an impulse signal is also employed to model the studied networks. Furthermore, a novel space-dividing measurement method is used to reduce the estimator design cost. Finally, the effectiveness of the designed state estimator is verified based on numerical examples.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant Control for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper develops a fault-tolerant control strategy for quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicles using deep reinforcement learning. To Address the issue of actuator failures, which can degrade trajectory tracking and system stability, we propose a novel fault-tolerant control framework. This framework integrates neural networks to approximate the dynamics of a quadrotor through offline data, generating residuals containing fault information for reinforcement learning training. An improved Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient algorithm is employed to accelerate the learning process and improve fault-tolerant capability, enhanced by Prioritized Experience Replay to assign training priorities based on residual values. The approach significantly improves the robustness and adaptability of the controller despite actuator faults. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method maintains tracking performance effectively even under actuator faults.

articleTitle: Integrated Mobile Measurements for Improved Control of Atmospheric Pollution Based on Reaction Diffusion PDE Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, an optimal framework for the control of a class of atmospheric pollution modeled as reaction-diffusion systems is presented. It is assumed that a moving perturbation is involved in the diffusion process. The optimization is carried out by means of measurements obtained by mobile sensors from the spatial diffusion process. A control scheme based on mobile measurements which ensures global asymptotic stabilization of the closed-loop control system is provided through the use of an output feedback control policy and the Lyapunov function method. Under this improved control strategy, the traditional scenario of utilizing measurements from a fixed sensor network to achieve system control can be considered as a special case of our results. In addition, the effectiveness of the theoretical results is shown and substantiated through provided simulation examples.

articleTitle: Extended Kalman-based multi-sensor fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of sensor technology and electronic information technology, data fusion technology is of great significance in improving the system's ability of detecting, recognizing and tracking targets. That is, a single sensor can only provide partially imprecise information, thus not excluding ambiguity in the description of the external environment. Given the complementarity exhibited by the differences in the performance of the sensors, synthesizing the information from individual sensors results in more accurate and reliable information than a single sensor can provide. A multi-sensor fusion method based on extended Kalman is proposed to address this problem. Experimental results show that the accuracy and robustness of target detection and tracking can be significantly improved by the fusion of infrared and millimeter wave radar data.

articleTitle: Disturbance Estimation and Rejection Based Predictive Control for Networked Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The paper investigates disturbance rejection based control for networked control systems (NCSs) with communication delays. A combination of networked predictive control (NPC) and disturbance rejection methods, is developed for the considered NCSs. First, we construct the Luenberger observers to estimate the states of the system as well as disturbances. Next, based on the observers and NPC method, the impact of communication delays is effectively compensated. Finally, effectiveness of the developed NPC with disturbance rejection technology is verified via a car-like vehicle example in path tracking control problem.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control of T-S Fuzzy Systems Under Probabilistic Input Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This work investigates the sliding mode control (SMC) problem of T-S fuzzy systems under probabilistic saturation constraints, where the actuator input is permitted to exceed its pre-given threshold with a certain probability. One obstacle is how to integrate the probabilistic saturation constraints into stability and reachability analysis considering the special structure of sliding mode controller. To address this problem, an SMC law is firstly synthesized by utilizing the well-known parallel distributed compensation scheme. Subsequently, we propose an altered sector condition incorporating the sign function and membership functions (MFS) to deal with the saturation nonlinearities. Facilitated by an auxiliary inequality, sufficient criteria are derived towards ensuring the local stochastic stability of the closed-loop system and the reachability of the prescribed sliding surface. A broader domain of stochastic stability may be anticipated through an optimization problem. Ultimately, a simulation example validates the efficacy of the provided control method.

articleTitle: Optimal Path Seeking for Consensus Tracking Control of Networked Marine Surface Vehicles: A Three-Layer Reinforcement Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This study introduces a novel three-tiered reinforcement learning (RL) framework, meticulously crafted for the purpose of optimal pathfinding and consensus tracking control within the realm of networked marine surface vehicles (NMSVs). The framework is structured into three layers: decision-making, estimation, and control, each addressing specific challenges in autonomous marine navigation. The decision-making layer processes environmental data and employs reinforcement learning for path planning, the estimation layer develops consensus strategy development, and the control Layer implements these strategies for coordinated MSV movement. Our experimental results, obtained from simulations, demonstrate effectiveness for the framework in improving operational efficiency and reliability of MSVs in dynamic marine environments, underscoring the potential of our approach in advancing autonomous marine vehicle coordination.

articleTitle: Topic Mining and Hotspot Perspective on Nuclear Power Generation Research in China
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This study uses data mining and visual analysis methods to analyze the research themes and hot spots in the three research stages of China's nuclear power generation research in the CNKI literature database. In order to systematically sorting out the historical context of China's nuclear power generation research and judging the next phase of research focus.

articleTitle: Observer-based H∞-consensus control of nonlinear multi-agent systems under hybrid attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper studies the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> -consensus control of non-linear multi-agent systems with measurement saturation under hybrid attacks. Firstly, nonlinearity and measurement saturation phenomena are considered during the modeling process, making the established system model closer to practical engineering applications. Then the observer and controller of the system are designed under the hybrid attacks involving deception attacks and denial of service attacks. A sufficient condition is provided to guarantee that the consensus error meets the desirable disturbance attenuation level against exogenous disturbances. Therefore, the parameterized form of the observer and controller gain is attained by the solutions to a matrix inequality. Finally, an example verifies the validity of the control algorithm research.

articleTitle: Driverless Vehicle Tracking Algorithm Based on Convolutional Neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To improve the accuracy and stability of tracking, this paper proposes an improved convolutional neural network (CNN) for driverless vehicle tracking. Firstly, a decaying learning rate is used in the optimizer by introducing learning rate decay technology. Then, we replace the convolution layers in the convolution blocks with the identity blocks to achieve residual nesting, which can better learn the complex feature information. The improved convolution blocks are used to construct residual network. Finally, experiments and comparisons show that the validation loss of the proposed CNN is significantly lower than that of the conventional CNN, which demonstrates the superiority of the proposed tracking method.

articleTitle: Deep-Q-Network-based Economic Model Predictive Control for Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: It has been investigated that economic model predictive control (EMPC) is a promising technique for controlling wind energy conversion systems (WECSs). However, the economic performance of EMPC tends to deteriorate severely due to the uncertainty of wind speed in the entire operating mode. Besides, WECSs also impose high demands on the computation time of the controller. In this work, we perform an integrated algorithm of deep-Q-network and EMPC in the optimal operation of WECSs. By learning the action-value function to act as the terminal cost of EMPC, the suggested approach aims to improve performance even at short prediction horizons. The closed-loop performance is improved by incorporating Q-learning even if the presence of wind speed uncertainty. For the simulation study, a typical 5 MW wind turbine is considered, and the results show that the proposed method outperforms the general EMPC.

articleTitle: a real-time trajectory planning method for overhead crane based on deep reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Considering the trajectory planning requirements of overhead crane, a real-time trajectory planning method based on deep reinforcement learning is proposed. A trajectory planning model of overhead crane in transport phase is established, taking into account the random start positions of the overhead crane and the load uncertainty. The Twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm (TD3) is used, in which the position and velocity of the planar crane and the sway angle and angular acceleration information between the crane and the load are used as the state quantities of the algorithm, and the thrust force applied on the planar crane is used as the control quantities, the proposed method has the generalization ability to meet the accuracy requirements, and the control method can make the crane in the process of movement with smooth speed, accurate positioning, small load sway angle, and has a certain degree of robustness in the face of the beginning of the position of the random and the load uncertainty, which can satisfy the needs of online real-time trajectory planning.

articleTitle: Research on Stick-slip Vibration Control Method of Drill String
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The stick-slip vibration generated during drilling can easily lead to drilling accidents and reduce the drilling efficiency. By analyzing the mechanism of the stick-slip vibration, a motion equation of drill string is established; The combination of top drive and bottom hole assembly is equivalent into lumped mass blocks, a two lumped mass spring damping vibration model is built, the simulation results show that the drill string model can effectively simulate downhole stick-slip vibration. Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to obtain the drill bit speed, a kind of proportion integration differentiation control algorithm based on the state observer is designed and simulated, the results show that the state observer can effectively estimate the drill bit speed, and the control method can effectively suppress the drill string stick slip vibration. Based on the theory of similarity, the stick-slip vibration experimental device is built and studied, the experimental results show that the control algorithm is effective and has a good control effect on the downhole stick-slip vibration. The stick-slip vibration control method of drill string provides a theoretical basis for top drive control in drilling engineering and has important engineering application value.

articleTitle: Learning-based Fuzzy Control for Strict-feedback Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The fuzzy control problem for a sort of uncertain strict-feedback nonlinear systems is examined in this article. Fuzzy logic systems (FLSs) approximate the unknown uncertainties of considered systems, whose fast convergence is guaranteed by novel gradient-descent based parameter updating laws. The closed-loop system is shown to be semi-globally uniformly ultimately bounded (SUUB) by Lyapunov function-based approach. To demonstrate the efficacy of the presented scheme, a simulation example on inverted pendulum is provided along with some comparison results.

articleTitle: Finite-time formation control of underactuated ASVs with prescribed transient performance subject to input saturation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive finite-time prescribed performance control (AFPPC) algorithm for underactuated autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) with input saturation characteristics based on introducing a virtual vessel. The entire leader-follower formation control process is decomposed into a two-stage tracking control process. In the first stage, a virtual ASV tracking reference trajectory is introduced to facilitate the controller design for the leader with the unmeasurable velocity. By designing a finite-time observer, the unmeasurable velocity is observed in finite time. In the second stage, an adaptive finite-time prescribed performance controller is presented for the followers to track the virtual ASV. First, the uncertainty of the ASVs is approximated by employing the fusion of neural networks with fractional-order power functions. Then, a concise adaptive law is proposed to compensate the neural network’s upper boundary, resulting in finite-time convergence. Secondly, in order to ensure that all signals do not violate the transient performance, an error system built from the logarithmic error transformation function is established, which ensures that the transformed error converges to a prescribed boundary in finite time. Thirdly, conditions are given to ensure that all closed-loop signals of the ASVs are consistently bounded in finite time. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed AFPPC scheme is verified by a simulation case study.

articleTitle: Safety assessment of probe-and-drogue aerial refueling docking based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Ensuring safety during aerial refueling is critical, especially during the docking phase. For increasing the safety of aerial refueling, this paper proposes a docking safety assessment method based on a deep neural network (DNN) to predict the docking success rate, in which particle swarm optimization (PSO) is adopted to solve the optimal network parameters. First, rich simulation data is generated based on the comprehensive aerial refueling docking simulation platform. Then, using the collected data, the relationship between the state of the aerial refueling system and the docking success rate is established based on the deep neural network after training, and the docking success rate can be predicted as a safety metric. Finally, the simulation comparison shows that the proposed PSO-DNN is better than the classical DNN prediction. In general, the deep learning network designed in this paper can obtain the internal information of the data well, and can evaluate the safety of aerial refueling according to the predicted docking success rate, which provides strong support for improving the safety of aerial refueling.

articleTitle: Cooperative Formation Control and Obstacle Avoidance of Multi-Robot Systems Based on Potential Field Method
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Multi-robot systems (MRS) are widely used in military, industrial, and agricultural applications since they are capable of accomplishing tasks that individual robots cannot handle through collaborative cooperation. However, MRS often face challenges when considering formation characterization and obstacle avoidance simultaneously in real-world scenarios. In such context, a distributed cooperative formation and obstacle avoidance controller is proposed for wheeled mobile robots based on potential field method. In this paper, by using the leader-follower model, a consistency-based cooperative formation controller is designed, where the leader robot focuses on reaching the desired target point while the followers are responsible for maintaining the formation. Then, an obstacle avoidance controller based on potential field method is designed to avoid static and dynamic obstacles while preventing the formation from passing across the obstacles. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed cooperative method is verified through simulation tests and real experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Lithium-Ion Battery State of Health Prediction Based on Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Precise prediction of the state of health (SOH) of lithium-ion batteries exerts a key effect on ensuring the safe and reliable operation of battery systems. To solve the issue of low precision in traditional health forecasts for lithium-ion batteries, a lithium-ion battery health forecast approach based on the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) model is proposed. Firstly, the aging characteristics of batteries are analyzed based on the NASA and Maryland University public datasets. Secondly, the ARIMA model is validated using different aging data from two operating conditions to explore the coupling association between battery health and cycle count. According to experimental outcomes, the ARIMA prediction model realizes a precise forecast of the SOH of lithium-ion batteries. Compared to the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network health prediction model, the CS2-37 battery prediction results show an improvement of 92.2% in Mean Absolute Error (MAE), 91.2% in Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and 92.6% in Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).

articleTitle: Motion Planning Framework of Mobile Robots for Prisoner Counting in Workshop
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: For the sake of safety and order, the prison administration needs to carry out strict management and patrols. However, it is difficult to ensure timeliness and comprehensiveness of manual patrols. Robot patrols are already used to help with supervision in some prisons and detention centers. But as far as we know, there is no successfully application of prisoner counting in workshop, which comes down to a multi-area patrol question. In this article, we propose a new universal framework of mobile robots, aiming to solve the multi-area motion planning problem. Simulation results show that the proposed framework performs well in planning efficiency and planning quality. Compared to existing manual counting, robot counting with our proposed planning framework can greatly reduce repetition work of policeman and enrich digital portrayal of prisoners.

articleTitle: A Control Method for Coupled Output-Constrained Robotic System
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel control strategy is proposed to deal with the coupled output constraints of the robotic system. A transformation matrix is designed to decouple the relations of the output constraints and transform the problem into an uncoupling time-varying constrained problem. The controller is designed based on the time-varying barrier Lyapunov function (TVBLF) to ensure the transformed tracking errors remain within the pre-specified bounds, and the robotic system achieves asymptotic stability under the proposed controller by the Lyapunov direct method. Finally, numerical simulation results are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Application of multi-path network combined with attention mechanism in the diagnosis of diabetes retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Diabetes retina is one of the most serious causes of blindness. In order to improve the diagnostic accuracy of the severity of diabetes retinopathy, a multipath model was proposed to classify retinopathy. This model designs a multipath network to fully extract features, fuse contextual information, then design a feature fusion module, and combine attention mechanisms to fuse the extracted results to form the final classification features. The classification accuracy of the proposed model reaches 97.51%, effectively classifying different degrees of retinal lesions and preventing further deterioration of the lesions.

articleTitle: An End-to-End Automatic Classification Algorithm for Hyperspectral Images via 3D Convolution and Swin-Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Deep Learning (DL) is one of the key technologies to realize artificial intelligence (AI), which achieves automatic classification and prediction of data by simulating the learning process of the human brain. Convolutional neural network (CNN) is a very important architecture in DL, which is being widely used in the classification task of hyperspectral images (HSI).The local convolutional operation in CNN cannot learn the global semantic information in HSI adequately, but the multi-attention mechanism in the Swin-Transformer can fully utilize the rich discriminative information. So we jointly design an "end-to-end" deep network model with Swin-Transformer to further improve the classification accuracy of HSI. First, the HSI is downscaled using principal component analysis, and the neighborhood data around the pixel is selected as the input samples to make full use of the null-spectrum joint information in the image; then, the input samples are converted into sequence feature vectors using convolutional layers; finally, the classification is carried out by using the constructed Swin-Transformer blocks. The experiments show that our method can achieve better classification performance than some existing CNN models.

articleTitle: Parameter Self-tuning of ADRC for Electronic Throttle Based on CARLA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The electronic throttle system (ETS) is a critical component of the automotive gasoline engine, and ensuring accurate and rapid tracking of the disired throttle position without overshoot poses significant importance for vehicle safety and driving comfort. In this study, we designed an active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC) to achieve the accurate throttle tracking control. Considerring performance degradation caused by the engine aging and changes in operating conditions, a continuous action reinforcement learning automata (CARLA) algorithm is applied to tuning the control parameters adaptively. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed parameter tuning strategy.

articleTitle: Dynamic output feedback control for switched systems based on time scheduled multiple discontinuous Lyapunov functions
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This study focuses on dynamic output feedback control for a category of switched systems featuring mode-dependent average dwell-time. A novel time-scheduled control strategy is implemented, multiple discontinuous Lyapunov functions (MDLF) dependent on switching signals of continuous-time switched systems are established. Initially, the global uniform asymptotic stability of switched systems is examined. Subsequently, using the time scheduled MDLF approach, a collection of mode-dependent controllers is formulated. At the conclusion, a simulation example is given to illustrate the effectiveness and advantages of the raised approach.

Author Keywords: time scheduled multiple discontinuous Lyapunov function

articleTitle: Development and Application of Cable Trench Drilling Robot Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Cable trench drilling, as a key step in the installation of power systems, directly affects the progress and quality of the overall project. Traditional drilling methods are limited by manual operation, resulting in low efficiency, difficulty in ensuring accuracy, and safety hazards. Therefore, this paper proposes an automated and intelligent cable trench drilling robot based on artificial intelligence technology. The robot has functions of automatic walking and correction, automatic drilling, and real-time verification of hole spacing errors, significantly improving the quality, accuracy, and production efficiency of drilling. At the same time, it reduces the labor intensity and safety risks for workers, effectively prolongs the robot’s lifespan, and brings revolutionary changes to power construction.

articleTitle: IMU and LIDAR Odometry Based on CNN and RNN Self-Supervised Learning and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Robots use their own sensors to obtain environmental perception information to solve their own understanding of the environment, such as SLAM(Simultaneous localization and mapping). This paper uses self-supervised deep learning to solve the odometry problem of robots in SLAM by modeling the fusion of IMU measurements and lidar measurements. In this paper, we uses a neural network to fuse the IMU measurements of two lidar data frames with lidar data. Fusing more deterministic a priori information can effectively reduce the trajectory drift for filter-based or optimized-based odometry. This paper also adopts this idea to increase the length of the processing sequence by using the feature that LSTM can process multiple frames of lidar data simultaneously. The global positional pose is also obtained using the LSTM’s ability to remember prior information. The learning-based approach can simplify the modeling difficulty and get better odometry results, but the supervised learning-based method needs to get the accurate position and pose true value. In many cases, obtaining accurate positional pose truth is very expensive and difficult to obtain. Therefore, it is reasonable and feasible to form a selfsupervised approach to the network’s output by fully using the training data’s characteristics. Based on this, in this paper, we propose a network structure that utilizes CNN and RNN and incorporates IMU measurement information. We propose neural network odometry using IMU and lidar data fusion. Using the feature that the LSTM can change the sequence length, we design a processing method similar to the sliding window algorithm to suppress drift, taking full advantage of the inspiration of the sliding window algorithm. Introducing a self-supervised adversarial mechanism based on point cloud segmentation. It makes the self-supervised process more robust and fast convergence.

articleTitle: Process Industry Scheduling Based on Graph Neural Network and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The production scheduling in the process industry is becoming increasingly complex due to the continuous expansion of scale. Traditional heuristic algorithms or mathematical methods struggle to handle dynamic orders. Conventional reinforcement learning-based algorithms fail to fully represent the model characteristics in scheduling models with heterogeneous features. We propose the HGCN-PPO algorithm, based on Proximal Policy Optimization(PPO), by introducing Graph Convolutional Network(GCN) and processing of heterogeneous features. This method effectively addresses the uncertainties in the scheduling process and extracts deep features of the scheduling problem. Furthermore, we compare our algorithm with conventional reinforcement learning algorithms to verify the role of GCN in feature extraction. We also validate the impact of heterogeneous graph features on the performance of scheduling algorithms, proving the effectiveness of our algorithm in the scheduling of the process industry.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Multi-Robot Pursuit with Deep Reinforcement Learning and Navigation Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Robotic systems have been used to solve multiple important problems, including pursuit. However, traditional methods in game theory and controlling make it difficult to resolve pursuit problems with high dimensions, continuous spaces, and complex non-convex obstacles. Recently, many researchers have proved that deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has strong feature extraction and decision-making ability when solving decision problems in high-dimensional, continuous space. Thus, applying DRL methods to multi-robot pursuit problems is reasonable. Firstly, in this paper, a multi-robot pursuit simulation environment with complex obstacles in the Unity simulation engine is built. Moreover, a hierarchical method combined with global decision by DRL, local navigation through A* and Navigation Mesh, and collision avoidance by Reciprocal Velocity Obstacles (RVO) is proposed. Finally, the experiment results show the effectiveness of our methods in solving the multi-robot pursuit problem.

articleTitle: Cross-modal Adaptive Fusion Object Detection Based on Illumination-Awareness
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, cross-modal object detection has attracted much attention from researchers across various domains. Compared to single-modal detection, cross-modal object detection combines diverse features from distinct modalities, bolstering the reliability and robustness of object detection applications. However, presently proposed cross-modal models exhibit deficiencies in terms of fusion methodologies, resulting them less suitable for the specific task of aerial object detection.To address these challenges, we present the Cross-Modal Adaptive Fusion Network based on Illumination Awareness (CAFN-IA). The Illumination Awareness module is designed to dynamically adjust the position and orientation of GroundTruth-Box (GT-Box) by quantifying light intensity and computing Intersection over Union (IoU) metrics derived from RGB and Infrared images. Additionally, a dual-stream network architecture is developed to extract RGB and Infrared features separately. Moreover, the introduction of an Interest Region Extraction module enhances the extraction of partial regions. Furthermore, we introduce a Cross-Scale Adaptive Fusion module, enhancing the complementarity of distinct features generating from RGB and Infrared images. Notably, our approach involves the modification of the loss function to elevate the accuracy of small object detection.Extensive experimentation and thorough ablation studies demonstrate the efficacy of our method, yielding an accuracy rate surpassing 69% on the DroneVehicle Datasets.

articleTitle: Online Electricity Purchase for Data Center with Dynamic Virtual Battery from Flexibility Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: As a critical component of modern infrastructure, data centers account for a huge amount of power consumption and greenhouse gas emission. This paper studies the electricity purchase strategy for a data center to lower its energy cost while integrating local renewable generation under uncertainty. To facilitate efficient and scalable decision-making, we propose a two-layer hierarchy where the lower layer consists of the operation of all electrical equipment in the data center and the upper layer determines the procurement and dispatch of electricity. At the lower layer, instead of device-level scheduling in real time, we propose to exploit the inherent flexibility in demand, such as thermostatically controlled loads and flexible computing tasks, and aggregate them into virtual batteries. By this means, the upper-layer decision only needs to take into account these virtual batteries, the size of which is generally small and independent of the data center scale. We further propose an online algorithm based on Lyapunov optimization to purchase electricity from the grid with a manageable energy cost, even though the prices, renewable availability, and battery specifications are uncertain and dynamic. In particular, we show that, under mild conditions, our algorithm can achieve bounded loss compared with the offline optimal cost, while strictly respecting battery operational constraints. Extensive simulation studies validate the theoretical analysis and illustrate the tradeoff between optimality and conservativeness.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Generative Artificial Intelligence in The field of Open Source Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Current open source intelligence (OSINT) collection and analysis face challenges such as low efficiency in information gathering and processing, narrow coverage, and strong subjectivity, making it difficult to meet practical requirements. There is an urgent need to enhance the intelligence level of OSINT methods. Recently, Artificial Intelligence Generated Content has received increasing attention. Generative AI technologies, through processes like data mining, preprocessing, model training, content generation, and traceability and verification, can make OSINT collection and analysis more flexible and efficient. This paper presents application patterns of generative AI technologies in the field of OSINT. It designs a full-chain intelligent intelligence service model from information collection to service delivery. Additionally, the paper elaborates on the application prospects and challenges of integrating AI and OSINT. This provides insights and methodological approaches for upgrading intelligence methods and technologies from "Manual" to "Intelligent".

articleTitle: An Improved Gaussian Mixture Model Motion Target Detection Algorithm for Complex Backgrounds
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The problem of detecting moving targets under practical working conditions, taking into account the unstructured environment, background reflections, and shadows interfering with the detected target, leads to the problem of missing information about the detected target, which makes it difficult to carry out accurate tracking and localization. In this paper, a moving target detection method based on a Gaussian mixture model of HSV (hue, saturation, value) color space is proposed. Firstly, the method of the Gaussian mixture model is used to solve the problem that the target is easily interfered with by the background reflection when acquiring the target. And then, color conversion using HSV color space. Detects and removes shadows by comparing the difference in features between moving targets and shadows. Finally, the filtering and noise reduction method is chosen to remove the background noise from the target features to get the complete moving target. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can accurately acquire the motion target and effectively avoid the influence of the surrounding complex environmental noise, background reflection, and shadow interference. The shadow detection rate, ROI (Region of Interest) discrimination rate, and mean value reach 96.5%, 97.0%, and 96.7%, respectively. Compared with other methods, the indexes are improved by 20% on average, and the performance of motion target detection is superior.

articleTitle: An overview on big data analysis of large-scale pumped storage power plant equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Large-scale pumped storage power station equipment plays a crucial role in the electricity system and holds significant importance for energy storage and power dispatch. However, the reliability and performance maintenance of these equipment have always been a challenge in the power industry. To address these issues, real-time monitoring and analysis of the equipment's condition have become crucial. This review covers the status monitoring and analysis of large-scale pumped storage power station equipment, including hydraulic turbine condition monitoring, generator condition monitoring, governor system monitoring, excitation system monitoring, transformer equipment operational status monitoring, and GIS equipment investigation. Research in these areas provides strong support for performance optimization, fault prediction, and maintenance of power station equipment. In the future, with the continuous development of machine learning and big data technologies, the monitoring and analysis of power station equipment's condition will further improve, potentially enhancing the reliability and efficiency of the power system.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent Based Simulation Modeling Method for UAV Swarm Collaborative Combat
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarm collaborative combat is increasingly becoming a vital component in modern warfare systems. As an important part of swarm warfare research, the modeling and full process simulation systems for collaborative operations have become a challenging topic. Considering the characteristics of swarm combat, this paper constructs a simulation modeling design for UAV swarm collaborative combat simulations. Based on multi-agent modeling technology, UAV swarms are modeled as multiple intelligent agents with behavior models and strategy models. In the behavior model, the movement, formation, communication, detection, and strike behaviors of UAV swarm are fully considered. To further characterize the collaborative characteristics, emergency network formation strategies, collaborative search strategies based on stepwise predictive control, and collaborative strike strategies responsive to situational changes are designed in the strategy model. A simulation scenario is designed and simulated, which validates the feasibility and effectiveness of the simulation model. The impact of swarm size, task complexity, environmental interferenceˈ and strategic selection on combat effectiveness is verified by the simulation system. This simulation model can fully show the validation for collaborative operations and provide guidance for decision optimization.

articleTitle: UAV Small Target Detection in Complex Scenes Based on Improved YOLOv8s
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the phenomenon of misdetection and omission caused by the question of tiny target size and difficulty in capturing details when UAVs perform target detection tasks in intricate scenes. An modified target detection algorithm YOLOv8s-SME with YOLOv8s as the base algorithm is proposed.
