abstract: A sand cat swarm optimization algorithm was presented, and it incorporates a sparrow warning mechanism and spiral search to overcome the challenges related to weak global exploration capabilities and susceptibility to local optima in traditional sand cat swarm optimization algorithms. Firstly, the integration of Cubic chaotic mapping results in a more uniformly distributed initial population, enhancing the varied nature of the sand cat population and expediting algorithm convergence. Secondly, the incorporation of a spiral search strategy during the prey search phase enables the sand cat to explore multiple paths for better positional adjustments, thereby enhancing the algorithm's ability to conduct extensive global exploration. Finally, the introduction of the sparrow warning mechanism facilitates quicker convergence speed for the sand cat swarm algorithm. The performance of the enhanced algorithm was assessed utilizing 4 core test functions from the CEC2017 benchmark set and compared against path planning experiments of PSO, GWO, AWOA, GA, and SCSO algorithms in complex maps. The improved algorithm achieved a 9.46%, 14.83%, 14.32%, 5.76%, and 1.06% reduction in the optimal value of the shortest path compared to the algorithms, respectively. The enhanced algorithm demonstrated remarkable search efficiency, the ability to avoid local optima, and advantages in convergence speed, accuracy, and optimization time.

Author Keywords: the sand cat swarm optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control with Incremental Input Constraints for Trajectory Tracking of Wheeled Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a model predictive control algorithm with incremental input constraints for trajectory tracking of wheeled mobile robot (WMR). This algorithm ensures that the rate of change of control inputs remains within a certain range, avoiding deterioration in the control performance or mechanical damage caused by excessive changes in control inputs. Firstly, based on the kinematics equations of WMR, we establish a trajectory tracking error model. Then, combining this model, we present a model predictive control algorithm with control increment constraints. Furthermore, by utilizing the properties of cost function monotonically decreasing along predicted trajectories and system states converging to equilibrium points, together with Lyapunov Theorem, we prove the asymptotic stability of the system. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that under this algorithm’s control, the trajectory tracking error model can stably converge to equilibrium point while satisfying incremental input constraints.

articleTitle: Extended State Observer Based Consensus Control of Linear Multi-Agent Systems with Input Saturation and Unknown Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, the leader-follower consensus problem of linear multi-agent systems (MASs) is studied, in which each agent is subject to unknown disturbance and input saturation. A distributed extended state observer (ESO) is first designed, to estimate the state and disturbance of each follower, which guarantees the consensus error asymptotic convergence without consideration of the saturation. Then, to improve the performance with input saturation, anti-windup compensation is designed. Finally, we demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed methods by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Research on 6DOF gripping position measurement strategy of robot based on monocular vision
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The purpose of this thesis is to propose a 6DoF grasping position measurement strategy for robots based on monocular vision in response to the problems of high cost and poor stability of 6DoF grasping position measurement of target workpieces when industrial robots are grasping metal workpieces under vision system. The strategy adopts a simple structure, low-cost, easy-to-deploy monocular vision system to collect industrial sample data, and through the introduction of virtual reality technology and generative adversarial network, to realize the purpose of data enhancement for industrial metal small sample objects with surface defects and interference from the external environment, to solve the problem of insufficient data due to the difficulty of acquiring data in complex environments, and to achieve the problem of insufficient data due to the later application of monocular vision system as well. The purpose of continuously updating and expanding the sample data can be achieved by applying the monocular vision system in the later stage. At the same time, combining the deep learning-based multi-keypoint object detection technology and 2D-3D affine transformation, the method realizes the accurate measurement of the 6DoF position of the target workpiece. This method can measure the 6DoF position of industrial metal parts only by 2D plane images, and is a new method to estimate the 6DoF pose of a given object from a single RGB image using monocular vision, which possesses the ability to detect the pose of target objects with low-cost, stable, and strong antiinterference, reduces the cost of using robotic vision guidance technology in the industrial field, and provides a new way of thinking for monocular vision to be adopted by the industrial field. Provide a new idea for monocular vision to be adopted by the industrial field. Experiments show that the method has good detection accuracy for industrial small sample objects.

articleTitle: Robust Output Feedback Tube Model Predictive Control for Path Following of A Constrained Quadrotor Under External Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a path following control method based on output feedback tube model predictive control (OFTMPC) and PD for a constrained quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle system with unmeasurable system states and unknown disturbances. In translational motion dynamics, this paper guarantees the state and control constraints under unknown but bounded disturbances and measurement noise by applying OFTMPC. Additionally, we design an H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> observer to mitigate estimation errors. In rotational motion dynamics, PD control is employed to enhance the attitude response speed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated through simulation using a specific example.

articleTitle: Low-carbon economic dispatch of integrated energy systems considering refined utilization of hydrogen energy
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high economic cost, high carbon emission, and the existence of power abandonment in wind and light of the traditional integrated energy system containing hydrogen, a low-carbon economic dispatch model of the integrated energy system that considers stepped carbon trading and refined utilization of hydrogen energy is proposed. First, the carbon capture power plant on the source side adds flue gas diversion and liquid storage tanks on the basis of the traditional model to build a flexible operation carbon capture power plant. Time-sharing tariffs are set on the load side to realize peak shaving and valley filling. Secondly, establish a refined hydrogen energy utilization model of electrolyzer, methane reactor, gas doped hydrogen cogeneration unit, gas doped hydrogen boiler, and hydrogen storage tank to fully explore the low-carbon and economic nature of hydrogen energy utilization. Finally, the stepped carbon trading mechanism is introduced to establish a low-carbon economic dispatching model that minimizes the cost of purchasing electricity, purchasing gas, coal combustion cost, carbon trading cost, carbon sequestration cost, wind abandonment penalty cost, and light abandonment penalty cost. Example analysis shows that the model proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the system operation cost, reduce CO2 emission, and realize the low-carbon economic dispatching of the integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Planning Safe Trajectories for Quadrotors Using Secure Aerial Corridors with Local Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this work, we propose a quadrotor path planning method comprises of secure aerial corridors method (SAC) and B-spline-based local planning method (BLP). The proposed method can generate safe, smooth, and dynamical feasible trajectories for quadrotor in complex environments with fewer computational cost. We use a set of convex polyhedrons to construct SAC as free space and plan global flight trajectory within them. Furthermore, in order to avoid unknown obstacles during the flight process, we employ the BLP method to re-plan and generate collision-free trajectories within the limited perceptual range of the quadrotor. The feasibility and completeness of the proposed method are validated in a complex simulation environment.

articleTitle: Traffic Anomaly Prediction based on Spatio-Temporal Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Traffic Anomaly Prediction (TAP) has emerged as a critical concern in the field of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), attracting attention from numerous scholars. Accurately predicting traffic anomalies is challenging due to the inherent uncertainty in their occurrence. Unfortunately, most existing methods overlook this issue. They rely solely on deterministic modeling approaches. Moreover, many TAP methods are only applicable to simple transportation scenarios, disregarding the complex spatio-temporal dependencies of traffic anomalies. To address these challenges, we propose a novel TAP method that integrates deterministic and uncertainty modeling approaches. Firstly, we design an attention-based temporal convolutional module to capture temporal dependence from anomaly data. Secondly, we introduce a diffusion graph convolution module to capture spatial dependence across different regions. These two modules are then combined to extract spatio-temporal features of the anomaly pattern. Subsequently, we employ a probabilistic module to address potential uncertainty. Finally, we develop a model for TAP based on spatio-temporal uncertainty. We collected and processed traffic anomaly data from 24 regions in Beijing. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms existing models.

articleTitle: Research on wind power-hydrogen energy storage model taking into account the utilization of wind abandonment
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of serious wind abandonment of wind power grid-connected, a wind-hydrogen consumption model is proposed with the goal of minimizing economic cost and maximizing wind abandonment and consumption. First, a wind-hydrogen energy storage model is established based on the wind abandonment characteristics, and the system hydrogen storage tank capacity is reasonably configured. Then, considering the economic cost, the wind-hydrogen energy storage economic model is established. Finally, the validity of this wind-hydrogen consumption model is verified by case analysis. The results indicate that the proposed model can realize carbon emission reduction while consuming abandoned wind, and achieve the purpose of enhancing the system revenue.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Observation and Control of Positive Complex Networks Using Linear Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the event-triggered observation and control of positive complex networks with randomly occurring nonlinearities obeying a Bernoulli distribution. By utilizing observation errors and sensor measurements, an event-triggered scheme is formulated based on the form of 1-norm. An event-triggered controller is designed by using linear programming. Sufficient conditions are addressed to ensure the positivity of the lower bound of the closed-loop system. By employing a co-positive Lyapunov function, the stability of the upper bound of the closed-loop system is established. Finally, a simulation example is provided to illustrate the efficacy of the proposed design.

articleTitle: Air-to-Ground Missile Handover Position Optimization and Terminal Guidance Design
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the handover position and terminal guidance design of a certain type of short-range axisymmetric air-to-ground missile. To guide the missile to the vicinity of the target area for target search, a performance-based evaluation function is established to comprehensively optimize the handover position. To meet the constraints of terminal impact angle, a comparative analysis is conducted between the sliding mode guidance law and the over-gravity compensation proportional guidance law, as well as the ballistic shaping guidance law. The results show that the sliding mode guidance law is more efficient in the context of this paper. Finally, a two-loop autopilot is established to obtain a complete guidance control system for simulation, and the effectiveness of the scheme is verified using Monte Carlo method simulation.

Author Keywords: the constraints of terminal impact angle

articleTitle: A two-stages path planning algorithm for Autonomous parking
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper introduces a fully automated parking method that divides the parking path planning process into two stages. One stage, an improved RRT algorithm* is used to plan the global path to the initial parking area. Another stage, an RRT-RS algorithm* is employed to plan a parking trajectory that adheres to the vehicle’s kinematics. Compared to A* and the original RRT* algorithms, our improved RRT* algorithm demonstrates higher efficiency and improved safety. The RRT*-RS algorithm, compared to traditional geometric methods, is more adaptable and capable of handling parking tasks for vehicles with various initial orientations. To enhance dynamic obstacle avoidance and trajectory tracking, a local planner is designed using a combination of the A* algorithm and the MPC algorithm. Finally, the feasibility of this algorithm is validated in a ROS simulation environment.

articleTitle: Linear parameter variation modeling and online model identification algorithms for lithium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of modeling lithium-ion batteries based on linear variable parameter (LPV) models. In the modeling framework of LPV, a recursive algorithm that can predict the output voltage of lithium batteries online is proposed. The primary focal point of this research is to propose a model structure that describes all the internal and external factors of a Li-ion battery and to derive an online algorithm adapted to the battery model to cope with aging and time-varying parameters. Illustrative instances of simulation verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Distributed self-triggered scheme for containment control of Multi-agent systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper examines the multi-agent containment control problem and proposes a distributed self-triggered scheme to reduce network load. Firstly, a novel approach is proposed to integrate the distributed self-triggered mechanism with the containment control, by splitting the global form of the containment error system. In order to achieve containment control with H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance, a condition for system stability and a distributed self-triggered auxiliary condition are presented for each agent. Furthermore, to derive the distributed self-triggered scheme, an auxiliary condition is proposed, in which the next triggering time is calculated based on system states at the previous triggering moment. Consequently, the controller update is triggered based on the calculated triggering moment, ensuring that the followers are led into the convex hull encompassed by the leaders using only the states at triggering instants. At last, the effectiveness of the proposed distributed self-triggered containment control is demonstrated by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Resilient Monitoring in Multi-Robot Systems against denial-of-service attacks through Predictive Network-Reconfiguration Defense
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This study presents a resilience framework designed for heterogeneous multi-robot teams to effectively handle Denial-of-Service attacks. Within this framework, robots distribute resources among each other according to the team’s established communication graph, and the success of their tasks heavily relies on the availability of these shared resources. In the event of a DoS attack that interrupts communications, the team strategically reconfigures the network to ensure uninterrupted task execution. This involves carefully selecting which connections, or edges, in the communication graph should be altered following the disruption. The practicality and effectiveness of this strategy have been validated through a series of simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Finite-time flexible performance-based formation control for wheeled mobile robots with collision avoidance and connection maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of leader-follower formation control for wheeled mobile robots with performance constraints and safety requirements, where the working environment is cluttered with obstacles. The artificial potential function is employed to prevent the followers from colliding with other robots and obstacles, while guaranteeing the communication connectivity with their neighbors. Then, a finite-time flexible performance function is constructed to constrain the formation tracking error such that the formation tracking error converges to a predetermined region in a finite time. This feasible region expands when the performance constraints conflict with collision avoidance and/or connection maintenance constraints. As a result, the proposed finite-time flexible performance-based formation control strategy achieves a delicate balance between the performance constraint and safety requirement. The proposed formation control method also guarantees that all error signals in the closed-loop system converge to a prescribed region within finite time. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Joint Computation Offloading and Resource Allocation for Hybrid Cloud and Edge Computing in Satellite-assisted Unmanned System
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Unmanned systems such as unmanned surface vehicle (USV) and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) are difficult to undertake complex computational tasks on their own due to their limited computational capabilities. The existing method of sending the computation tasks to the ground terminal for processing will bring large transmission delay and reduce the real-time performance of task execution. Inspired by terrestrial mobile edge computing (MEC), deploying edge computing servers on low-orbit satellites (LEO) allows unmanned system to offload tasks to the satellite to enhance the task processing efficiency. However, owing to restricted computing and communication resources of satellite, designing appropriate computational offloading and resource allocation strategies is of great relevance. In this article, we propose a partial computation offloading strategy for a three-tier edge computing architecture consisting of unmanned system, satellites and cloud. We consider the energy optimization of the system under resource constraints while meeting the requirements of tasks. To address this issue, we propose a computational offloading method based on Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG). This method can simultaneously decide the optimal offloading ratio, offloading location and resource allocation ratio under the dynamic environment with multi-task concurrency. The proposed method meets task’s requirements while effectively decreasing the total energy consumption of system. Finally, experimental results prove the effectiveness of the formulated method.

articleTitle: Research on Ontological Information Modeling for the Integration of Cyber and Physical Security in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of power systems and the evolving nature of cyber threats, traditional security management methods are facing growing challenges. The effective integration of cyber security and physical security is key to enhancing overall safety. This study proposes an innovative ontological design approach aimed at constructing a comprehensive semantic network suitable for the integration of these two safety aspects within power systems. Initially, ontologies for cyber security and physical security were designed separately, defining the key entities and their attributes for each. Subsequently, these two ontologies were effectively combined to form a comprehensive ontology model that fully reflects the integration needs of cyber and physical security. This model not only reveals the intrinsic connections between cyber and physical security but also provides new strategies and methods for identifying and preventing cross-domain security threats. Through empirical analysis and case studies, this study validates the effectiveness of the proposed method in enhancing the security of power systems, especially in facilitating early detection and response to security incidents. The findings of this research offer a new perspective and tool for power system security management, holding significant theoretical and practical implications for the deep integration of cyber and physical security.

articleTitle: A lifetime prediction approach for parallel standby systems with stochastically degrading spare parts
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: As the key part of prognostics and health management (PHM), lifetime prediction has been recognized as an effective technology to guarantee reliable, safe and economic operation for key industrial systems. Despite that there are various parallel standby systems in the industry, most exiting researches concerning the lifetime prediction of parallel standby systems ignore the degradation of spare parts in storage, resulting in inaccurate lifetime prediction and unreasonable management arrangement. Therefore, this paper proposes a lifetime prediction approach for parallel standby system with multiple stochastic degrading spare parts of the same type. On the basis of a two-phase Wiener process, the stochastic degradation models for operating parts and stored spare parts has been constructed. Then, the reliability function and lifetime probability density function (PDF) of the system have are derived, integrating the impact of the replacement strategies. Finally, the proposed approach has been demonstrated by a simulation study, where the lifetime PDFs of parallel standby systems under three different replacement strategies are provides and verified.

articleTitle: Safety-Critical Pursuit-Evasion Differential Game Guidance for Multiple Underactuated Autonomous Surface Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper explores an adversarial pursuitevasion differential game problem of two groups of under-actuated autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs) in an obstacle environment. A pursuit-evasion game method featured with intra-team cooperation and inter-team adversary is proposed. Optimal control theory is utilized to obtain the optimal control strategies of pursuing ASVs and evading ASVs. Speed-heading control barrier functions are utilized to address collision avoidance with obstacles and ASVs within the same team. A quadratic programming (QP) problem is formulated by combining the pursuit-evasion strategies with collision avoidance constraints and input constraints. Real-time optimal control signals are generated by solving QP problem. Simulation results effectively validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of 3D bridge crane controller based on TD3 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the issues of high coupling and nonlinearity in the underactuated system of a crane by drawing inspiration from the application of deep reinforcement learning in the field of robotic arm control. The approach of deep reinforcement learning is applied as the controller for the crane. The crane is first modeled using Simscape Multibody, and then the TD3 algorithm is chosen as the controller. Suitable state variables and a reward function are selected to describe the crane's state and objectives, enabling precise control while satisfying constraints. A comparison with traditional PID control methods demonstrates that the proposed approach achieves higher work efficiency and control performance.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Feature Fusion Object Detection Based on Swin Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The precision of object detection is crucial for autonomous vehicles to accurately perceive and understand the surrounding environment. In order to consider the problem of low detection accuracy caused by large differences in target scales and uneven content distribution, the paper proposes a multi-scale object detection method based on Swin Transformer. By enhancing the details of the combined features with low-level information, this method improves the effective utilization of features, thereby reducing the loss of crucial information when adjusting the number of channels. The algorithm presented in this paper improves the mAP by 0.83% and NDS by 0.93% on nuScenes dataset, and improves box AP by 1.4% on COCO dataset compared to the previous algorithm. Comparison results with other methods also validates the effectiveness of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Pseudo Supervised Meta Learning for Susceptibility Assessment of Acute Mountain Sickness
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Acute altitude sickness presents as a syndrome characterized by individuals’ incapacity to adapt to the hypoxic conditions of high-altitude environments. The assessment of this sickness typically relies on the subjective evaluation of symptom severity using the Lake Louise score, introducing potential subjective biases and rendering the labels unreliable. To address this challenge, this paper introduces a weakly supervised meta-learning algorithm tailored for the assessment of susceptibility to acute altitude sickness within a few-shot framework. Initially, objective sleep data is subjected to clustering, and pseudo-labels are generated from the cluster result exhibiting the highest mutual information with the Lake Louise score. This approach capitalizes on the mutual complementarity of subjective and objective data, thereby enhancing label credibility. Subsequently, a task-driven pseudo-label supervised meta-learning algorithm is formulated to comprehensively explore individual differences. Moreover, recognizing the necessity for model updates during online learning, an event-triggered online learning algorithm is devised to optimize computational resources. Experimental validation utilizing data from 18 real subjects demonstrates promising results: an accuracy of 79.900% and an F1 score of 79.342% for acute altitude sickness susceptibility assessment, with further improvements evident through the online updated model’s accuracy of 81.992% and F1 score of 81.366% on the test set. These outcomes underscore the viability of the proposed event-triggered weakly supervised meta-learning algorithm in the assessment of susceptibility to acute altitude sickness.

articleTitle: MSPNet-based Liquid medium leakage Detection in Industrial Sites
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Liquid medium leakage is a common issue at industrial sites, posing significant threats to production safety, environmental pollution, and health risks if not promptly addressed. Detecting and warning about liquid medium leaks quickly and effectively is crucial for ensuring enterprise and environmental safety. The traditional object detection background is complex and diverse, but liquid medium leakage detection typically features a more uniform background affected by factors like illumination, leading to background overfitting and decreased detection accuracy. To enhance robustness and eliminate noise interference, we introduce the EMA image enhancement module in the Neck part of MSPNet. This module ensures spatial semantic features are evenly distributed across feature groups, enhancing the algorithm’s image feature extraction capabilities. Additionally, the introduction of the Bottleneck Transformers module significantly improves baseline object detection accuracy while reducing parameter count. During the inference stage, Gaussian modeling and thresholding methods are employed for background modeling to eliminate irrelevant background information, facilitating object detection in images. Experimental results demonstrate a 12.62% increase in average accuracy compared to the baseline, enhancing liquid media leakage detection accuracy under noise interference and mitigating false alarms and omissions.

articleTitle: PAG-Net:Semantic Segmentation Network of 3D Point Clouds in Excavator Operation Scene based on Attention Mechanics and Ghost Convolutional
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Accelerating the construction of intelligent mining platforms has become an essential path to achieving high-quality development in the industry. Currently, there are still several challenges in developing mine intelligence, including the limited intelligence of mining excavators, particularly their struggle to recognize different operation scenarios. In recent years, with the rapid development of artificial intelligence and deep learning, more and more semantic segmentation methods have been proposed. However, most of the current semantic segmentation methods have a problem: how to possibly achieve higher accuracy with fewer parameters and shorter time. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a novel semantic segmentation approach of 3D point clouds in excavator operation scenes, which integrates the attention mechanism with the lightweight convolutional module. We proposed a semantic segmentation network of 3D point clouds in excavator operation scenes based on attention mechanics and ghost convolutional, called PAG-Net. It includes an input embedding module, a light attention module, and ghost convolution modules. Among them, the input embedding module can transform point clouds into a high-dimensional feature space, retaining more feature information. The light attention module can better focus on the features of the point clouds while balancing efficiency and accuracy. And the ghost convolution modules can accelerate the speed of convolution without losing too much information. Our experimental results show that, in the semantic segmentation task of excavator operation scenes, our method is faster and uses fewer parameters compared to other methods, while also achieving better accuracy.

articleTitle: Dynamic degradation identification of solid oxide fuel cell systems based on automatic spectral clustering and neighborhood rough sets
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the problem that some of the degradation phenomenon states of solid oxide fuel cell systems under dynamics are difficult to be observed directly from the data, this study proposes a dynamic degradation identification method for SOFC systems based on automatic spectral clustering and neighborhood rough sets. First, this method identifies all the health states exhibited by the SOFC system from the dynamic data by using an automatic spectral clustering-based algorithm to determine whether degradation phenomena have occurred. Then, this study extracts the feature variables that lead to changes in the dynamic performance of the SOFC system using a feature extraction method based on neighborhood rough sets, which helps analyze where the anomalies that lead to degradation of the performance may occur and provides a theory to trace the causes of the performance degradation.

articleTitle: Self-triggered model predictive control for switched systems with dwell time constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a new self-triggered model predictive control (MPC) strategy for switched systems under dwell time (DT) constraints. The strategy combines the advantages of self-triggering mechanism and switching control, thereby having a good performance in saving computing resources and adapting to complex engineering practices. To guarantee the feasibility of the switched MPC strategy under the self-triggering framework, the concept of feasible truncated admissible switching sequence (f-TAS) is proposed to solve the constraint violation problem caused by the switching behavior and guarantee the flexible index. Besides, the self-triggering mechanism is developed to overcome the divergence of the Lyapunov function by using the self-triggered relaxation, thus ensuring the sub-optimal performance. Simulation example shows that the algorithm effectively saves the computing resources while ensuring the feasibility and sub-optimal performance.

articleTitle: A distributed random projection gradient method for stochastic optimization problems in multi-agent systems
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the context of time-varying directed graphs under uniformly strong connectivity, this paper studies distributed stochastic optimization problems where the local objective functions and inequality constraints are nonlinear, and the local constraint functions are disturbed by uncertain parameters. The goal is to locate a consensus optimal solution to the optimization problem without intervention from a central agent, where each agent obtains the solution through information exchange with neighbouring agents and local computations. In this article, a distributed random projection gradient (DRPG) algorithm is proposed based on the distributed gradient algorithm, random sampling process and Polyak projection operator. Then, this paper theoretically proves that the DRPG algorithm reaches almost sure convergence. Finally, the convergence of the DRPG algorithm is illustrated by a numerical case study.

articleTitle: IrSADP: A Discriminative Target Predictor with Noise-Invasion Recovery Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 39th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The identification and investigation of intractable noise invasion event embedded in the tracking sequences have been receiving significant attentions for more accurate and more robust visual object trackers which include occlusion, illumination variation and fast motion. However, existing visual object trackers with template updating mechanisms and memory networks based schemes rely on time-consuming multitudinous history information to achieve favorable tracking performances, hindering them from real-time tracking. To further tackle the above difficulties, this paper devises an invasion-recovery strategy aided discriminative target predictor on the basis of deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm (DDPGA) for adaptive noise invasion recovery during online tracking process (IrSADP). The contributions of IrSADP include: 1) a noise modeling of special invasion event is devised in light of incursion effect and corresponding template strategy as bases for adaptive recovery strategy; 2) a deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm based online tracking noise invasion recovery strategy is proposed to surmount the noise invasion effect of special events; 3) the error bound for invasion recovery strategy is provided for convergence analyses of the proposed procedure. Extensive experiments are conducted on OTB100, UAV123, NFS, VOT2019 and AVisT benchmarks to illustrate that 1) the introduced modules in IrSADP can achieve comparable tracking performances against other state-of-the-art (SOTA) trackers; 2) the IrSADP runs at a speed of 38 frames per second (FPS) on 5 aforementioned benchmarks averagely.
